apps.name: AirCard-iOS
apps.subtitle: Apple Wallet card skins, passcode themes and wallpapers
apps.localizedDescription: Customize Apple Wallet card artwork, lock screen passcode dialers and PosterBoard wallpapers directly on device, without a jailbreak. Requires iOS 27 or newer, LocalDevVPN running in loopback mode, and Developer Mode pairing.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's Changed in v1.3.2 🚀

This update brings full feature parity with AirCard macOS v1.2.6, restores robust card discovery across all iOS versions, introduces automatic bank/network recognition with custom card nicknames, delivers an ultra-fast tunnel cache (0.02s connections), and completely resolves wallpaper flashing for Collections and Mercury wallpapers.

### 💳 Wallet Card Discovery & Bank Identification
• **Universal Wallet Log Parser**: Ported the proven `WalletScanParser` from AirCard macOS. Captures cards from `Dashboard loading (...): for SOO+`, `passIDs[InSession]`, `passIDs[global]`, and modern JSON NFC activations (`"identifier": "HEX"`).
• **Automatic Bank & Network Detection**: Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, UnionPay, Discover, and JCB via applet AIDs during selection.
• **Card Nicknames (Rename)**: Added a direct **Rename** button (✏️) so you can give your cards friendly names like *"Monobank"*, *"Salary Card"*, or *"Revolut"*, safely persisted in app settings.
• **28-Character Fallback Token Matcher**: Restores dependable card discovery on devices where standard log patterns are redacted.

### ⚡ Ultra-Fast Tunnel Routing (from 10s to 0.02s!)
• **Working Route Caching**: `rust-core` now caches the active RSD connection route (`LAST_WORKING_ROUTE`), eliminating repeated port and interface scanning.
• **RSD-First Priority**: Connects directly via RemoteXPC on port 49152, bypassing slow Lockdown retries and broken pipes on iOS 18+.
• **Eliminated Loopback Policy Drops**: Removed local loopback attempts that caused `policy drop` control channel errors.

### 🖼 Wallpapers (.tendies) — Collections & Mercury Fixes
• **Dual Injection on iOS 18+**: Wallpapers are now injected into both their primary bundle (`com.apple.WallpaperKit.CollectionsPoster` or `com.apple.MercuryPoster`) and the modern iOS 18+ application container (`com.apple.Posters.CollectionsPosterApp` / `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp`).
• **Metadata Synchronization**: Fixed a critical issue where `Wallpaper.plist`'s numeric identifier was randomized out-of-sync with `suggestionMetadata.plist` (`7400.DYNAMIC`), causing wallpapers like Windows 11 to vanish from the Lock Screen gallery.
• **Mercury Wallpaper Support**: Added recognition for `mercury-descriptors` container folders and registered `com.apple.Posters.MercuryPosterApp` in `PersistedPosterContainerBundleIdentifiers`.
• **NeoSpring Respring**: Instant springboard reload to apply wallpaper preferences immediately.

### 🧪 Quality & Testing
• All 24 unit tests passing (`TendiesEngineTests`, `WalletScanParserTests`, `CardPhotoCropTests`, `CardPhotoPickerTests`).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mak5er/AirCard-iOS/compare/v1.3.1...v1.3.2

apps.name: AniBaka
apps.subtitle: 跨平台番剧聚合、媒体播放与弹幕客户端
apps.localizedDescription: AniBaka 是一个基于 Flutter 的跨平台番剧聚合与媒体播放客户端，支持多番剧源、弹幕、字幕、离线缓存与本地媒体库，并提供动漫实时超分辨率画质增强。

versions.localizedDescription:
本次更新重点优化手机端打开番剧详情和返回的体验，新增本地字体导入，并更新四个内置播放源。

### 界面与交互

- **优化番剧详情转场。** 点击卡片后，圆角小窗口从封面位置逐渐铺满全屏，返回时收回卡片。适配 Android 预测性返回和 iOS 侧滑返回手势。
- **支持导入自定义字体。** 在「设置 → 外观 → 导入字体」选择本地 `.ttf` 或 `.otf` 文件，重启应用后会恢复已导入的字体。
- **调整移动端底部导航。** 优化拖动切换和随滚动收起、显示的交互。社区发帖按钮随底栏一同收起。

### 性能优化/修复

- 优化 Android 首页触摸采样和海报网格绘制，减轻慢速滚动时的细节抖动。
- 减少封面加载、详情刷新和播放选源时的重复处理。内存紧张时释放部分后台标签页。
- 修复ios和macos异常播放器黑屏的问题。

### 播放

- 修复部分 HLS 视频因上游返回重复响应头而无法正常读取分片的问题。

### 平台兼容

- 统一 Android 各架构安装包的版本号，避免同一版本因架构不同而被识别为不同构建。
- 同步 iOS 和 macOS 的媒体库与播放器渲染插件版本，并更新 Windows 打包流程以兼容六位构建号。
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/AniBakaBaka/AniBaka/compare/5.2.4+1101...5.2.5+261113

apps.name: Apollo for Reddit - GLASS
apps.subtitle: Apollo-Reborn build with Liquid Glass patch
apps.localizedDescription:
Apollo-Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo sideload build powered by the Apollo-Reborn tweak.

It restores custom API support, media fixes, uploads, inline media, translation, saved categories, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Liquid Glass support on iOS 26+, and the rest of the project’s ongoing fixes and enhancements.

These sources are intended for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Apollo-Reborn is not compatible with AltStore PAL.

Choose the source variant that matches how you sideload:

• Standard: full app bundle with Apollo’s working extensions plus Apollo-Reborn widgets
• No Extensions: strips app extensions, including widgets, to reduce App ID usage on free Apple IDs
• GLASS: adds the Liquid Glass iOS 26 patch and bundled Liquid Glass icon catalog
• No Extensions + GLASS: combines both options

The extension-bearing builds (Standard and GLASS) register about 7 App IDs, one per bundled app extension. A free Apple ID can register 10 App IDs per 7 days, so a clean single install fits, but it is easy to exceed if you install under more than one bundle ID, reinstall within the same week, or sideload other extension-bearing apps. If an install fails with an App ID error, use a No Extensions build (1 App ID) or wait for older App IDs to expire. A paid Apple Developer account has a much higher cap.

This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Features

- Add a **Subreddit Switcher** choice of **Classic** or **Modern** under Interface → Display & Navigation: Classic brings back Apollo's original Favorites popup for title taps and Posts tab holds, and Modern keeps the search sheet (#1604: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Classic is the default on regular iPhones, so updating from 4.0.x brings the popup back; Modern is the default on iPhone Duo
  - Modern now opens with the keyboard up and starts loading your pick right away, and on the iPhone Duo holding the Posts tab opens the switcher from the side rail and when unfolded
- Add **Jump Button Navigation** so the comment jump button can step through comments posted since your last visit instead of top-level threads; press and hold to go back one (#1506: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Choose Threads (default) or New Comments under Settings → General below Jump Button Position, or from a post's ••• menu; the button shows a NEW label in that mode
- Add **Tint Tab Bar Icons** to give unselected tab icons a muted shade of your theme's accent, on the classic and Liquid Glass tab bars and the iPhone Duo side rail (#1684: @IllIIllIllIllII, @AcornElf)
  - Add **Accent Navigation Buttons** on Liquid Glass to draw Back, toolbar and menu buttons in your theme's accent; titles stay neutral
  - Both are off by default under Settings → Appearance → Theme Manager → Options
- Add **Unread Badges** under Interface to show the Inbox's unread count as a small dot on the tab bar and on the Inbox's Notifications and Chat tabs, and to color unread badges with your theme's accent instead of red (#1680: @icpryde, @AcornElf)
  - Compact Dot on Tab Bar, Compact Dot in Inbox (shown while modern Chat is on) and Theme Color are each off by default
- Show **Hidden & Deleted** in Apollo's own post and comment lists, so results follow your post size, thumbnails, text size, themes, swipe actions and menus, and open their threads like anywhere else (#1485: @IllIIllIllIllII)
  - Items keep their Hidden, Removed or Deleted label, removed posts keep their saved title and media, and the Posts tab has its own Compact Posts / Large Thumbnails button

  - It turns on by itself when you half-fold with a video open and goes back to the normal viewer when you unfold; on every device, Hold for Video Speed no longer fires when you press a video control

### Fixes

- Keep the closed **iPhone Duo**'s side rail working when a Live Activity, Moderator or Translate leaves it short of room: More (•••) opens in one tap with Sort, its time ranges and Moderator tools inside, and the subreddit list keeps Edit and Add in the rail (#1473, #1688: @IllIIllIllIllII)

apps.name: Applesauce
apps.subtitle: A playful emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Plays supported 32-bit iPhone games on modern devices, carrying both the HyperHLE v1.0.6 and touchHLE 0.2.3 emulator cores so you can pick which one runs each game. An unaffiliated fork, endorsed by neither project. JIT must be enabled for each new app process. No games are included.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Applesauce 0.4.2

Five fixes, mostly found by pushing Blade Dash and Talking Tom until they
broke. Nothing about installing or your library changes — pick the same IPA
you used for 0.4.0.

Applesauce is an unaffiliated fork. The emulation is the work of
[touchHLE](https://github.com/touchHLE/touchHLE) and its fork
[HyperHLE](https://github.com/HyperHLE/HyperHLE); neither project is connected
to this one or endorses it. Please report problems here rather than to them.

## The on-screen keyboard now appears in games that use text fields

Games that focus a text field — The Sims Medieval naming your Sim or kingdom,
Peggle's profile certificate, Blokus, Spore — loaded the iOS keyboard
subsystem but no keyboard ever came up, so those names could not be entered.
The cause was run-loop starvation: the emulator holds the main thread and only
let iOS service its run loop for microseconds per frame, far too little for the
asynchronous keyboard-presentation handshake to finish, so iOS invalidated the
keyboard service connection. The emulator now services the run loop generously
while a text field is focused, which is not performance-sensitive because those
are name-entry screens.

## Talking-character apps can use the microphone

Apps like Talking Tom sat silent because input audio queues were created but
never delivered any audio. They now capture through the microphone, and iOS
shows its normal microphone-permission prompt the first time a game records.
Along the way this also fixes two things that made Talking Tom unusable:

- **It no longer freezes after a couple of taps.** Its recorder treated a
  buffer that reported zero packets as empty and re-enqueued it without ever
  looking at the audio, so it waited forever for speech that had already
  arrived. The real sample count is reported now.
- **Opening the upgrade screen no longer crashes.** That screen loads a
  UTF-16 text file, the format Apple recommended for older apps, and the
  loader used to abort on it. It reads UTF-16 in either byte order now.

## Games that crashed on launch now start

Blade Dash — and other games built on Google's protobuf/Tag Manager runtime —
crashed immediately with a stack overflow or an infinite loop. Three separate
causes:

- The old-toolchain `[super …]` call was unbound, turning every super-call
  into infinite recursion on the object itself.
- `NSAllocateObject` was implemented by re-sending `alloc`, which recursed
  forever whenever an app allocates with a computed size.
- Legitimately deep start-up chains (protobuf nests initialisation through
  hundreds of classes) overflowed the small per-thread host stack before the
  recursion guard could catch it; threads get a much larger stack now.

## Notes

These fixes are in the HyperHLE core and the shared iOS layer. As always, JIT
must be enabled before starting a game, and gameplay behaviour on a physical
device can differ from the simulator — please report anything that still
misbehaves, with the log from **On My iPhone → Applesauce → touchhle-host.log**.

apps.name: ARMSX2
apps.subtitle: PlayStation 2 emulator for ARM64
apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64.AppImage, for 4K, 16K and 64K page kernels alike
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- COP2: a VU0 sync runs VU0 to the EE's clock, never past it
- iOS: bump to 2.6.1
- Android: compile the GS shaders and the GameDB into the core
- Embedded resources: the compiled-in copy wins over the resources folder
- iOS: L3 and R3 buttons in the pad layout
- iOS: move the D-pad and face buttons as one in the pad editor
- iOS: drop the old pad layout editor
- iOS: floating sticks in the pad layout
- iOS: touch pad editor with drop cards, controller and VoiceOver
- iOS: per-class pad layouts with opacity and a book slot
- Android: offer our Turnip pack on the Adreno 8xx parts its device table lists
- Adreno 8xx on Turnip takes the declared feedback loop with the per-draw barriers

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261124...d4fe08faebcb977da891b20477a3f8b7eb9ee531

apps.name: Asspp
apps.subtitle: The ultimate multi-region App Store manager
apps.localizedDescription:
Manage multiple Apple IDs across App Store regions: switch stores instantly, browse and download official IPAs from anywhere, and keep a searchable IPA library with older versions — no signing out of your device required.

Downloads go through Apple's servers with your own Apple ID. Because the underlying protocol is the same one ipatool uses, a secondary or burner account is strongly recommended.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Changes

- Recover downloads when Apple returns an empty HTTP 500 by retrying the version-pinned request through the bag’s update endpoint.
- Update ApplePackage to 2.0.3 with Swift 6.2 compatibility fixes.
- Report Keychain save failures before completing login, and preserve stored data when loading fails.
- Improve empty account layout, editable device identifiers, and account table column widths.
- Remove personal metadata from bundled installation certificates and omit the CA private key.
- Explicitly clear development teams for release builds and check packaged artifacts before publication.

## Installation certificate

The local installation CA was replaced to remove personal metadata. If you use OTA installation, install and trust the new certificate from Settings after updating.

The release contains an unsigned iOS IPA and a macOS ZIP without a personal development team.

apps.name: BCD
apps.subtitle: Windows games on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: A fast, controller-friendly launcher that runs Windows games on iOS and iPadOS with Steam and GOG built in, powered by Wine, FEX and Metal via DXMT.

versions.localizedDescription:
**BCD is in alpha:** an early stage of development, before beta. Many games run, many do not yet, and things can break between builds. When a game fails, please send a log.

> **Everything new in this release is experimental and has been tried on only a few devices so far.** It may work great on yours, or it may not work at all. Either way, a log helps a lot.

> **Tried a game on an earlier build? Reset its settings first.** On the game's page: **Options › Recommended settings › Reset to Recommended**. The recommended list changed for 17 games in this release.

This build brings everything since 0.1.712:
- a fix for the launch crash on the iOS 27.2 beta;
- Steam Cloud saves that games could not see;
- a round of fixes from the logs you sent and from the #game-reports channel;
- LiveContainer 3.8.14 support for the built-in JIT helper;
- live logs over Wi-Fi;
- an option to see the game's cursor in Mouse-look;
- a fix for bcd.cfg losing every setting over one odd character, fixes for videos in 32-bit games and two new switches that save CPU time.

## Fixed: the launch crash on the iOS 27.2 beta

0.1.712 crashed at once on the iOS 27.2 beta when a Steam account was signed in. Two of Apple's date comparisons are new in iOS 27.2, and the beta says it is 27.2 without having them yet. BCD now compares dates in a way that gives the same result on every iOS. The build now also fails on my build Mac if a new call of that kind ever comes in.

## Steam Cloud: saves the game could not see (changed default)

Some games keep their saves through Steam Cloud's own interface: The Binding of Isaac, Don't Starve and Slay the Spire 2, for example. Players reported "no cloud saves" in such games. BCD downloaded the files, but the game started a new profile.

- **Why:** in a BCD Dock session such a game sees only the files Valve's client lists in its own file list (`remotecache.vdf`). BCD downloaded your saves next to that list but did not add them to it. The game saw no saves, started a new profile, and that new profile could later be uploaded over the old one.
- **What changed:** after each comparison, before the game starts, BCD now writes Valve's list when a save that is the same on the device and in the cloud is missing from it. A game whose list already names its saves, and a game with no such saves, gets no write. The rewrite existed before, but it was off.
- **Going back:** in **Settings › All settings**, `env.MADEIRA_STEAM_CLOUD_REMOTECACHE` (Steam Cloud: Valve's client's file list) offers three choices:
  - **When a save is missing from it** (the new default);
  - **After every comparison**;
  - **Never** (as before).
- **Not covered:** games that keep their saves in their own folders through Steam's automatic cloud (Cult of the Lamb, for example). If yours lost its save, please send the log of a start right after you see the empty save.
- The log now counts, at each comparison, how many saves the list names and how many it misses. It counts only and names no files.

## Fixed in games (from the logs you sent and #game-reports)

Each was made from a log and checked by tests on a Mac.

- **Cyberpunk 2077** now gets far: on one 12 GB iPhone it played for one to two minutes at about 30 FPS. Then Metal ended it for a blend setting it does not allow on a second render target. BCD now builds such a pipeline without that blend.
- **The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+** still crashed with the 32-bit memory settings that 0.1.712 put in its recommended settings: the game's memory library asks for memory without naming an upper limit, and the settings only looked at requests that name one. Such a request now also stays inside the game's own part of the address space.
- **Hitman: Blood Money** stopped in its start-up code every time (14 logs). Its recommended settings now make BCD's translator check every instruction against the program's current bytes (`env.FEX_SMCCHECKS = full`). It is slower.
- **Resident Evil 7, The Witcher 3, Just Cause 3, Devil May Cry 5 and other Direct3D 11 games that hang the GPU:** the 64-bit Direct3D 11 layer BCD ships was built before a fix in its own source for draws with tessellation or geometry shaders. With that fix missing, a batch of such draws could keep the GPU busy until iOS reset it.
  - BCD carries a newer build of that layer, the "fresh" set. `env.MADEIRA_DXMT_FRESH = 1` in a game's settings uses it.
  - Resident Evil 7's recommended settings now carry the line: a player's freeze at one place was gone with it.
  - For other games, auto-tune offers it once after a start that ended with the GPU hang, except for the heavy games that have settings of their own, such as GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2.
- **ULTRAKILL and other games played with a mouse or trackpad:** pressing Escape ended the mouse lock, and the mouse then stayed dead until you switched apps. When iPadOS ends a lock BCD still wants, BCD now takes it as your own release of the pointer. `env.MADEIRA_POINTER_LOCK_END = 0` turns this off.
- **FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles and Kingdom Come: Deliverance II** stopped on a Direct3D 12 pipeline library. Their recommended settings now turn BCD's pipeline library on (`d3d12-pipeline-library = 1`).
- **Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter (demo):** the demo has its own Steam App ID, so the full game's recommended settings never reached it. They do now.
- **FINAL FANTASY XIII** showed its "not enough video memory" box. It reads the 128 MB that Windows' DirectX diagnostics reports, and its recommended settings now report 2000 MB.
- **S.T.A.L.K.E.R. (Shadow of Chernobyl, Clear Sky, Call of Pripyat) through BCD Dock:** the first Play ran only the game's DirectX setup, which failed, and you had to restart BCD. BCD already ships what that setup installs, so the setup is now skipped and the first Play starts the game.
- **Stardew Valley** stopped after one frame while GOG Galaxy's online library waited for a Galaxy program that is not there. Its recommended settings switch that library off for this game. GOG's online features are not available then.
- **MudRunner (Epic)** started without BCD's sign-in helper, so its Epic online services had no sign-in and the game faulted. It now starts through the helper.
- **Borderlands 2** copied a whole vertex buffer for every draw (13 to 21 FPS in a player's report). It now gets the Direct3D 9 change that copies only what a draw reads (`env.DXMT_D9_VB_RANGE = 1`, see 0.1.712).
- **Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition** on devices whose GPU cannot read compressed textures (A14 and older): coloured noise on every texture. BCD now decodes those textures on the CPU for it. Devices with less than 10 GB of RAM also get the memory settings of the one run that lasted.
- **Kingdom Come: Deliverance** (the first game) was closed by iOS at the memory limit on an 8 GB phone. Devices with less than 10 GB of RAM now get the swap file of the other 8 GB rows.
- **Dead Space 2:** EA's activation program read garbled text and the game ended. Its recommended settings try the emulator's exact x87 mode. This is an experiment.
- **Crysis (2007):** the 64-bit program stops in `CrySystem.dll` on a pointer it keeps in 32 bits. Use the 32-bit program, `Bin32\Crysis.exe`. The game's page says so.
- **Games with a large program at a fixed address** (DRAGON BALL FighterZ, eFootball PES 2021):
  - **The cause:** in some starts of BCD, iOS puts memory of its own where the program must load, and the game does not start.
  - **What changed:** BCD now also uses the free room below it when that room holds the program's own size.
  - **When it still happens:** quit BCD completely (swipe it away in the app switcher), open it again and start the game. iOS lays memory out anew at every start.
- **Steam games whose files Steam prepares for your account (copy protection), through BCD Dock:**
  - **The stop:** in some starts of BCD, Valve's helper service ends at once after its first call to Windows' service manager is lost, and the start fails with code 49 (Mafia II, Call of Duty: Black Ops and others).
  - **The experiment:** when that happens in a service manager BCD Dock started itself, it now starts one fresh service manager and tries the service once more. This costs about 25 seconds, and only on a start that would fail anyway. `env.MADEIRA_DOCK_CEG_SCM_RESTART = 0` turns it off.
  - **The text:** the code 55 message now says that this does not happen in every start of BCD.
- **Path of Exile 2** could open neither its shader cache nor its pipeline cache:
  - **The stop:** the game opens each cache as a 100 GB view over a small file and grows it as it writes. Windows allows that. BCD refused it (`c000001f` in the log).
  - **What changed:** BCD now extends the file to the end of such a view, at most 16 GB by default (`env.MADEIRA_SECTION_VIEW_CAP_GB`). The empty part takes no storage. Only a request BCD refused before takes this path; every other one is handled as before.
  - **Going back:** `env.MADEIRA_SECTION_VIEW_GROW = 0` brings the refusal back.
- **Logs:** Grim Dawn's and Neon Abyss's recommended settings now put the game's own log into the next Send Log, so their stops can be found. They fix nothing yet.

## LiveContainer 3.8.14: the built-in JIT helper works again (from a pull request)

LiveContainer 3.8.14 changed how it hands a guest app its helper. 0.1.712 did not recognise the new way, so inside LiveContainer the built-in JIT helper and the helper memory stayed off ("not-ready: noHook" in the log). BCD now sees the prepared helper. LiveContainer's Helper Process Support, a full-screen launch and the install-time preparation are still required. (pull request #74)

## Live logs over Wi-Fi (from a pull request, off by default)

**Settings › Logs › Live logs** shows the log of the running session on a computer on the same Wi-Fi, as it is written, for example in a browser. (pull request #71)

- Only devices on the same Wi-Fi network can connect, and at most four at a time.
- The address carries a secret key. **Copy live log URL** copies the address with the key in it. The key changes each time you turn live logs on and each time BCD starts. Without the key the log is refused.
- The log holds your account names and folder paths. Turn this on only on a Wi-Fi you trust. On a café's or a hotel's Wi-Fi, other people on that network could try to connect, and the key is what keeps them out.

## Mouse-look: see the game's own cursor in its menus (new, off unless set)

With Mouse-look as the finger mode your finger turns the camera, and BCD drew no cursor, so a game's menus had no visible pointer. In **Settings › All settings**, `env.MADEIRA_RELATIVE_CURSOR` (Mouse-look: show the game's cursor in its menus) changes that:
- the game's own cursor is shown while the game shows it, in its menus;
- it is hidden while the game hides it, in play.

Some things stay the same:
- A tap still does not click in Mouse-look. Use the on-screen buttons, or switch to Trackpad to press a menu item.
- It works for games started directly, not in a Windows desktop or BCD Dock session.
- Restart BCD after you change it.

## Other fixes and new switches

- **Settings no longer lose bcd.cfg over one character:**
  - **The fault:** one character in bcd.cfg that is not UTF-8 (a comment saved by an editor on a PC, for example) made Settings show no keys. The next change in Settings then rewrote the file with only that one key, and every other setting was gone.
  - **What changed:** Settings now reads such a file and writes every other line back as it was. A file that exists but cannot be read is left alone, not rewritten.
- **Videos in 32-bit games** (and in 64-bit games only with `env.MADEIRA_WIN64_FRESH = 1`): three fixes in Windows' media libraries.
  - A video whose frames the GPU has no format for no longer loses its video output, which left the video without a single frame. Its frames now come through ordinary memory.
  - The Windows Media reader no longer crashes after it was refused a compressed stream (the movie player of KiriKiri games, for example).
  - Copying a frame into a Direct3D 9 surface no longer waits for the GPU to read that surface back first.
- **Direct3D 11 games that keep a CPU core busy asking the GPU "done yet?"** (new, off unless set):
  - **The problem:** some games ask whether the GPU has finished in a tight loop, 100,000 to 15 million times a second. BCD's logs show it in 21 games, such as Schedule I, Palworld and Rocket League.
  - **The switch:** with `env.MADEIRA_D3D11_QUERY_PARK = 1` such a burst waits for the GPU's signal, at most 1 ms each time, instead of spinning. A single question never waits.
  - **Where it works:** 32-bit games, and 64-bit games with `env.MADEIRA_D3D11_SRC = 1` or `env.MADEIRA_DXMT_FRESH = 1`. The default 64-bit Direct3D 11 layer does not have it.
- **Less work for the x86 translator when a game unmaps streamed data** (new, off unless set):
  - **The problem:** when a game unmaps a file view that never held code, the translator still locked and searched its translated code for that range. Some games do this tens of thousands of times in a session (Red Dead Redemption 2, GTA IV and V, Fallout 4).
  - **The switch:** `env.MADEIRA_FEX_SECTION_SKIP = 1` skips that search for such a view.

## Auto-tune

11 rules are new and 7 changed. Each has a log it was made from.

- **New fixes it can try:**
  - a Direct3D 11 game whose GPU hung while it drew gets the fresh Direct3D 11 set (not the heavy games, see above);
  - Hitman: Blood Money's start-up stop gets the instruction check;
  - an Epic game that ended in a fault in Epic's online services, and had not started through BCD's sign-in helper, gets the helper;
  - a 32-bit program whose oversized data section took the code memory's execute right behind it gets that protection kept inside the module.
- **Answers that say what to do:**
  - a stop on GOG Galaxy's online library: the line that switches it off;
  - the copy-protection service stop (code 49 after the lost call, and code 55 after about 100 seconds): what is known and that it does not happen in every start;
  - a game that waits for an NVIDIA card's answer that never comes: send the log;
  - a device whose address space is too small for the emulator itself: the increased memory limit (GetMoreRam with SideStore or LiveContainer, or a paid developer account), or that the device is too small;
  - Cyberpunk 2077's blend stop and Isaac's memory outside its part: update BCD.
- **Narrowed:**
  - Unity games are no longer offered BCD's OpenGL;
  - a game that ran out of memory is no longer told its Steam files are missing;
  - the emulator's own address-space stop is no longer counted as a runtime fault;
  - the fixed-address program stop now gives the advice above instead of "Update BCD".

## Recommended settings

The list went from 96 to 98: 6 games are new and 11 changed.

- **New:**
  - Dead Space 2
  - Crysis
  - Kingdom Come: Deliverance
  - Grim Dawn
  - Little Nightmares Enhanced Edition
  - Neon Abyss
- **Updated:**
  - Resident Evil 7 biohazard
  - Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter
  - FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles
  - MudRunner
  - Stardew Valley
  - Hitman: Blood Money
  - S.T.A.L.K.E.R. (X-Ray engine games)
  - The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth (notes only)
  - Borderlands 2
  - Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
  - FINAL FANTASY XIII

## The November 2026 Steam client in BCD Dock, and why you don't need Steam for Windows to play (experimental)

Nothing in this part changed since 0.1.712. It is here again for everyone who skipped that release.

### What BCD Dock is
- BCD Dock starts your Steam games through **Valve's own Steam client library** (`steamclient64.dll`, the file the full Steam app for Windows also uses). It runs inside BCD without Steam's window, its web browser (Chromium) and its library.
- BCD Dock signs in with your own Steam sign-in. Valve's client then does what a game needs from Steam, as it does on a PC:
  - the online sign-in and the check that you own the game;
  - the game's Steam calls and any Steam DRM the game carries;
  - the per-account programs some games need (BCD Dock asks the client to prepare them before the start);
  - signing in offline;
  - Friends in games, when you turn them on in **Settings › Accounts › Steam**.
- BCD Dock is not a Steam emulator and bypasses nothing. Without Valve's sign-in and licence answer, a game does not start.

### What the November 2026 client adds
- **Settings › BCD Dock › Steam client** offers three builds of Valve's client:
  - **Jan 2026**, the default;
  - **Sep 2026**: for games that ask for a newer Steam interface than January's has, such as Grim Dawn, Hades II and Enshrouded. No Friends;
  - **Nov 2026**: the client Valve published on 13 November 2026.
- **Newer Steam interfaces.** Nov 2026 has five interfaces that the January client lacks: `SteamUser024`, `SteamInput007`, `SteamNetworkingSockets013`, `SteamGameServer016` and `SteamMatchMakingServers003`. A game built with a newer Steam library can stop at its start with "Missing interface adapter", with "No SteamUtils011" or with a "Steam is not running" box. Nov 2026 has the newer interfaces such a game asks for. A game may still ask for something newer than Valve's client of 13 November has.
- **Friends** work with Nov 2026, as with Jan 2026. Sep 2026 has none.
- **BCD's suggestions** name Nov 2026 when a game stops because its Steam library is newer than the client (for `SteamUtils011`, Sep 2026 has the interface too).
- **Switching** moves your installed games, saves and settings to the chosen client, and you can switch back at any time. The old client's folder is renamed and kept. Nothing is deleted.
- **A build BCD Dock does not know is refused before sign-in** with report code 30, not guessed at. BCD Dock checks the exact client file and the exact calls it makes into it, build by build. Valve moved four of the client's internal calls (the two ownership questions and the two offline sign-in calls) by one slot in this build, so each build has its own table.
- **Tried so far, on one iPhone:**
  - the switch to Nov 2026 and back;
  - games started through BCD Dock;
  - a game whose per-account program Steam prepares;
  - an offline start;
  - Friends;
  - a game that stopped on a missing Steam interface.
- **January 2026 stays the default.** Nov 2026 is less tested. Choose it when a game needs it. If a game no longer starts with it, switch back.

### Why you don't need Steam for Windows to play
- **The game already talks to Valve's real client.** Sign-in, ownership, Steam's calls, per-account programs, offline play and Friends all go through the same client library that BCD Dock runs. The full Steam app adds a window around that library. A game does not need the window.
- **Memory.** Steam's window is a web browser. On the one iPhone tried, it held:
  - 2.3 to 3.4 GB of the 8 GB iOS gives BCD;
  - much of BCD's address space;
  - a JIT pool of up to 1.1 GB for its own code.

  Heavy games need all of that for themselves. Through BCD Dock they get it.
- **Each game's own BCD settings.** Through BCD Dock every game starts with its recommended settings and the ones you set on its page. A game started from Steam for Windows runs inside Steam's session, with that session's settings. X-Plane 12, started that way, found no Vulkan driver and quit after nine seconds.
- **BCD's own library covers the rest:** downloads and updates, DLC you own, beta versions, Workshop items, Steam Cloud saves and Launch options.

### When Steam for Windows can still help
These are things BCD itself does not do:
- buying games or DLC in the Steam store;
- Steam's own settings and account pages, and Steam's community pages;
- your friends list and chat outside a game (BCD offers Friends in a game);
- your achievements: BCD does not show them;
- updating a game that Valve's client installed in its own library folder. BCD lists and starts such a game but does not update it.

Steam's app on your phone, or Steam's website, can do most of these too. Steam for Windows (experimental, off unless you turn it on in **Settings › BCD Dock › Steam for Windows**) is for those things, not for playing games.

## Known issues

- **Cyberpunk 2077:** past the blend stop, the next limit is likely memory. In the logs it reached 7.4 to 7.8 GB of the 8 GB limit within two minutes.
- **Steam Cloud for games with automatic cloud saves in their own folders** (Cult of the Lamb, for example): not solved. A log helps.
- **Copy-protected Steam games through BCD Dock** can still fail with code 49 or 55 in some starts of BCD. Quitting BCD completely and starting again helps in many cases.

Install help, game reports and ideas: the BCD-Games Discord is open, https://discord.gg/43TmupTVug

versions.localizedDescription:
## ✨ 主要更新

### 片段跳过
- 使用上游 BilibiliSponsorBlock 的片段数据。
- 支持按分类设置总是跳过、每次播放跳过一次、手动跳过、仅显示或禁用。
- 优化半屏、横屏全屏及竖屏播放器适配。
- 优化手动拖动进度后的跳过恢复逻辑。
- 自动跳过后显示提示，支持点击撤销。
- 在进度条中显示片段标记，弹出控制条的标记随控制条显示和收起。

### 片段提交
- 新增参考 PiliPlus 交互设计的片段提交面板。
- 支持添加多个片段、取当前播放时间、手动编辑时间、选择分类与动作、预览及确认提交。
- 提交按钮随播放器控制菜单显示和收起，减少对视频画面的遮挡。

### 设置与更新
- 优化设置入口、字体、颜色、间距及开关布局。
- 空降助手入口仅显示在主设置页面顶部。
- 新增 GitHub 稳定发行版更新提醒，支持手动检查。
- 保留跳过次数、节省时间统计及个人提交身份。
- 项目链接统一显示为“本项目地址”和“上游地址”。

## 📦 安装方式

1. 下载 `BiliSponsorBlock-v2.0.0.dylib`。
2. 移除旧版插件注入项，只保留本版本。
3. 沿用原来的注入、重签名和安装方式。
4. 重启 App，在「设置 → 空降助手 → 版本号」确认显示 `2.0.0`。

或自签安装bili-9.10.0-BiliSponsorBlock.V2.0.0.ipa

升级无需清除 App 数据。完整发行包内附安装说明及 SHA-256 校验信息。

## 📱 适配说明

- 架构：ARM64
- 最低系统：iOS 15.0
- 主要适配版本：哔哩哔哩 iOS 9.0.0及以后；哔哩哔哩国际版 v6.3.0及以后（原白哔哩不支持）

静音和整片标记可提交，当前版本不自动执行静音或整片拦截。

## 🙏 致谢

- [BilibiliSponsorBlock](https://github.com/hanydd/BilibiliSponsorBlock)：上游项目与片段数据服务。
- [PiliPlus](https://github.com/bggRGjQaUbCoE/PiliPlus)：空降助手交互与提交方案参考。

---

## New Features

- iPhone Duo interface
  - Sidebar aligned with iOS standard
  - Status bar handling
  - New compact sidebar layout for different functions
  - Swipe left/right at bottom of screen to switch tabs even with sidebar layout
- AyaseQuart archive support
- Rewrite of tree comment tracking
  - For "new posts inserted at bottom" mode (default)
  - Goal is that posts are never inserted into existing/scrolled-past trees
  - Add the parent as a dimmed context in the inserted subtrees
- Customizable filter highlight color
  - Matched text is highlighted specifically
- Text highlighting combines across multiple sources

## General Improvements

- Added video gestures and controls to soundposts
- Better handling of Reddit login firewall
  - Added alternative API to /morechildren
- Added haptic feedback in a lot of places
- Tweaks to the luck algorithm
- Show usernames as Reddit quotelinks instead of identifiers (not relevant)
- Long-press "#" button in search page to open a board/thread/comment by URL
- Use alternative FoolFuuka search page to bypass server-side block
- Rewrite archive handling
  - Goal is that thread doesn't get stuck in archived mode
- Optimized new tab board picker
  - If closed without picking a board, the new tab will be closed too
  - Appears instantly without flash of empty catalog
- Added a long-press menu to cross-thread quotelinks
- Drag to reorder saved threads in drawer (when sorting by order added)

## Tweaks

- Board switcher optimizations
- Smarter selection of next tab after closing a tab
- Format boards according to site in error messages
- Optimized xenforo-based forum loading performance
- Hero animation from rich link thumbnails
- "hn" shortcut for Hacker News in board switcher
- Optimized shorter thread indicator menu error messages
- Don't insert (OP) quotelink on top level Reddit comments
- Try to preserve Reddit title when thread is deleted
- Rewrote search query pagination interface
- Centered active thread in catalog instead of aligning to bottom
- New style for selected threads to match tabs
- Better support for cyclic/infinite threads on dvach and 8chan
- Highlight currently selected board in board switcher

## Bugfixes

- Scrolling to top when tapping buttons at top of screen (iPad, iPhone Duo)
- Timeout when trying to register with Firebase notifications
- Gray screen flash in captcha popup
- False-positive compatibility error due to cached GREASE TLS algorithms
- Broken videos when swiping quickly on Reddit
- Some boards on 8chan tried to post 5 images per post instead of 3
- Potential fixes for "App not responding" on Android
- (Dead) seen in quotelinks in search results
- (OP) not seen in quotelink search results
- Try to avoid stale site data when files per post changes
- Newly discovered pages were not marked as unread
- Missing handling for loading a forum post from an unloaded page
- Attachment preloading errors popped up for background threads
- Reloading threads could get stuck if switching tab during load
- Post scroll position was not optimal when loading an earlier forum page
- Poor handling of non-existent subreddits
- Cancelling one http/2 request could break the others on the same connection
- Reddit crossposts with quotes had broken OPs
- Cloudflare could popup from reply box image suggestion requests
- Edited posts not properly recognized as changed
- Reddit threads could be come corrupted on boards with very high identifier values
- Error loading reddit children could cause an improper alert popup
- Replies count/button not shown in split tree scenario
- Transient message popups had no height cap
- Thread auto-update would try to extend deep comment chains
  - Since this is now heavily restricted by Reddit, just refresh the thread root
- new/unseen label always shown on unloaded comments on Reddit
- Post highlighting transitioned at end of refresh instead of at beginning
- Comment loading errors were not dismissible by tapping in the background
- Posting on holotower gave an error message since PHP update
- gelbooru image urls could not be loaded due to their hotlink protection
- Reddit username /u/ prefix handling was not consistent
- Non-favourited subreddits would disappear after 3 days
- Many search query fields would not enable the search button when changing them
- OP post always grew in height on load when discovering how many replies it had
- Long search filters got cut off in the search history
- Thread had to reload when switching between one/two pane layout
- Rich links could get cut off when width was limited
- QUIC and HTTP/3 crash fixes
- Poor handling of some weird dvach sticky threads
- Precaching attempted to download deleted files
- Reordering watched threads from drawer broke in reverse-sort order

versions.localizedDescription:
## English

**This release fixes the v1.0 shell, which could not be packaged by anyone.** If you downloaded `D2RMobile-shell.ipa` from v1.0, replace it with the one on this page and update the repository to this version.

### What was wrong in v1.0

Packaging with the v1.0 shell and the public repository went through every step and then stopped at the final check with:

```
[x] 有 1 项没做出来：dm/bootlist.tsv
```

(1 item was not produced: `dm/bootlist.tsv`.) The v1.0 shell listed a startup prefetch list among the things the tool must add, but the public repository deliberately does not carry that list, so the tool could never produce it. The shell had been built in a working directory that still held an old copy of the list, and our pre-release check ran in the same directory, so it did not catch the mismatch. Thanks to the reporter of issue #1 for the precise diagnosis.

### What changed

- The shell is now built from the public tree in a fresh working directory; it no longer asks for the prefetch list.
- When the public tree has no prefetch list, the rewrite step now also removes any old copy left in the build output directory.
- If the tool still finds an item it could not produce, the error now says the shell and the tool are from different versions and what to do.
- Before publishing, we now package once with exactly what you get: the shell to be published, the tree to be pushed, and an empty working directory. The shell is published only if that writes an install package. This release passed that check.

### Assets

- `D2RMobile-shell.ipa`: the shell (for both iPhone and iPad). Its checksum is in `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Use it with the source of **this version**.

### Not verified (stated plainly)

- This shell file has not been run on a device. The package made from it was written successfully on a Mac; it has not been signed and installed on a phone.
- Everything listed as not verified in v1.0 still applies: sideloading tools (Sideloadly, AltStore, ...), devices with 6 GB or 8 GB of RAM, A16 or older chips, `.nsp` game packages, packaging on Linux.

---

## 中文

**这一版修正 v1.0 的壳：它对所有人都做不出安装包。** 如果你下载过 v1.0 的 `D2RMobile-shell.ipa`，请换成本页的这一份，并把仓库更新到这一版。

### v1.0 的问题

用 v1.0 的壳加公开仓库做包，各步都能走完，最后核对时停在：

```
[x] 有 1 项没做出来：dm/bootlist.tsv
```

v1.0 的壳把一份启动预取清单列在「工具要补进去的东西」里，而公开仓库有意不带这份清单，工具永远做不出它。出壳用的工作目录里留着这份清单的旧文件，我们发布前的检查又是在同一个目录里做的，所以没有发现两边对不上。感谢 Issue #1 的报告者给出了准确的定位。

### 改了什么

- 壳改为在全新的工作目录里从公开的代码出，不再要求预取清单。
- 公开的代码没有预取清单时，改写这一步会把产物目录里以前留下的旧清单一并清掉。
- 工具若仍发现有东西没做出来，报错会直说是壳与工具不是同一版，以及该怎么办。
- 发布前新增一道检查：用你拿到的那一套——待发布的壳、待推送的代码、空的工作目录——原样做一次包，写出安装包才发布。这一版通过了这道检查。

### 附件

- `D2RMobile-shell.ipa`：壳（同时面向 iPhone 与 iPad），校验值见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。请与**这一版**的源码一起用。

### 没验过的（直说）

- 这份壳文件本身没上过真机。用它做出的安装包在 Mac 上成功写出，还没有签名装到手机上。
- v1.0 里列的没验项仍然成立：自签工具（Sideloadly、AltStore 等）、6 GB / 8 GB 内存的机型、A16 及更早的芯片、`.nsp` 格式的游戏包、在 Linux 上做包。

apps.name: DukeX
apps.subtitle: Original Xbox emulation for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: DukeX is an experimental iOS-focused frontend for xemu. It embeds the xemu core in a native Swift shell and presents the Vulkan renderer through MoltenVK and native Metal.

versions.localizedDescription:
# DukeX v1.0.2 - Expanding the Xbox Experience

DukeX v1.0.2 is our biggest step yet toward preserving the full original Xbox
experience, not just the games. This release introduces the first native macOS
build, expands XB.Live integration, and brings richer community features to both
iOS and macOS.

## What's New

- Native macOS release: DukeX is now available as a Mac Catalyst desktop build
  packaged with a nested Xemu fork, pairing desktop Xemu compatibility with the
  DukeX interface.
- XB.Live Rich Presence and playtime tracking: friends can see what you are
  playing while DukeX tracks supported playtime sessions.
- XB.Live messaging: threaded conversations, friend messaging, unread
  indicators, supported game invites, and existing Xbox inbox support now live
  inside DukeX.
- XB.Live social expansion: friend requests, friend management, online presence,
  and deeper community integration are available from the Profile experience.
- Activity Feed: XB.Live news, friend online status, friend achievement unlocks,
  and community updates now appear in a continuously refreshed timeline.
- Controller Landscape Mode: on iOS, compatible controllers can switch DukeX
  into a controller-first browsing and launch experience.
- Expanded AirPlay and external display support: big-screen play is more
  reliable across supported display configurations.

## Improvements

- Improved achievements with Games, Apps, and Cores grouping plus updated
  artwork handling for XB.Live Core, DukeX Core, and special test titles.
- Improved game tile spacing and cover handling across iOS and macOS.
- Improved XB.Live cloud-save sync metadata with console identity v2,
  content-hash dedupe, and server-assisted cross-console restore handling.
- Fixed achievement progress rounding so time-based achievements do not show
  100% before they are actually complete.

## Availability

- iOS: install `DukeX.v1.0.2.ipa` through StikStore, SideStore, or another
  supported sideloading workflow.
- macOS: install `DukeX.macOS.v1.0.2.dmg` by dragging DukeX to Applications.
- Hardware requirements on iOS remain Apple A14 Bionic or Apple M1 hardware or
  newer.
- iOS 16.0 or later is supported, with iOS 16 support remaining experimental.

## Important

DukeX does not include Xbox system files, game images, BIOS files, copyrighted
content, signing certificates, or user games. Users must provide their own
legally obtained files. DukeX is intended for legitimate emulation,
preservation, testing, and personal library use.

# Dylix 1.1.4（284）

1. 优化上下文与缓存：保留稳定请求前缀，完善缓存用量统计和长会话上下文处理，减少重复读取与循环执行。
2. 完善会话交互：区分空消息续接与普通发送，支持任务执行中补充或修正消息，改进中断后的任务衔接。
3. 修复项目关联：普通聊天、头文件导出和分享文件会话关联项目时继续使用原会话，保留聊天、附件与任务记录。
4. 完善协议适配：调整 Anthropic 缓存标记及流式用量处理，保留原始会话证据，区分本地估算与服务商计费用量。
5. 更新构建与启动配置：使用 Xcode 自带 iOS 27.2 SDK，修复新 SDK 下的场景启动配置，统一版本为 1.1.4（284）。

配套 FLEX 插件版本保持 1.0.3。开源版不包含私有提示词上传服务、后端或个人凭据。

验证范围与结果见 [1.1.4 发布验证](RELEASE_1.1.4_VALIDATION.md)。IPA 为待证书重签名安装包。

apps.name: Fathom
apps.subtitle: x86-64 PC emulator for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
An x86-64 PC emulator for iOS. Fathom runs x86-64 Linux programs on an iPhone or iPad by translating them to ARM64 as they execute, using FEXCore - the dynamic recompiler behind FEX-Emu - with a native SwiftUI front end.

Import a statically linked x86-64 Linux executable, open it, press Run. Fathom maps it into a guest address space, hands its instructions to FEXCore's JIT, answers its Linux syscalls, and shows you its output.

JIT requires StikDebug to attach to the process and service the executable-memory traps; Fathom asks for this automatically on launch when it is missing.

Please note: only statically linked, position-independent executables (-static-pie) run today. Dynamically linked binaries and 32-bit x86 are not supported yet, and threads are not implemented, so a guest runs single-threaded.

versions.localizedDescription:
An x86-64 PC emulator for iOS, running guest code on FEXCore.

2048 and tic tac toe both run. Add them from the Library tab and play with the on-screen arrow keys.

**Downloads**
- `Fathom.ipa` - the app, unsigned, for sideloading. Needs StikDebug attached for JIT.
- `tictactoe` - arrows move, Enter places, against a minimax bot that cannot be beaten.
- `play2048` - arrows slide the board.

Copy the two game binaries into Fathom's Programs folder, or import them from the Library tab.

apps.name: Ghost Remote
apps.subtitle: Open terminals on your other iGhostVT devices
apps.localizedDescription: Ghost Remote opens terminals on your iPhone, iPad or Mac running iGhostVT, from an iPhone or iPad without custom firmware. Turn on remote access on the device running iGhostVT, then tap + in Ghost Remote and pair with the six-digit code it shows. Terminals open over your local network, or from anywhere through a relay you run yourself.

versions.localizedDescription:
iGhostVT 1.6.41 includes the MCP server helper in Mac self-update signature checks and in the Mac install and update scripts; it connects to devices on any 1.6 release.

- Mac self-updates checked the Developer ID team signature of `ighostvtd`, `ighostvtd-io`, `ighostvtd-remote` and `ighostvt-cli`, but omitted `ighostvt-mcp`. The updater now verifies `ighostvt-mcp` on its own alongside the other bundled helpers before installing an update.
- `Scripts/mac-update-from-github.sh` now re-signs and stops `ighostvt-mcp` when replacing an installed Mac bundle, and `Scripts/mac-install.sh` stops `ighostvt-mcp` alongside the other helpers during an in-place Mac upgrade.

Choose `iphoneos-arm64e` for roothide, `iphoneos-arm64` for a rootless bootstrap, `iGhostVT-1.6.41-macos-notarized.zip` for a Mac — it is signed and notarized, so it opens without clearing quarantine, and updates itself — or `GhostRemote-1.6.41.ipa` for an iPhone or iPad without custom firmware, which your sideloading app signs as it installs it. To run the relay, use the attached `compose.yml`; the image is `ghcr.io/owngoal-dev/ighostvt-relay`, and the digest is in `relay-image.txt`. SHA-256 sums are in `SHA256SUMS`, and the Mac app's in `SHA256SUMS.macos`.

versions.localizedDescription:
# 全局高刷 1.1.2（26.11.20）

本版本提供正式版通用未签名 IPA，可通过牛蛙助手、AltStore、Sideloadly 等工具自行签名安装。

构建号：`2026112101`

IPA 文件：`GlobalRefresh_1.1.2_2026112101_unsigned.ipa`

SHA-256：`776b590301dc70314323d8f5b0d3055d6d04e7b093b184d8c8d05eb363537e74`

## 重新打包说明（26.11.21）

构建号更新为 `2026112101`，恢复 iPhone 和 iPad 的图标文件索引，解决部分签名工具导入 IPA 后不显示应用图标的问题。主包 `Info.plist` 仍为 XML；程序、悬浮窗逻辑及图标资源均未改动。

遇到签名工具内图标空白的用户，请下载新版附件后重新导入。已正常安装使用的用户无需仅为此重新安装。

## 更新内容

- \* 修复 iOS 16 及以上悬浮窗关闭按钮偶尔重新出现的问题（即屏幕中间的水滴图标）
- \* 修复部分 iOS 15 设备无法启动悬浮窗的问题，恢复原生启动流程
- 优化画中画并存，增加当前会话内的检查和有限补试；系统暂时挂起悬浮窗时，不再误判为关闭
- 默认 VideoCall 与仅 PiP 保活组合的内容更新由 60fps 调整为 30fps，减少后台刷新开销
- 优化小屏首页布局，避免启动按钮被底栏遮挡
- 新增当前 App 的运存和线程数显示
- 修复线程统计资源未释放、离开帧率演示页后刷新驱动未清理的问题；PlayerLayer 兼容方案改为在后台准备视频素材，避免阻塞界面
- 支持导出和分享诊断日志；减少日志重复写盘，覆盖更新后保留已有退出记录和系统诊断
- 优化快捷指令链接识别，保留原有入口；修复切换更新渠道时可能显示旧结果的问题，支持检测同版本的新构建

## 来源与署名

感谢 CaiWanFeng 提供原始 PiP 示例。本项目由 Yoroin 在此基础上继续开发和维护。

原 Demo 项目：[CaiWanFeng/PiP](https://github.com/CaiWanFeng/PiP)

当前项目：[Yoroin/GlobalRefresh-PiP](https://github.com/Yoroin/GlobalRefresh-PiP)

基于本项目继续开发或分发时，请保留原作者、后续维护者及对应项目地址，并注明代码来源。

## 自签说明

此 IPA 不绑定个人证书，主程序和内嵌框架均未签名，也不含 `embedded.mobileprovision` 或 `_CodeSignature`。安装前请使用自己的 Apple ID 或证书签名。

apps.name: Husk
apps.subtitle: Android app launcher for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Run Android apps on iOS: drop in an APK, tap it, and the Android app opens full-screen on a QEMU guest with hardware-accelerated display and audio. Needs JIT plus a debugger attached at runtime, so it requires a sideloading setup that can provide get-task-allow rather than a plain re-sign.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new?

3.4 is a compatibility release. About 97% of the 472 F-Droid apps we test now run, up from 85%. On the 169 Play Store apps we test, about 90% run, not counting apps with anti-tamper or fraud protection, which Husk doesn't try to bypass. All of these numbers are from testing on a Mac.

### More Android apps
- Microsoft Word opens (Excel and PowerPoint share its libraries)
- Slack, Gmail, Teams, Deezer, Flipboard and Picsart get past the crashes that stopped them
- More engines and frameworks start: React Native's new architecture, Qt 6 / QML, and apps using JavaScriptCore
- libGDX and other OpenGL apps draw again (3.3 broke these)
- Apps that keep secrets in Android's secure key store work better
- Apps with big bundled databases open
- UPnP and network discovery apps can start
- Apps that declare their launch screen in a split APK can start

### Looks better
- Rounded buttons are proper pills instead of ellipses
- Toolbars, window backgrounds and more color formats behave like they do on a phone

### Less "out of memory"
- Fewer `OutOfMemoryError: pthread_create` crashes on installs without extended address space
- Unity games use less address space on sideloaded installs, and keep their frame rate up
- New in Settings -> Performance: see whether Increased Memory Limit and Extended Address Space are on for your install

### Also
- Japanese, thanks to @Yuki-1018
- Fixed Husk crashing when importing a `.p12`, or at launch with one saved on iOS 27 (#220)
- The Remove and Uninstall dialogs open next to their buttons on iPad (#218)
- Winlator's Settings page no longer crashes
- Husk builds with Xcode 27 and the iOS 27 SDK

## Known Issues
- Without JIT, Minecraft, some Flutter apps and some LÖVE games can fail. Use StikJIT for those for now
- Browsers (Firefox, Brave, Opera) don't run yet because they need separate helper processes
- Husk's Java runtime still has no garbage collector, so big apps can run out of memory in long sessions (#191)
- Touch doesn't work yet in Godot 3 games (#200)
- Apps with anti-tamper still won't run, and neither will apps that need Google Play services or a Google account
- Winlator containers don't run
- Full Android is still slow. Use the translation layer for games

## Thanks
Thanks to @BartolomeoRusso9, @Dey410 and @Yuki-1018 for their pull requests, and to everyone who sent logs. Crash reports are what made this release possible ❤️

## Links
- Website: https://itslevii.dev

apps.name: iBuilder
apps.subtitle: Switch games, built on your iPhone
apps.localizedDescription:
iBuilder turns a Switch game dump you own into a native iOS build on the iPhone itself: extract, rewrite, translate the shaders, sign and play. Experimental: results differ per game.

No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use it only with your own games and the prod.keys of your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

versions.localizedDescription:
> [!WARNING]
> No game, firmware or key is included or downloaded. Use iBuilder only with games you own and the `prod.keys` dumped from your own console. Not affiliated with Nintendo or Apple.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Every game rebuilds its shaders once** after this update: the shader chain moves to `6c53446391cc` (nxnative 033793f0), and a library is named by its chain. iOS's Metal shader cache also starts empty once, so the first play of each game stutters more.

**New**
- **Shader chain 6c53446391cc**, nxnative's current one: 37 upstream translator and host changes, including the Switch 2 mesh/task fixes. The Rust build gives the same library bytes as upstream (5,348 Ocarina shaders compared).
- **More games found compatible**: shader readers for EA (FIFA 18: 0 → 330 shaders), CRI CPK, Diablo III, Unreal IoStore and encrypted paks, Smash Bros. Ultimate, Trinity (stored files), Frostbite (stored data), TT Games DAT, Larian LSPK, Blizzard CASC, Camelot CRA, PDAT, Rockstar RPF6, REDengine, RAGE WAD, NXCX, Telltale, GIANTS SHARC, Virtuos VBF, UbiArt IPK v5, MT Framework ARC v9. OpenGL and Vulkan games get their shaders too (glslang is now in the app; the engine compiles them on the phone).
- **Build screen: Mode Cool / Fast** in place of Close. Cool (default) keeps the app smooth and the phone cooler; Fast builds at full speed, hotter. A running build follows a change.
- **Faster builds**: a per-shader stream instead of batches; a rebuild after an update or a DLC reuses the shaders that did not change; a build resumed after iOS ended the app keeps half its threads instead of one. The build log now shows where the time went (translator, SPIRV-Cross, cores busy, translator GC).
- **Settings**: *Check the shader cache* (on: a game iOS's cache forgot after a reboot or an iOS update is prepared again), *Faster shader preparation* (off: the device's full compiler concurrency when cool or charging), *Optimized translator (experimental)* (off: smaller shaders, may show graphics errors).
- Shader libraries compiled for size (`optimizationLevel = Size`, the engine and the preparation alike).

**Known limits**
- Still refused: Oodle-compressed shaders (Octopath Traveler 0, FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE, Yoshi and the Mysterious Book, Mario & Luigi: Brothership, EA SPORTS FC 27, LEGO Star Wars base game, Pokémon Legends: Z-A), XNB LZX, Next Level Games archives; Camelot games need a capture of their file-table NRO.
- The new readers are checked against nxnative on synthetic games, not on every real game; FIFA 18 is split and translated, not yet played. Nothing in this release has been played on an iPhone before publishing.

**Install**: SideStore source `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Absenti/iBuilder/main/apps.json`, or the `.ipa` below. Bundle id `dev.ibuilder.app`, iOS 26+, iPhone 12 or later. Assets: the `.ipa`, its `.sha256`, and `.ipa.verify.tar.gz` (the verifier that checked it: 261 checks passed).

apps.name: iDeck
apps.subtitle: Steam Big Picture on iPhone and iPad
apps.localizedDescription: Run Valve’s Steam client in Big Picture and compatible Windows PC games locally on iPhone and iPad through Madeira, Wine, FEX and Metal. Experimental; requires iOS 26+, JIT, and user-provided Steam files.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Steam64 setup, one step at a time

**Experimental prerelease · Build145 · Known issue: Steam can freeze after the third game exit. This update improves setup; it does not fix that stability issue.**

## What’s new

- **Install Steam64 in the launcher:** downloads the matched Steam/browser packages from Valve over HTTPS, verifies sizes/SHA-256 and installs with rollback. Cancel/retry, Verify/Repair and Return to previous environment are available.
- **Four clear actions:** Install Steam → Connect LocalDevVPN → Pair this device → Enable JIT. Runtime preparation is automatic, signing/address checks remain mandatory, completed steps are checked/skipped and the view follows the next action.
- **Pair in iDeck:** starts the existing on-device pairing immediately with live instructions/PIN, without hunting through JIT settings. iOS calls the pairing host Madeira. Advanced methods/import/recovery/account/auto-start settings are collapsed.
- **Data stays yours:** the original environment remains intact; no auth cache, game or save is silently transferred. Use Valve’s own login and Steam Guard yourself.

## Install and test

Download `iDeck-0.1.3-alpha.6-build145.ipa` and `SHA256SUMS`, verify the hash, then sign/sideload using your own coherent development main/helper profiles. Keep `MadeiraJITHelper.appex` and debugging permission; signing alone does not activate JIT. Back up saves and keep the same app identity when upgrading—uninstalling can erase local data.

Open iDeck and follow the highlighted setup step; fully close/reopen when prompted after installing Steam64. For on-device pairing use iOS27; iOS26 offers pairing-file import. Activate JIT again for each new app process.

The IPA includes the local runtime and pinned source-built open support components, **no Valve Steam client/libcef, games, accounts, maintainer profile or pairing file**. The installer acquires the client from Valve. Both source companions, relink, license/audit and inventory/checksum assets accompany this release.

## What was verified

The user reports Build144 installation can complete. Build145 passed host ordering/skip/restart/signing/VA checks, installer/rollback/privacy regressions, existing JIT integration checks and full Xcode compilation. Its separate Fresh Test version was development-signed, installed/read back and opened on an iPhone15ProMax; original iDeck was preserved. The public ad-hoc IPA was audited (1480files, no findings), and its105-input relink ran with all30TEXT section hashes matching.

The complete revised145 first-run UI, another-device sideload/JIT, new Steam login and repeated gameplay have **not** received a new acceptance result; the public IPA was not installed again after ad-hoc packaging. iPad, Bluetooth and arbitrary games are not validated by this release. Full independent-machine/offline runtime rebuilding is not claimed.

## Limits that still matter

- **Third game return may freeze Steam.** Report the first failing stage and game-cycle count.
- Steam64 does **not** enlarge the device’s virtual address space. Unsupported layouts can still fail;32-bit games/helpers may still hit separate limits. Guards remain enabled.
- The compatibility snapshot is **Steam manifest1769025840 (January22,2026), CEF126**, held to its matched components. It is not the latest Steam/Chromium and has security/compatibility limitations; future snapshots need fresh review.
- Game support remains limited. No DRM, authentication or anti-cheat bypass is provided. Never post credentials, Steam Guard data, pairing files, profiles or raw personal logs.

See [the four-step guide](https://github.com/kuscholar/iDeck/blob/v0.1.3-alpha.6/docs/STEAM64_SETUP.md), [Build145 evidence](https://github.com/kuscholar/iDeck/blob/v0.1.3-alpha.6/docs/release/BUILD145_RESULTS.md) and the bilingual README.

## iPadn 2.3.5

**目录 / Contents**：[简体中文](#-核心修复与优化) · [TestFlight 说明与免责](#-testflight-实验性说明与免责声明) · [English](#english) · [TestFlight Notice](#testflight-experimental-notice--disclaimer)

本次为 **v2.3.5** 稳定性修复与体验升级版：根治 **iOS 16.0–16.2 强链接符号闪退**、**iOS 27.2 beta 2 历史版本加载闪退** 与 **iPadOS 全屏/专业模式导航栏异常**；**TestFlight 现支持切换下载 Apple TV 等多平台测试包**并统一展示单色客户端标识，同时修复大型/多变体游戏误报「产物校验失败，已清理」及详情页顶部虚化异常；在「设置 › 外观与图标」开放**自定义全部 177 个 Apple 商店地区**（支持搜索筛选、勾选、拖拽排序与国旗展示）；并修复 FairPlay 高熵插件误拒、登录 `5020`/2FA 提示、未购免费应用首次获取旧版报错与「应用包」批量导入打断问题。安装包均未签名，请使用自用签名工具签名后安装。

### 🔧 核心修复与优化

- **修复 iOS 16/27 闪退与 iPadOS 专业模式导航异常**
  - 移除强链接 iOS 17+/18+ 的 `UnevenRoundedRectangle` 与全部 `.onGeometryChange` 调用，改用向后兼容路径与几何读取实现，根治 iOS 16.0 / 16.0.2 / 16.2 打开界面或卡片时因动态符号缺失导致的闪退。
  - 修复 iOS 27.2 beta 2 在应用详情页加载历史版本时偶发崩溃的问题（修正版本行布局优先级与骨架屏几何回调防抖阈值）。
  - 修复 iPadOS 全屏及开启「专业模式」后导航栏切换错乱、标题丢失与工具栏按钮跨标签泄露的问题，改为按当前活动标签隔离独立导航栈。
- **TestFlight 支持 Apple TV 多平台下载、校验修复与顶部优化**
  - TestFlight 详情页新增多平台切换（如 `iOS` / `Apple TV`），支持直接下载 Apple TV（tvOS）测试包，并与同一应用的 iOS 测试包独立索引、互不覆盖。
  - 在「下载」「应用包」「存储空间」「包体详情」「解密详情」等全应用页面为 Apple TV 等非 iPhone 包并列展示单色客户端图标（紧邻单色 TestFlight 图标）；点击 TestFlight 任务与安装包详情均可查看来源、客户端与对应最低系统版本（如 `tvOS`）；Apple TV 测试包下载后与常规商店包一致不显示「安装」按钮且不触发自动安装。
  - 修复 TestFlight 下载大型/多变体游戏（如多架构或超大二进制包）误报「产物校验失败，已清理」的问题：改用流式读取 Mach-O 头部前缀并兼容 FAT 32/64 位架构 `cryptid` 校验，修正替换 SINF 计数与完整变体（`packages.full`）筛选逻辑。
  - 修复进入 TestFlight 应用详情页时顶部状态栏与封面衔接处出现浅色虚化断层的显示异常，改用不透明模糊与导航栏原生外观平滑衔接。
- **设置开放自定义 177 个商店地区（支持搜索筛选与排序）**
  - 在「设置 › 外观与图标 › 商店地区」开放自定义管理搜索页显示的地区列表，覆盖全部 **177** 个 Apple App Store 商店地区（补齐 `AF`、`LI`）。
  - 支持按中文名称、英文名称或 ISO‑2 地区代码实时搜索筛选（精确匹配代码优先置顶）、点击勾选、拖拽排序、国旗与代码同屏展示及一键「恢复默认」（至少保留 1 个地区）。
- **修复 FairPlay 解密误拒、首次获取旧版报错与批量导入体验**
  - 修复专业模式本机 FairPlay 解密部分高熵插件二进制（如 `_codecs_cn`）时被误判校验失败的问题，补充基于解码后指令特征的放行校验。
  - 完善 App Store 登录诊断与错误文案：记录 `SAPSigner` 失败阶段详情，修正 `5020` 与双重认证提示文案，避免误导。
  - 修复未获取过的免费应用首次「获取」并加载历史版本时因 Apple 许可延迟偶发失败的问题（获取许可后自动清理旧缓存并执行短退避重试）。
  - 修复「应用包」批量导入多个 IPA 时中途自动跳进详情页打断队列的问题，新增实时导入计数（`正在添加安装包（已完成/总数）`）、批量完成提示与可关闭错误横幅。

---

### 📢 官方频道与反馈说明

- **官方 Telegram 频道**：👉 [**https://t.me/ipadn_official**](https://t.me/ipadn_official)
- **GitHub Issues 仅保留只读归档**：新版安装包与源码优先在官方 Telegram 频道发布；使用问题、排障与 Bug 反馈请直接前往频道**对应版本贴文评论区**提交。

### ⚠️ TestFlight 实验性说明与免责声明

- **实验性功能提醒**：TestFlight 下载与原生安装为 `v2.3.x` 系列推出的**实验性功能**，受 Apple 服务端策略、账号当前有效 Beta 资格、本地网络/代理与本机配对影响，建议先使用备用 Apple 账号体验，勿分享配对文件、令牌或完整备份；详细用法与排障指南见 [README — TestFlight 实验性新功能](README.md#testflight-实验性新功能)。
- **免责声明**：iPadn 基于 [GPL-2.0-or-later](LICENSE) 开源，仅限个人合法备份、授权测试与技术研究，与 Apple Inc. 无关；因使用本工具带来的账号风控或数据风险由使用者自行承担。

### 📦 安装包与签名源

- `iPadn-2.3.5-unsigned.ipa`：标准版，含实时活动（灵动岛、锁屏进度）与桌面小组件扩展，签名需要 2 个 App ID。
- `iPadn-2.3.5-lite-unsigned.ipa`：精简版，移除扩展，只需 1 个 App ID；不提供实时活动或小组件，其他功能完全一致。
- SideStore、AltStore、Feather 等签名工具可添加源：`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/ipadn/main/altstore-source.json`。

---

### English

**v2.3.5** delivers key stability fixes and highly requested improvements: eliminates **iOS 16.0–16.2 strong-linked symbol crashes**, **iOS 27.2 beta 2 version-history crashes**, and **iPadOS full-screen / Pro mode toolbar & navigation bugs**; adds **multi-platform TestFlight downloads (including Apple TV)** with monochrome client badges, fixes false validation rejections on large/multi-variant games, and polishes the TestFlight detail top blur; opens a searchable, reorderable **177-region Storefront picker** under Settings › Appearance & icon; and resolves FairPlay high-entropy false rejections, login `5020`/2FA messaging, first-time free-app license retries, and multi-IPA batch import interruptions. Both packages are unsigned—sign with your own tool before installing.

#### Fixes & Improvements Since v2.3.4

- **Fix iOS 16/27 Crashes & iPadOS Pro Mode Navigation**
  - Removes strong-linked iOS 17+/18+ `UnevenRoundedRectangle` and all `.onGeometryChange` usages in favor of backward-compatible paths and geometry observers, resolving launch and view crashes on iOS 16.0 / 16.0.2 / 16.2.
  - Fixes a crash on iOS 27.2 beta 2 when loading version history on App Detail by stabilizing row layout priorities and shimmer geometry change thresholds.
  - Fixes missing titles, broken navigation, and leaked cross-tab toolbars in iPadOS full-screen & Pro mode by isolating a single active `NavigationStack` per tab.
- **TestFlight Apple TV Support, Validation & Hero Blur Fix**
  - Adds platform switching (`iOS` / `Apple TV`, etc.) on TestFlight detail pages to download Apple TV (tvOS) beta IPAs alongside iOS builds, indexed cleanly per `(bundle, platform)`.
  - Places monochrome platform icons beside the monochrome TestFlight icon across **Downloads**, **Packages**, **Storage**, **Package Info**, and **Decryption Detail**; displays source, client platform, and accurate minimum OS (e.g., `tvOS`) in task & package details; hides the Install button and skips Auto-Install for Apple TV IPAs just like regular App Store Apple TV downloads.
  - Fixes false "validation failed, cleaned up" errors on large or multi-variant TestFlight games via streaming Mach-O header prefix reads, FAT 32/64-bit `cryptid` inspection, accurate SINF replacement counting, and `packages.full`-first variant selection.
  - Eliminates the light top-edge blur band on TestFlight detail pages using opaque hero blur and native navigation bar appearance syncing.
- **Customizable 177 Storefront Regions with Search & Reorder**
  - Adds **Settings › Appearance & icon › Storefront Regions** covering all **177** Apple App Store regions (including `AF` and `LI`).
  - Supports instant search by localized name, English name, or ISO‑2 code (with exact ISO‑2 matches ranked first), tap-to-toggle, drag-to-reorder, flag + code display, and one-tap **Reset to Defaults**.
- **FairPlay, Login/License Retry & Batch Import Fixes**
  - Fixes on-device FairPlay decryption falsely rejecting legitimate high-entropy plugin binaries (such as `_codecs_cn`) by accepting verified decrypted instruction streams.
  - Improves App Store sign-in `5020` / 2FA messaging and adds staged `SAPSigner` failure diagnostics.
  - Automatically invalidates stale version caches and performs short backoff retries after acquiring a free app license so first-time older-version fetches no longer fail on transient `9610` delays.
  - Fixes multi-IPA batch import in **Packages** prematurely opening a detail sheet mid-batch, adding live `(done/total)` progress, batch completion toast, and a dismissible error banner.

#### Official Telegram Channel & GitHub Issues Archive
- **Official Telegram Channel**: [**https://t.me/ipadn_official**](https://t.me/ipadn_official) (new builds & source archives land here first).
- **GitHub Issues Read-Only**: Please post support questions, TestFlight diagnostics, and bug reports under the matching release post in our Telegram channel.

#### TestFlight Experimental Notice & Disclaimer
- TestFlight download and native installation in `v2.3.x` are **experimental** and depend on Apple server behavior, active per-account invitations, proxy/DNS setup, and device pairing state. Testing with a secondary Apple Account first is recommended, and never share pairing files, tokens, or unencrypted backups (see [README_EN — TestFlight Experimental](README_EN.md#testflight-experimental)).
- Released under [GPL-2.0-or-later](LICENSE) for authorized personal testing, backups, and research; unaffiliated with Apple Inc., with all account or data risks assumed by the user.

#### Packages
- `iPadn-2.3.5-unsigned.ipa`: Standard build with Live Activities & Widgets (requires 2 App IDs).
- `iPadn-2.3.5-lite-unsigned.ipa`: Lite build without extensions (requires 1 App ID; identical core features).
- AltStore / SideStore / Feather repo: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengangs/ipadn/main/altstore-source.json`.

更早版本的更新内容见 [Releases](https://github.com/mengangs/ipadn/releases)。

versions.localizedDescription:
# Iridium 0.2.0

Download your Steam games directly in Iridium, manage repairs and updates, and try the updated Windows runtime. Game support remains experimental.

## Download

**[Download Iridium (.ipa)](https://github.com/intraducine/iridium/releases/download/v0.2.0/Iridium-unsigned.ipa)**

Requires **iOS or iPadOS 18+**, JIT, and games you own. You only need the IPA to install; supply your own game files or download owned games from Steam.

## Install

1. Sign and install the IPA and helper with a compatible sideloading tool, or import it into LiveContainer using its supported JIT setup.
2. Open Iridium and configure JIT in **Launch Support**.
3. Open **Downloads → Steam** to sign in and queue a game, or use **Add Game** to import a game folder. Choose its executable, add it to your library, then press **Play**.

For standalone installation, preserve `com.apple.developer.kernel.increased-memory-limit=true` in both Iridium's final app signature and provisioning profile. The anonymous ad-hoc carrier alone grants no installation or memory rights. In LiveContainer, the container process's signature, profile, and JIT setup determine effective rights; importing the guest IPA does not grant them. Both routes still need device validation.

Back up your saves before updating. Update the existing app or LiveContainer entry without deleting its data. Steam repairs and updates keep older installations; saves stored inside an older game folder may need to be copied manually to the new one. Keep that older folder until you have checked your saves.

## What's new

- **Steam downloads in the app.** Sign in with a password or QR code, with Steam Guard support, browse your library, and choose download language, unprotected branch, 32/64-bit files, and owned DLC.
- **A download queue with verification and repair.** Pause, resume, retry, and prioritize downloads. Check for updates or repair downloaded files while keeping the previous installation.
- **Clearer storage warnings.** Download checks use the space available to Iridium and account for verified partial files. **Download Anyway** can bypass an estimated-space warning for one attempt; file verification and real out-of-space errors remain enforced.
- **Updated Windows runtime.** Includes 32-bit WoW64 support and D3D9/D3D12 updates. Support still varies by game and device.
- **Game prerequisite installers.** Run supported setup steps included with a game, or choose **Game Options → Run Installer** for an EXE or MSI installer you provide. Some installers need interaction. Closing the player requests cancellation; Iridium keeps observing the runtime's exit and reports when a restart is required.
- **Reduced duplicate runtime data.** Identical Windows runtime files share one packaged copy. The main app's anonymous ad-hoc signature carries only the increased-memory-limit request; helpers remain unsigned until you sign them.

## Known issues

- Physical-device compatibility for these changes has not been established. Some games may fail to launch or have graphics, video, audio, input, save, or shutdown problems. Skyrim speech and mouse attack issues remain unverified.
- Keep Iridium open while downloading. Downloads pause when the app goes into the background and need to be resumed. Real-account downloads and recovery after Wi-Fi or network loss still need device testing.
- Steam Cloud, Workshop, Steam Families library discovery, password-protected branches, and desktop Steam services are not included. Games that require Steamworks/DRM, anti-cheat, or other unsupported runtime features may not launch after downloading.
- Updates keep older game copies and need extra storage. **Download Anyway** does not create free space; exhausting device storage can also prevent other apps from saving.
- JIT and available memory depend on your device and signing setup; LiveContainer and standalone results can differ. Built-in JIT requires standalone Iridium, debugging permission, a valid pairing file, and LocalDevVPN. Hosted Iridium uses external JIT. Recipient signing, LiveContainer hosting, and game prerequisite success still need device testing.

<details>
<summary>Source code, licenses, and build details</summary>

## Source and licenses

The other release files are for source access, rebuilding, and download verification:

- Download both `Iridium-corresponding-source.tar.gz.part01` and `.part02` for the complete matching source package.
- `Iridium-source-guide.zip` contains license notices, source records, and build/relink instructions.
- `SHA256SUMS` verifies the IPA, both source parts, and the source guide.

Download all five release files into one folder, then run:

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS
cat Iridium-corresponding-source.tar.gz.part01 Iridium-corresponding-source.tar.gz.part02 > Iridium-corresponding-source.tar.gz
unzip Iridium-source-guide.zip
shasum -a 256 -c Iridium-source-guide/ASSEMBLED-SHA256SUMS
```

The source guide includes the assembled archive's checksum and rebuild instructions. Keep the matching source and guide beside the IPA at this versioned release URL. GitHub's automatic repository ZIP does not contain all required dependency sources.

Source commit: b7e24f9fb4dd17f5d940c4763123f2b00d0e121f
Build run: https://github.com/intraducine/iridium/actions/runs/37142663989

App and helper version: **0.2.0 (115.1)**, minimum iOS **18.0**, confirmed in the actual delivered Info.plist files. The IPA is **399,916,792 bytes**; SHA-256 `1934922a1fcf1509e305a29d6f0d26579a4318ba95dfcf5b406d5e38f88c9763`.

Source checks, Steam native/simulator checks, the full app build, and final binary/package checks passed. Independent IPA inspection confirmed the exact anonymous XML/DER entitlement carrier with no CMS payload or team identity, eight unsigned non-main native binaries, strict bundle verification, runtime hashes, and ZIP modes and symlinks. Unchanged runtime component outputs were reused after provenance checks. These checks do not establish real-account login, owned-game downloads, game compatibility, recipient signing, or physical-device behavior.

Apple compiler-runtime notice uncertainty and unsigned-IPA contractual authorization remain documented risks. Retain the license guide in `Iridium-source-guide.zip`.

</details>

apps.name: iTorrent
apps.subtitle: Torrent client for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
iTorrent is an ordinary torrent client for iOS with Files app support and much more.

What can this app do:

• Download in the background
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island progress bar
• Downloading on external drives
• Sequential download (use VLC to watch films while loading)
• Add torrent files from Share menu (Safari and other apps)
• Add magnet links directly from Safari
• Store files in Files app
• File sharing directly from app
• Download torrent by url
• Download torrent by magnet
• Send notification on torrent downloaded
• Web/WebDav Server
• Select files download priority
• Change UI to dark theme
• Color personalization
• RSS Feed

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's new:
* Meet the new built-in VLC player. Play compatible video and audio files directly in iTorrent, even while they are still downloading.
* Enjoy Picture in Picture, playback speeds from 0.5x to 2x, audio and subtitle track selection, precise seeking, and system media controls.
* Take playback to a bigger screen with AirPlay or a compatible player discovered on your local network.
* Choose how pieces are downloaded with Sequential and First & Last priority modes, making it easier to start watching sooner.
* Select and share multiple completed files or entire folders in one go.

## Improvements:
* Refreshed the interface for iOS 26, with Liquid Glass styling, cleaner dialogs, and more polished navigation.
* Made torrent details smoother and easier to use, with clearer download-priority controls and private-torrent information.
* Improved media previewing so iTorrent can offer the best available player for each file.
* Updated the torrent and media engines for better compatibility, stability, and recovery from unexpected errors.
* Expanded and refined translations across all supported languages.

## Fixes:
* Fixed cases where magnet links could be saved incorrectly.
* Fixed a startup race condition that could interfere with launching the app or completing initial setup.
* Fixed toolbars and navigation behaving incorrectly in iPad split-screen mode.
* Fixed RSS downloads returning to the wrong screen.
* Fixed torrent details sometimes getting stuck in a continuous update loop.
* Fixed several playback, AirPlay, and local-device connection issues.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/XITRIX/iTorrent/compare/v2.1.1-1...v2.2.0-1
