versions.localizedDescription:
### 修复

- 修复点全屏后画面有时缩到左下角并越出边界、必须退出再进一次才恢复的问题
- 修复在 Bangumi 上标记单集看过失败时只说一句「失败」、看不出原因的问题，现在会说明是令牌失效、单集不存在还是番剧未收藏
- 修复时间表滑到底后大量过滤或切换排序时整页空白的问题
- 修复番剧详情页的验证码弹窗在大字号或横屏下撑满整屏的问题，现在限制在半屏高度、内容可滚动
- 修复截图偶发失败：`screenshot-raw` 取不到帧时先在 GPU 侧按片源分辨率读回，不再为此切换解码器

### 优化

- 横屏播放页的进度条改用独立布局，与时间显示对齐更整齐
- 弹幕：屏蔽规则预编译复用、轨道判定提速，无弹幕时段降低刷新频率，高密度弹幕下更省电
- 追番页只按需加载可视区封面，之后 15 张提前预取，滚动更顺
- 下载重试改为 0.5 秒 → 1.5 秒 → 3 秒的退避；App 被强杀后重开也能按已下载的分片恢复进度
- 云同步内容没有变化时不再重复上传，上传过程中的提示会分阶段显示进度
- 更新提醒的封面改为复用同一张图，不再为每条提醒重复准备
- 图片搜索选图后改为后台压缩再上传，选择大图时不再卡顿
- 日志缓冲改为固定容量的环形结构，长时间使用后内存占用更稳定

### 已知问题

- 部分番剧的详情页侧滑退出无法打断，按钮悬空慢淡出。这是 SwiftUI 原生转场机制的限制，暂时没有优化计划

**安装：** 在 AltStore / SideStore / Feather 中添加软件源 `https://linkpass888.github.io/Sideload/source.json`，即可直接安装与更新，无需手动下载 IPA。入口页 <https://linkpass888.github.io/Sideload/>

apps.localizedDescription:
Kumone（雲の音）— native NetEase Cloud Music client for iOS. Talks directly to NetEase's real API with no third-party server: QR-code login, gray-track unblocking, synced lyrics with translation, immersive artwork-tinted now-playing, and playlist management.

Supports English and Simplified Chinese localization.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added

- **macOS**: an Add to Playlist button next to the heart in the player bar saves the playing song to one of your playlists in one click (#232, thanks @WillowBranch127).
- **iOS**: a Swipe Left from Lyrics for Comments switch in Settings turns the swipe off for anyone who triggers it by accident; View Comments stays in the now-playing menu (#225).

### Fixed

- **iOS**: skipping to another song now stops the previous one straight away, instead of letting it play on for a few seconds under the new song's title and lyrics (#221).
- **Now playing**: after a relaunch, the restored song's lyrics load right away instead of spinning until you press play (#219).
- **macOS 26**: with Liquid Glass, the page no longer covers part of the floating sidebar; a gap now runs between them, also with the window inactive (#229).
- **macOS**: opening Roam with a song loaded no longer pushes the sidebar up under the window buttons (#227).
- **macOS**: dragging the desktop lyrics no longer brings a minimized or hidden main window back to the front (#187).
- **Comments**: shared comment pictures no longer have a thin white line along the bottom.

---

### 新增

- **macOS**：播放条爱心旁新增「收藏到歌单」按钮，一键把正在播放的歌收藏到歌单（#232，感谢 @WillowBranch127）。
- **iOS**：设置中新增「左滑歌词查看评论」开关，容易误触的话可以关掉；关掉后播放页菜单中的「查看评论」仍然可用（#225）。

### 修复

- **iOS**：切歌时会立刻停掉上一首，不会再在新歌的歌名和歌词下继续播放上一首几秒（#221）。
- **播放页**：重新打开应用后，恢复的歌曲会直接加载歌词，不用等按下播放才出来（#219）。
- **macOS 26**：开启液态玻璃时，主界面不会再盖住悬浮侧边栏的一部分，两者之间留出间距，窗口失去焦点时也一样（#229）。
- **macOS**：有歌曲时打开「漫游」，侧边栏不会再被顶到窗口按钮下面（#227）。
- **macOS**：拖动桌面歌词时，不会再把已最小化或隐藏的主窗口带回前台（#187）。
- **评论**：分享的评论图片底部不会再有一条细白线。

apps.name: LinuxRunner
apps.subtitle: Run ARM64 Linux apps and desktops on iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Run ARM64 Linux applications and desktop environments on iOS without a jailbreak, virtual machine, or JIT.

versions.localizedDescription:
# LinuxRunner v1.0.1

Linux on your iPhone and iPad. This update adds iPad desktop adaptations, brings Arch Linux ARM into the setup workflow and improves package recovery and desktop sessions.

## What's New

- **iPad support:** window-aware desktop sizing, hardware-keyboard desktop shortcuts and the shared touch/pointer interface. Tested on a physical iPad.
- **Arch Linux ARM:** install signed packages, use `pacman` and explore an experimental Openbox desktop with LXQt Panel and PCManFM-Qt.
- **One setup workflow:** **Distributions → Set Up Linux…** installs a distribution or configures an existing environment while preserving its files and accounts.

The maintainer reports a working Arch graphical desktop and graphical application launches on a physical iPhone using **build 897**. Telegram Desktop has been tested on Arch Linux ARM with login, sending messages and calls. The supplied iPhone capture shows its welcome screen.

## Improvements

Arch desktop defaults provide a visible panel, wallpaper and file manager without replacing the user's normal LXQt configuration. Managed graphical launches share the active account's authenticated X11 context. Desktop startup status and Qt diagnostics are more useful when a component fails.

IPA packaging now includes an ad-hoc code signature and a standard ZIP layout. It still needs a compatible signing/provisioning method for ordinary device installation.

## Bug Fixes

- Arch terminal termios2 compatibility.
- Signed cached-package recovery and consistent handling of orphaned GCC ownership/obsolete recovery state.
- Qt X11 launch-context failures and desktop profile defaults.
- Reopening existing desktop sessions and readiness after component crashes.
- ARM64 vDSO executable mapping and covered filesystem/syscall compatibility gaps.

## Supported Distributions

| Distribution | Experience |
| --- | --- |
| Debian GNU/Linux 13 ARM64 | Recommended terminal and LinuxRunner Desktop; KDE Plasma remains experimental. |
| Arch Linux ARM | Terminal, `pacman` and experimental Openbox/LXQt-component desktop. |
| Alpine Linux 3.24 ARM64 | Small terminal environment with `apk`; graphical compatibility remains experimental. |

## Installation

Download the release IPA and sign/install it with your preferred compatible sideloading tool, such as Sideloadly or AltStore Classic. Then use **Distributions → Set Up Linux…** to install Linux inside the app.

See the [installation guide](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner#installation) and [Linux setup walkthrough](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner/blob/v1.0.1/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md). When updating, back up important files and preserve the existing app identity and App Group configuration. Do not uninstall the app as a repair step.

## Known Limitations

The application interprets ARM64 Linux userspace; it does not boot a Linux kernel, require JIT or use hardware virtualization. System-call and application coverage is incomplete. The configured minimum is iOS/iPadOS 15.0; model/OS compatibility is not universal. iPad support has been physically tested. An older iPhone 11/iOS 17 launch-black-screen report is unresolved.

Arch desktop, Debian KDE Plasma and Metal acceleration remain experimental. Arch Plasma/Wayland is unavailable. Some Arch GTK/glycin programs still encounter write-seal compatibility problems. Large applications can be slow or exceed memory limits. iOS/iPadOS may suspend or terminate the app; saved files persist, running processes do not survive termination.

## Downloads

- **LinuxRunner-1.0.1.ipa** — ad-hoc signed, without an Apple provisioning profile. Install with your preferred compatible signing/sideloading method.
- **LinuxRunner-1.0.1-source.tar.gz** — matching application source and build scripts, pinned build dependencies, matching Alpine source inputs and terminal-renderer sources.
- **LICENSES.txt** — project and third-party license notices.
- **SHA256SUMS** — checksums for the IPA, source archive and license notices.

The IPA is **14,646,386 bytes**. Verify the original download before signing it; signing changes its checksum.

```text
c571c7ae1dd8ab641930e513254866658dc94f0bee370f1d2623cd462f0fa2ca  LinuxRunner-1.0.1.ipa
```

GitHub automatic source archives omit submodule contents. Use the separately attached source asset for the dependency-inclusive source distribution.

## Feedback and License

[Report reproducible problems through GitHub Issues](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner/issues/new/choose), including your device, OS, app version/build, distribution and diagnostic report. Review logs/screenshots for personal information before attaching them.

LinuxRunner derives from [iSH](https://github.com/ish-app/ish) through [ios-linuxkit](https://github.com/rcarmo/ios-linuxkit). The combined application is GPL-3.0-covered; upstream copyright, contribution-specific terms, App Store terms and third-party notices are preserved. See the repository's [license](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner/blob/v1.0.1/LICENSE.md) and [third-party notices](https://github.com/mxhm11cr/LinuxRunner/blob/v1.0.1/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

apps.name: Madeira
apps.subtitle: Windows PC games on your iPhone
apps.localizedDescription: Madeira runs unmodified x86-64 Windows PC games inside a single jailed iOS app: FEX-Emu translates the game's x86 code to ARM64 as it runs, Wine 11.4 built for ARM64EC provides Windows itself, and DXMT plus Madeira's own Direct3D 12 runtime draw Direct3D 9, 10, 11 and 12 through Metal. Games come with a library, Steam sign-in and installs, controller and touch controls, and keyboard, mouse and trackpad input. Requires an iPhone on iOS 26 or later with JIT enabled through StikDebug.

versions.localizedDescription:
### New
- **More stores.** Madeira has a new **GOG** section: sign in with GOG's own login page, see your library, download and update games with the DLC you own, verify and repair them, and play with Galaxy achievements and stats (Madeira stands in for GOG Galaxy). A new **EA app** section: sign in, see your library and download games without the EA app. A new **itch.io** store shows your itch.io games and free games, and downloads and installs them, .7z archives included. **Epic Games** now handles game downloads and cloud saves together.
- **Store tabs.** With more than one store on the library page, a row of tabs at the top (All, Steam, Other, GOG, itch.io, Epic, EA) shows one store at a time. All is the page as before; the tab you pick is remembered.
- **Steam:**
  - DLC downloads with the game, with a switch per DLC
  - beta branches, with beta codes
  - a Workshop page per game
  - achievements
  - choosing the game's language
  - downloading from a PC on the same network
  - faster repairs
  - a switch that turns Steam Cloud off
- **A redesigned library.** Game details pages, a starting screen, and Settings split into pages. You can also turn on a zoomable grid in Settings › Appearance › New library grid.
- **Recommended settings** for many games, with Reset to Recommended. Share Setup sends a game's setup to someone else.
- **Get Help from Claude** on a game's page shares a fixes guide together with your log and config.
- **Translations:** German, Spanish, Korean, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian.
- **External drives**, save backups and Home Screen shortcuts.
- **Games and downloads keep running** when you leave Madeira.
- **Wine Mono and Wine Gecko** download for you, without Wine's download windows.
- **Graphics:**
  - MetalFX upscaling per game
  - experimental frame generation
  - a per-game picker for the graphics card the game sees
  - FPS limits, including 40 FPS on 120 Hz screens
  - an optional thermal frame cap
- **The performance overlay** has a Column layout that you can drag anywhere on the screen.
- **Controllers and touch controls:**
  - rumble, adaptive triggers and the lightbar on real controllers
  - an optional DualSense / DirectInput mode
  - gyro aim and turbo
  - touch control gesture zones
  - a size slider per touch control, and the editor's panels close when you tap outside them
  - a **Button style** for touch controls: Glass (Liquid Glass) or Solid (plain opaque buttons), in the in-game menu and in Settings › Appearance
- **On iPad:** Command-V pastes into games, and the mouse wheel scrolls.
- **On iPhone:** a Bluetooth or USB mouse works with AssistiveTouch on; mouse-look no longer stops at the screen edges.
- **JIT:** Madeira offers StikDebug when the built-in helper is not available.

### Fixed
- **Native D3D12:** many fixes, including DXIL tessellation, shader caching and faster pipeline builds.
- **Memory and JIT:** many fixes, so large 64-bit and 32-bit games crash less often.
- **Per-game AVX / AVX2**, for games that quit with c000001d.
- **Steam CEG games** can start through Madeira Dock.
- **Launchers that offered to install a game that was already installed:** Madeira Dock now writes the Registry values from a game's install scripts before the start, as Steam's desktop client does.
- **Rockstar Games Launcher / Social Club 2.4.0.296** (the update of 3 November) loads its pages again.
- **The touch controls' Opacity slider** now fades the buttons on iOS 26; it only faded their labels before.
- **Game pills:** the 32-bit / 64-bit and DirectX pills under each game are gone, because they were often wrong. The size pill stays.

### Known issues
- Some Steam games with CEG copy protection still stop with "Madeira Dock stopped" on first start.
- The GOG and EA app sections are new. Please send a log if something goes wrong.

### Install
- Requires **iOS 26 or later**. In-app pairing and the Madeira JIT shortcut need iOS 27.
- If your sideloader asks whether to keep app extensions, keep them: Madeira's in-app JIT runs in one.
- The IPA is ad-hoc signed (no certificate) and carries the app's entitlements, including the increased memory limit. Sideload it with your own Apple ID (SideStore, AltStore, Sideloadly, Plume or similar), which signs it for your device.

### Not included
The Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs are not redistributed (see `legal/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`). Building from source: `tools/fetch-vcruntime.md`.

Thanks to everyone who sent pull requests, logs and test results since 0.1.3.

apps.name: MD3Music
apps.subtitle: 基于酷狗音乐 API 的 Material 3 音乐播放器
apps.localizedDescription: 基于酷狗音乐 API 的 Flutter 音乐播放器，内置嵌入式 Rust API 服务器，无需外部服务器即可使用。提供 MD3 与 Apple Music 风格播放页、逐字歌词与多种音频输出能力。

versions.localizedDescription:
## 已知问题

- **切歌无声 / 上一首残留问题仍存在**：本版已尝试根治（原生层播放/暂停去早退、切歌意图确立后立即静音旧源、挂起后死亡播放器自愈），真机实测概率性仍可复现——后续版本继续排查

## 上游 6.2.0 移植

- 版本号与上游对齐（6.2.0+53），全量同步上游 md3Music 6.2.0：播放链路重构（本地 API 服务器新增响度参数与预热、媒体会话收敛）、依赖更新（m3_expressive、ort_dart、image、sqflite_common_ffi 等）、桌面小组件服务调整与全部上游修复
- just_audio 播放内核同步至上游版本，iOS fork 补丁（音频焦点中断转发、均衡器挂载、辅助播放器）全部保留并适配新接口

## iOS 修复

- **iOS 26 桌面小组件按钮全部无响应修复**：iOS 26 弃用了在 extension 中设置 `openAppWhenRun` 的行为（点击 intent 根本不执行）；按钮 intent 改为双 target 共享 + 新 `supportedModes` 属性。播放控制类按钮（播放/暂停、上下曲、FM 控制等）现走系统后台执行协议——**点组件直接切歌，不再跳转打开 app**
- **短暂挂起回前台后播放不了修复**：挂起会触发系统媒体服务重置，播放器实例死亡但应用状态未更新，点播放走快路径无声无错。新增前台死亡观察：播放中但进度 10 秒不动的判定为死播放器，自动重建并恢复到原进度（锁屏/切后台几分钟后回来自动恢复）
- **挂起恢复后搜索/解析全部失败修复**：挂起后本地 API 服务器工作线程死亡而监听端口残留，旧探测方式被内核代答误判「服务正常」且永不自愈；探测改为真实 HTTP 请求，回前台主动健康检查并按需重建服务
- **3D 封面系列修复**：iOS 缓存目录异常曾导致推理链路完全静默失败（不推理也无提示），失败原因现已对用户可见；脏缓存条目（索引在、文件丢）被误判为「设备不支持 shader」导致全进程降级多层视差的问题修复——缓存命中增加完整性校验，缺失自动重新推理
- **歌词画中画修复**：双行布局在较大字号下上下顶边裁切（行距超界），改为按剩余空间三等分居中——任何字号、单双行都完整居中
- **显示大小**：调整后未点「保留」就杀后台，不再把未确认档位带进下次启动（确认前仅内存预览，点「保留」才落盘）；iOS 隐藏「硬件解码播放」入口（iOS 播放器恒为系统级硬解，无对应开关可做）
- CI 构建修复：恢复 Rust 静态库编译产物（上游同步时被覆盖丢失导致 iOS 构建失败）

## 其它

- 签名与小组件兼容说明：App Group 兼容**目前仅支持 [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader)**（电脑签）；SideStore/AltStore 手机签后小组件显示「无法加载」是其签名流程丢弃 App Group 权限所致，主应用功能不受影响

未签名 IPA：下载后自行签名安装（推荐 [iloader](https://github.com/nab138/iloader)，免费 Apple ID 签名即可）。

- `MD3Music-unsigned.ipa`：标准版（无 3D 封面，推荐）
- `MD3Music-3D-unsigned.ipa`：含 3D 封面支持版（内置 Depth Anything V2 深度模型与 MI-GAN 修补模型，设置中开启 3D 封面即可；生成失败时自动回退平面封面，包体约 +40MB）

仅供学习交流，请勿用于商业用途！详见[免责声明](https://github.com/EPXiaohua/MD3Music-iOS/blob/main/DISCLAIMER.md)。如条件允许请支持原作者项目：[zzyoxml/md3Music](https://github.com/zzyoxml/md3Music/)。

apps.name: Melee-PC
apps.subtitle: Native port of Super Smash Bros. Melee
apps.localizedDescription: A native port of Super Smash Bros. Melee (NTSC-U 1.02) built from the decompilation project, with modern rendering and quality-of-life options. You must provide your own dump of the original game disc to play; no game data is included.

versions.localizedDescription:
**Beta, for testing only.** Expect crashes and missing features.

You need your own Super Smash Bros. Melee disc image. **No game data ships in
these artifacts** — the port reads everything, including its font atlases, from
the image you supply at runtime.

**USA revision 2 (NTSC-U 1.02, GALE01)** is the supported disc. A Europe (PAL,
GALP01) image boots experimentally, running the USA game code on PAL data with
English (UK) text.

<!-- Published verbatim by the release job (gh release create --notes-file).
     Per release: replace Highlights and Fixes, refresh Known issues and
     Requirements, link earlier releases, and update the feature status table
     in README.md (it is the single source
     of truth for what works; nothing here may contradict it). -->

## Highlights

- Fixed the Adventure mode Mushroom Kingdom crash when blocks are hit (#144).
- Fixed macOS bundles missing transitive `@rpath` libraries, including
  `libbrotlicommon.1.dylib`, which could prevent the app from launching (#145).
- Fixed coloured bars at the top left of widescreen fights when off-screen
  fighter magnifiers are drawn. Verified on Linux/Vulkan in Kongo Jungle and
  Onett; Windows/Direct3D hardware verification is still pending.

## Fixes

- Replaced GameCube byte-offset overlays with native field access for
  Mushroom Kingdom block objects, Multi-Man Melee record initialization, and
  Super Scope charge resets. This avoids invalid pointers, missing records,
  and writes into unrelated CPU state on 64-bit hosts (#144).
- macOS packaging now resolves and bundles transitive `@rpath` dependencies
  and rejects bundles with missing libraries before publishing (#145).
- Magnifier capture cameras now copy and clear their whole temporary viewport,
  preserving fighter proportions and preventing leftover depth from hiding
  parts of the stage. Added a regression test for original, widescreen and
  ultrawide framebuffer aspects.

## Known issues

Open reports are tracked on the [issue tracker](https://github.com/999sian/melee-pc/issues);
the numbers below link there.

**All platforms**

- Rendering artifacts and Kirby grab/throw behaviour remain under investigation (#130).
- Online play is a prototype. LAN Play, Direct Connect, Unranked and Ranked are
  implemented and rendezvous through the public DHT, but pairing across two
  NATs in general and live ranked acceptance are unproven, and cross-platform simulation
  determinism is not claimed. Ratings are community-computed and unverified.
  Every datagram is authenticated (protocol 9), and the LAN lobby
  only pairs identical builds, so both players should use the same release. A
  connect code is 8 characters after the `#`.
- Widescreen applies to fights (VS, Sudden Death, Training); menus, results and
  cutscenes stay at the original aspect. The wide HUD is a separate toggle and
  only moves the timer and the 2-4 player HUD groups.
- A move, stage or effect whose shader is still compiling is missing from the
  picture for a few frames (previously a freeze, #46). The bundled seed is
  queued for compilation on worker threads when the game starts, and the
  launcher waits for that queue when you press Play -- press Play again to skip
  the wait. `MELEE_PIPELINE_SYNC=1` restores the old wait-for-compile
  behaviour, and `MELEE_PIPELINE_JOBS=<n>` sets the compile thread count.
  On Android, shaders compile inline to avoid driver failures seen when
  pipelines are created on a second thread, so expect first-use stutter.
- Only Vulkan, Direct3D 12/11 and Metal backends are shipped; OpenGL and
  OpenGL ES-only GPUs and drivers do not run the game (#64, #66).
- Gamepad buttons, sticks and triggers can be remapped; dash sensitivity,
  tap-jump disable and input buffer settings are not available (#3).
- Some users cannot get past the launcher; if the launcher shows but the game
  never starts, run with the log enabled and attach it (#40).

**Browser**

- Tested in Chrome only; Firefox and Safari WebGPU support is incomplete.
- Only a raw, uncompressed USA revision 2 (GALE01) image loads: no `.ciso`,
  `.rvz` or PAL.
- No online play, and no gamepad remapping (the default mapping is used; the
  keys are listed under the canvas).

**Windows**

- Classic mode startup crashes remain under investigation (#128).
- v0.1.6-beta and later can close immediately when starting the game from the
  launcher on machines where v0.1.5-beta worked (#62, #63). Attach
  `melee-pc.log` (or run `RUN-AND-LOG.bat`).
- Intel Gen7 iGPUs (HD 4000/4400/4600, Ivy Bridge/Haswell, e.g. i5-4200U) are
  refused by D3D12, and the Direct3D 11 path they are meant to fall back to has
  not been verified on that hardware. A `DXGI_ERROR_DEVICE_HUNG` mid-match
  there (#67) is the 2020-era Intel driver timing out on the GPU; there is no
  further API to fall back to on it. The log names the adapter, backend and
  driver version.

**Android**

- Battle rendering is reported blank unless paused on Pixel 9 Pro (#129).
  This release does not yet have a verified fix for that device.
- Startup or Play-button crashes remain reported on Retroid Pocket 6 and
  AYN Odin 2 (#136, #137); device logs and hardware verification are outstanding.
- Some devices close the app at launch before the launcher appears, reported
  on an Honor 200 (Snapdragon 7 Gen 3) and an AYN Odin 2 (#59, #23).
- Android 9 and devices without Vulkan are not supported (#66).

**macOS**

- The macOS builds are experimental; the Intel one is untested on hardware.
  The game's C is compiled with Homebrew GCC (`scalar_storage_order`), the
  C++ with Apple clang.

## Config / save compatibility

- `launcher.cfg` (key/value text in the `melee-pc` preference directory:
  `~/.local/share/melee-pc`, `%APPDATA%\melee-pc`, or
  `~/Library/Application Support/melee-pc`) loads across versions: unknown
  keys are ignored and missing keys take their defaults.
- Memory cards are Dolphin-compatible `.gci` files and are unchanged by this
  release.
- Gamepad bindings live in aurora's per-device `.controller` files next to
  `launcher.cfg`.
- The pipeline cache (`pipeline_cache.db` in the same directory) is rebuilt as
  needed; deleting it only costs first-use shader stutter.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11 (x86-64 or ARM64): Direct3D 12 feature level 11_0 or Vulkan
  1.1; a Direct3D 11 fallback exists but is unverified.
  Linux (x86-64 or aarch64): Vulkan 1.1. macOS: Metal (Apple Silicon tested).
  Android: arm64 with Vulkan 1.1. iOS 14+: arm64, Metal. Browser: Chrome or
  Edge with WebGPU.
- Keep `resources/` (and on Windows the DLLs) beside the executable.
- A Melee USA 1.02 (GALE01) disc image (`.iso`, `.gcm`, `.ciso` or `.rvz`).

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux x86-64 | `Melee-x86_64.AppImage` | Needs a Vulkan driver. `chmod +x`, then run. |
| Linux x86-64 | `melee-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | Portable directory; run `run.sh`. |
| Linux aarch64 (ARM64) | `Melee-aarch64.AppImage` | For 64-bit ARM Linux (Raspberry Pi 5, Asahi Linux, Orange Pi). |
| Linux aarch64 (ARM64) | `melee-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` | Portable directory for 64-bit ARM Linux; run `run.sh`. |
| Windows x86-64 | `Melee-Windows-x86_64.zip` | Extract and run `melee.exe`. Keep the DLLs and `resources/` beside it. |
| Windows ARM64 | `Melee-Windows-arm64.zip` | Native 64-bit ARM build for Windows on ARM (Snapdragon X Elite, Surface Pro). |
| Android arm64 | `Melee-Android-arm64.apk` | Release build, signed. Allow install from unknown sources. |
| iOS arm64 | `Melee-iOS-arm64.ipa` | Sideloadable IPA (AltStore, Sideloadly, TrollStore) with Metal backend. |
| macOS arm64 | `Melee-macOS-arm64.zip` | Apple Silicon. Ad-hoc signed: right-click > Open on first launch. |
| macOS x86_64 | `Melee-macOS-x86_64.zip` | Intel. Same notes; built but not yet tested on Intel hardware. |
| Browser | [999sian.github.io/melee-pc/play](https://999sian.github.io/melee-pc/play/) | Chrome or Edge with WebGPU. Raw `.iso`/`.gcm` only; no online play. |

Launch with no arguments to open the launcher and pick a disc, or pass the
image path directly:

```sh
./Melee-x86_64.AppImage /path/to/melee.iso
```

## Previous releases

See [earlier releases](https://github.com/999sian/melee-pc/releases) for prior changelogs.

## What works

Every game mode runs. The per-feature list, including what is only partly
done, is the status table in
[README.md](https://github.com/999sian/melee-pc#status); it is the single
source of truth and these notes defer to it.

## Controls

Arrows or WASD = stick, IJKL = C-stick, X = A, Z = B, C = X, V = Y, Q/E = L/R,
Tab = Z, Enter = Start, TFGH = D-pad. Gamepads work through SDL and can be
remapped; an official GameCube adapter is read directly. **F1** opens the
settings overlay.

apps.name: MiniWatts
apps.subtitle: Battery, charging and thermal instrument
apps.localizedDescription: An iPhone battery and charging monitor built on Apple's private APIs: the charger's real watts, how much of that reaches the cell, where the rest goes as heat, and every temperature sensor in the phone. No network code — nothing it reads leaves your phone.

versions.localizedDescription:
Unsigned build — sign it with your own Apple ID before installing.
https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts#install

## 改进

- **温度可以显示为华氏度。** 设置 → 单位 里可选"自动 / °C / °F"。"自动"跟随系统地区，以及"设置 › 通用 › 语言与地区"里的"温度"选项，所以地区使用华氏度的用户升级后会直接看到 °F。App 各页、图表、热力图、悬浮读数、实时活动和小组件都按所选单位显示；原始数据仍显示传感器给出的 °C。(#25)
- **充电预估。** 充电时，功率页会显示充到 80% 和充到 100% 还要多久，以及大约几点。时间根据电量实际上升的速度推算，不依赖电池能量设置；要等电量变化两次才会出现，通常需要几分钟。80% 以后按典型充电曲线估算，只是近似值。(#27)
- **显示版本号。** 设置 → 关于 里显示当前版本，原始数据导出的第一行也带上了版本号。(#27)
- **iPad 布局。** iPad 横屏和 13 英寸竖屏时，各页分成两栏；窄屏时仍是一栏。历史记录里单次充电的详情页在 iPad 上不再横向铺满。(#22)
- **iPad 热力图。** 在 iPad 上，发热页画的是 iPad 的轮廓，各区域按 iPad Pro 11 英寸的内部布局放置：主板在中间，两侧是电芯，充电芯片在 USB-C 接口旁。设备页和设置里的图标也换成了 iPad。(#13, #22)

## 修复

- 发热：CPU 簇（`pACC`、`eACC`）和图像处理器（`ISP`）等传感器以前被归入"其他传感器"，现在算作 SoC，SoC 区域的温度也会把它们算进去。iPhone 11 上 `FrontCameraDie`、`BCMLBSkin` 这类名字连写的传感器以前会被分错区（比如前摄像头被当成机身），现在会先拆词再归类。(#13, #14)
- 适配器页里"单次采样"那段说明以前在中文界面下一直显示英文，现在已有中文。

## 注意

- iPad 相关的改动只在模拟器里验证过，我手上没有 iPad。如果在 iPad 上看到问题，请从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出并反馈。
- iPad 上"来自充电器"的功率偏低（#13）这次还没有修：要确认其余的输入由哪个传感器测量，需要一份**充电时**导出的原始数据。有 iPad 的话，请在充电时从 设置 → 原始数据 复制导出，贴到 #13。
- 充电预估无法知道是否开启了充电上限或优化电池充电。如果开着，电池会在上限前停下，"充到 100%"的时间就不准。

---

## Improvements

- **Temperatures can be shown in Fahrenheit.** Settings → Units offers Automatic, °C or °F. Automatic follows your region and the Temperature option under Settings › General › Language & Region, so if your region uses Fahrenheit you will see °F straight after updating. Every page, the charts, the heat map, the floating meter, the Live Activity and the widget follow the setting; Raw data still shows the sensors' own °C. (#25)
- **Charge forecast.** While charging, the Power page shows how long until 80% and until 100%, and roughly when. It is worked out from how fast the battery level is actually rising, so it does not depend on the battery energy setting; it appears once the level has moved twice, usually within a few minutes. Past 80% it follows a typical charging curve and is approximate. (#27)
- **Version number.** Settings → About shows the installed version, and the first line of the Raw data dump includes it. (#27)
- **iPad layout.** On an iPad in landscape, and a 13-inch in portrait, every page uses two columns; narrower windows keep one. A session's detail page in History no longer stretches edge to edge on an iPad. (#22)
- **iPad heat map.** On an iPad the Thermal page draws an iPad, with the zones placed as in an iPad Pro 11-inch: logic board down the middle, a battery cell either side, the charge IC by the USB-C port. The Devices page and Settings use iPad icons too. (#13, #22)

## Fixes

- Thermal: the CPU-cluster (`pACC`, `eACC`) and image-processor (`ISP`) sensors used to land under "Other sensors"; they now count as the SoC, and the SoC zone's temperature includes them. On an iPhone 11, run-together sensor names such as `FrontCameraDie` and `BCMLBSkin` were filed in the wrong zone (the front camera as chassis); names are now split into words before they are matched. (#13, #14)
- Adapter: the one-sample note always showed in English in the Chinese interface; it is now translated.

## Notes

- The iPad changes were checked in the simulator only — I do not have an iPad. If something looks wrong on yours, copy the dump from Settings → Raw data and report it.
- The low "from charger" reading on an iPad (#13) is not fixed yet: finding which sensor carries the rest of the input needs a Raw data dump taken **while charging**. If you have an iPad, please copy one from Settings → Raw data while it charges and post it on #13.
- The charge forecast cannot tell whether a charge limit or Optimized Battery Charging is on. If one is, the battery stops short and the time to 100% will be wrong.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ResistanceTo/MiniWatts/compare/v1.6.0...v1.7.0

versions.localizedDescription:
# What's New in Mori 4.6.1

### New Features & Enhancements

* **Direct iOS Camera Roll Save (#27)**: Added native Photos framework integration (`saveToCameraRoll`) in AppDelegate to save downloaded videos and photos directly to iOS Camera Roll without third-party dialogs.
* **Full Spanish (es) Localization (#30)**: Added complete Spanish language translation across app UI, tools, settings, and documentation.
* **Chinese Share Link Extraction (#26)**: Added parser preserving extraction codes from Chinese cloud drive and media share captions (Quark, UC, Baidu, 115, Lanzou).
* **Multilingual Documentation**: Added localized README and installation guides for Indonesian (`id`), Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`), and Spanish (`es`) with interactive language switchers.
* **Full i18n Key Synchronization**: Synchronized all 9 locale dictionaries to 630 translation keys and added native Android Indonesian string resources (`values-in`).

### Bug Fixes & Scraper Repairs

* **iOS Auto-Zoom on Input Focus (#31)**: Enforced 16px font sizing and locked viewport scale to prevent WebKit auto-zooming when tapping the input or paste bar.
* **Bilibili Akamai 403 & Stream Headers (#31)**: Injected required Referer (`https://www.bilibili.com/`) and User-Agent headers on Akamai CDN streams, removed universal byte-range header to prevent broken HTTP 206 responses, and added HTML error page detection to stop saving corrupt error responses.
* **Mori CLI Playlist Downloads**: Fixed playlist downloads and dynamic version resolution in `@coflyn/mori` (v1.2.2).

### Performance & Reliability

* **History & Gallery Memory Optimization**: Cached video thumbnails directly to disk via Filesystem, added paginated progressive rendering for large media lists, and removed redundant background scanning loops.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/coflyn/Mori/compare/v4.6.0...v4.6.1

apps.name: Mornye
apps.subtitle: Hi-res music player with downloads
apps.localizedDescription: Mornye is a Flutter and Rust music app with a full-screen player, hi-res and bit-perfect output, synced word-by-word lyrics, and installable extensions for metadata and audio downloads. Downloads and your own music folders share one local library, and SMB, WebDAV, HTTP or Subsonic servers can stream straight to the phone.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What's New

### Added

- **Parametric Equalizer**: Switch between Graphic and Parametric modes with up to 20 custom filters (peak, low shelf, and high shelf; 20 Hz to 20 kHz, +/-24 dB, Q 0.1 to 20), exact numeric entry, and import/export of plain-text AutoEQ-style filter lists (`Preamp` and `Filter` lines). Supported on Desktop, iOS, and Android (via the new playback engine DSP).
- **Personal Home & Dedicated Search Tab**: Home is now always your personal page in both Material and Mornye styles, while Search becomes its own tab/destination opening directly on the extension feed (*Search feed*). On Material Home, the old gray search prompt row was removed so the greeting leads straight into your sections, with a one-time tooltip for existing installs.
- **Recommended for You**: Added a daily cached *"Recommended for you"* shelf on Home suggesting tracks outside your Library based on your most played, recently added, and loved songs.
- **Expanded Home Mixes**: Added **Deep Cuts** and **Year Mix**, daily rotating Artist Mixes and extra genres, balanced variety across mix types, and up to 12 mixes on Home. *On repeat* falls back to Library albums when there is no listening history yet.
- **Home Shows Your Collection & Edit Home**: Home gains a status line under the greeting (songs added since your last visit, downloads in progress), *Finish your collection* (wishlist songs, albums missing songs, recognized songs not in your Library, failed downloads), a Hi-Res shelf while a DAC or exclusive output plays, and a row for a connected Link device. *Edit Home* at the end of the page reorders sections and shows or hides them; *Finish your collection* and *On repeat* start turned off.
- **Pin to Home & Your Own Shortcuts**: Pin albums, playlists, Loved, artists, genres, and folders to Home with a long press in the Library (up to 12), and remove any Home shortcut, the built-in ones included, so the grid can hold only what you picked.
- **Quick Play on Home**: A grid of nine songs from your Library sits under *Shortcuts* (under *Continue listening* in the Mornye style), and one tap plays a song with the other eight queued after it. It leads with the songs you play most and fills up with picks from your Library that change each day, and it can be moved or hidden in *Edit Home*.
- **Recommendations That Learn More**: With *Personalized autoplay* on, *Recommended for you* puts the songs that fit your taste first, Autoplay and mixes place songs you have not played yet through their album, credited artists, and genre, and learning now knows whether you listen on the speaker, wired headphones, Bluetooth, a DAC, a car, or another device. *Settings > Playback* shows how your mixes and recommendations are received once there is enough to measure. Everything stays on your device.
- **Cast to DLNA and FCast Devices**: Besides Google Cast, the app now finds DLNA / UPnP speakers and TVs and FCast receivers on your Wi-Fi network and plays your queue on them with play, pause, seek, and volume. On Android, *Audio Output* gains *Other TVs and speakers* under *Cast to TV*; on iOS and desktop they appear in the same list as Google Cast devices.
- **Update Metadata Over Mornye Link**: Songs you saved from a connected computer or phone can take the tag changes made there since. *Update metadata* on the Link page lists the saved songs that differ, shows each differing tag as the value on this phone and the value on the other device with its own switch, and changes nothing until you confirm.
- **Albums in Mornye Top Picks**: *Top Picks for You* on the Mornye Home now offers albums next to your mixes, each as a tall card whose cover runs on into a soft blur under the title, and the color backgrounds of mix banners now drift gently (they stay still when the system asks for reduced motion and on low-end devices).
- **Recommendations by Genre & Top Picks Page**: The arrow next to *Recommended for you* on Home opens a page with today's suggestions and a shelf for each of your Library's main genres. On the Mornye Home, the arrow next to *Top Picks for You* opens every pick sorted onto its own shelf: *Made for You*, *From your Library*, *New releases*, and the picks of your Home feed extension.
- **Full Profile Page**: Tapping your profile in Settings now opens a complete listener profile with *All time* totals and streaks, *Last 30 days* activity, *Last 12 months*, *Music taste* by genre with a color for each, *Listening habits*, *Time of day*, *Decades*, *Sound quality*, *Top artists/albums/tracks*, and collection counts (profile editing moved to *Edit profile*). *Now playing* shows how far the song has played, and *Listener type* describes you with up to five of 22 traits (such as *Night owl*, *Jazz at heart*, *Throwback lover*, or *Quick skipper*); the two leading ones also show under your name and on the Settings profile row.
- **Share Your Profile**: *Share profile* turns your profile into a story or square image with your photo, your leading listener type in large type, listening time, music taste, top artists and tracks, and sound quality. Choose what shows and the background, then save or share it.
- **Download Focus Mode (External Player)**: Selecting *External player* hides built-in-player-only UI across Home, Library, Profile, and Settings without deleting your queue, listening history, or preferences, focusing the app on downloading and file management.
- **Manual Lyrics Translation Editor & Readable Tags**: Add and edit lyrics translations by hand directly from the player. Saved translations and romanizations now write as readable plain-text tags (`[x-translated:...]`, `[x-romanized:...]`, `[x-translated-words:...]`) in `.mlrc` (`[x-mlrc:2]`) and embedded tags while staying backward-compatible with legacy base64 tags.
- **Customizable Share Lyrics Cards**: Added a *Style* pane with card shapes (**Story** 1080x1920, **Square** 1080x1080, **Wide** 1920x1080), text sizes (**Small / Auto / Large**), alignment options, and a **Save** button to export as PNG without storage permissions.
- **Share a Song's Name or Link**: *Share* on a song now offers **Share name** and **Share link**. Share link looks the song up on your installed extensions and shares its link on the service you pick.
- **Lock Screen Lyrics Title Option**: Added *"Keep the song title"* under *Lyrics on lock screen* so the active lyric line replaces the artist field while keeping the song title visible.
- **Full-Screen Cover Controls**: Added **Whole cover** (keeps full-screen artwork square at full width without side cropping) and **Cover fade** (**Short / Medium / Long**). On Mornye, still full-screen covers now end with a soft blur transitioning into a matching solid edge color.
- **Direct USB DAC Resampling & Rate Cap**: Automatically resamples tracks whose native sample rate a DAC rejects using a Kaiser windowed sinc polyphase filter (130 dB stopband, triangular dither for 16-bit output), reads UAC2 clock ranges, remembers working rates per DAC, and adds a **Highest sample rate** setting in Direct USB. A **Dither type** choice (**TPDF** or **TPDF HP**) picks the dither added to converted songs on a 16-bit output; TPDF HP moves the added noise to high frequencies where it is harder to hear.
- **AutoMix Beat Matching**: Added a *Beat matching* setting (**Standard**, **More often**, **Most often**) controlling how often AutoMix aligns beats between tracks, synced across devices via Link.
- **Simple Audio Quality Label**: Added a **Simple** audio quality badge mode (*Hi-Res*, *Lossless*, *Dolby*, or format name) for the Library and full player.
- **Multi-Track Authenticity Chart**: Batch Hi-Res / authenticity checks now overlay average spectra on one shared chart with color-blind-safe per-track colors.
- **Drag-to-Select Songs**: After a long press selects a song, slide your finger up or down to select or deselect multiple songs with automatic edge scrolling.
- **CSV Import with Track Links**: Supports `URL`, `Link`, `Track URL`, and `Track Link` columns (including album and playlist links) via matching extensions, with ISRC and stricter title/artist fallbacks.
- **Library, Queue & Desktop Actions**: Apply one cover image to all selected songs in *Set common values*; added *Re-download* and *Copy title* on track details; added copy/open-album actions for downloads and desktop library items, delete on the desktop album selection bar, desktop scroll arrows for Home shelves and Equalizer band faders, and extension names on verification prompts. *Up Next* gains a button that saves the whole queue, in its order, to a new or existing playlist.
- **Animation Speed Setting**: Added *Settings > Appearance > Animation speed* (0.5x to 2x) governing page transitions, player motion, sheets, snackbars, banners, and UI animations.
- **Turn Quiet Songs Up**: *Volume normalization* used to only turn loud songs down, so songs mastered quietly stayed quiet and the app sounded softer than other players. The new *Turn quiet songs up* switch under it raises those songs too, by up to 12 dB. On phones and Macs a limiter holds back their loudest moments; on Windows and Linux they may clip.

### Improved

- **Material 3 Motion & Scrolling**: Material pages now push solidly with distance-driven fade, pop as a receding card, follow the Android **predictive back gesture** live, and cache scaled transition frames as pictures to eliminate glyph-atlas jank. The Material full-screen player expands and collapses as one solid expressive spring surface, and Android Material lists use native Android fling physics while keeping bounce at both ends. A song's cover now flies back to its row on a back swipe, just as it does on a back press.
- **Mornye / Apple HIG Liquid Glass Alignment**: Removed Liquid Glass from content surfaces (reserving it for navigation and controls), adopted Cupertino buttons, menus, activity indicators, grouped settings lists, and expanded Cupertino icons, unified Liquid Glass springs, and removed staggered row delays on Mornye lists. Mornye's glass now follows the iOS 27 look on the tab bar, mini player, and controls at the default *Glass clarity*, and switch and slider thumbs turn to glass while you hold them.
- **Material 3 Expressive Consistency**: Connected option rows across song lists, search results, artists, albums, playlists, menus, loading skeletons, track details, and all bottom sheets; solid container colors without extra outlines; auto-widened menus and content-sized sheets; start-aligned plain lyrics and cleaner instant-apply search sorting; the desktop player bar gains shuffle and repeat beside the playback buttons, and its other buttons join one connected group in which Lyrics and Up Next fill while their panel is open.
- **Roomier Page Headers**: On phones, album, playlist, and folder pages show at most two buttons at the top and keep the other actions, such as saving songs to this phone or keeping them offline, in one menu, so the buttons no longer sit against each other.
- **Play From Search**: Tapping a song in Search that you already have now plays it, instead of only saying it is already in your Library.
- **Shorter Settings With an External Player**: With *External player* chosen, Settings leads with what shapes a download, hides the categories that only serve the built-in player, and offers the player choice as one row. Link stays listed once it is set up.
- **Accessibility & RTL**: Enforced an 11 pt minimum text floor, full touch targets, and proper RTL mirroring for navigation, sliders, and Rewind taps. Theme changes switch at once when the system asks for reduced motion. Album and artist headers show the still cover instead of the motion cover when the system asks for reduced motion.
- **Smaller Packages Across Platforms**: Icon tree-shaking, stripped unused font axes, compact binary pinyin data, trimmed concert timezone data, deduplicated LGPL license text, desktop code compiled out of mobile builds, Android resource/asset shrinking, dropped FFmpegKit plugin on macOS/Linux desktop, and size-optimized Rust builds (keeping FLAC decoding and the extension JS engine at full speed, without UniFFI on desktop, and with trimmed SQLite).
- **Faster Start**: The app opens sooner. It reads your settings once, checks storage after the first screen, and on phones starts Mornye Link only once you use it. The home screen widget no longer holds up the app when the launcher refreshes it.
- **Smoother Player**: Opening, closing and changing songs take less work in the full player, the mini player, the lock screen controls and the widget, and a song's colours now change together with its cover. Menus over the player, motion covers, lyrics with word timing and the equalizer curve take less work too.
- **Lighter Home & Pages**: Home no longer reloads after every download or for sections you hid. Album, playlist and folder pages keep their header steady as you scroll, Mornye *Top Picks* banners rest while out of sight, and Library covers fade in at your *Animation speed*.
- **Faster Library & Search**: Scans read most covers together with the tags. In a large Library, searching albums, artists and lyrics, sorting by size and cleaning up History are faster, and History no longer locks up when several things save at once.
- **Smoother Desktop**: Resizing the window, sliding the sidebar or the Lyrics and Up Next panels, and moving the pointer over track lists no longer redraw the whole window, and covers decode once at the size they show. Dropping many files no longer stalls the window, and resizing the borderless Mac window by its edges is smoother.
- **Downloads, NAS & Mornye Link**: Long download queues start without a pause and keep less in memory. NAS folder scans update their counter four times a second, Subsonic servers scan faster, and Mornye Link shares a large Library sooner. Songs that Direct USB resamples start sooner, and extension icons show at once.
- **Dependencies & Toolchains**: Updated Flutter to 3.50.1, FFmpegKit to 3.0.0 (FFmpeg 8.1.3), Android Gradle Plugin to 9.5.2, Gradle to 9.9.2, AndroidX Lifecycle to 2.11.1, and Rust and Dart dependencies.

### Fixed

- **Closing the Material Player**: Closing the full player with the back gesture now flies the cover into the mini player, as the close button and the back button do, instead of sliding it down with the page. The player also closes as quickly as it opens, the cover no longer jumps in size when you let go of a drag, and closing the player again while it is still opening takes the cover straight back.
- **Previous Song When Closing the Player**: After you skip songs in the full player, closing it no longer shows the previous song's cover and title in the mini player for a moment before they fade to the new song.
- **Music After a Call on Android**: Music paused by a call now plays on once the call ends, also after calls in other apps that never hand the sound back, and it waits until the call has fully ended. If the song does not move when it starts again, it reloads at the same spot, so a skip is no longer needed to get it playing.
- **Playback, Previews & Cast**: Re-fetches expired preview URLs and falls back across extensions; respects *Metadata Priority* when opening artists or albums; eliminated cover flicker/blink when opening track details or collections; falls back to embedded artwork when web covers fail; preserves the last session when the system stops playback; fixes continuing through an album or playlist from a local tap; keeps Android awake and advances cleanly to the next track on Cast; fixes black screen from lingering touches after closing the player; keeps Mornye player corners rounded while moving; lines up the song title and buttons with the small cover above the Mornye lyrics and Up Next; shows a single cover while the Mornye player closes onto the mini player, also when the page is scrolled meanwhile; and aligns album descriptions under the sheet's rounded top edge. On iPhone, iPad and Mac, moving an equalizer control no longer lets a moment of sound through without the equalizer, which could be heard as a small tick.
- **Search Opening on Recent Searches**: If you had turned the feed off to see your own Home, Search now opens on the feed again instead of only your recent searches. You can still turn it off under *Search feed*.
- **Home With an External Player**: A tap on a *Recently added* song on Home now opens it in your chosen player instead of the built-in one.
- **Direct USB DAC**: Keeps playing when another app plays a sound, pausing only for a call; releases idle DACs so other apps retain audio, restores initial DAC volume on exit, downloads network tracks fully before USB playback, and handles smaller USB endpoints reliably.
- **Lyrics & Translations**: Lyric lines follow the sung language direction while translations follow their own setting; aligned translation editor rows and icon; fixed Android pinyin data loading.
- **Network & Link**: Automatically rebinds the local playback proxy after iOS closes its listener, and keeps manually typed computer addresses in Link instead of overwriting them with discovery results.
- **Downloads & Platforms**: Keeps failed downloads in the queue across restarts; keeps download and Library scan progress updating on Android after the system closes the app's window while music keeps playing; allows absolute Windows download directories in the extension sandbox; fixes the Android player widget prior to Android 12; fixes dragged row offset under UI scaling; releases desktop audio devices cleanly on exit and keeps outputs open across gapless track changes; fixes desktop crashes when moving windows across displays; disables Impeller automatically on Linux with NVIDIA drivers and aligns the Linux system unwinder; the Play button on desktop album and playlist pages is as tall as the buttons beside it again. In the Material style on iPhone and iPad, pulling a list down to refresh no longer opens a gap under its pinned title.

MoviePilot 现已全面提供 **iOS / iPadOS**、**Android** 与 **HarmonyOS NEXT** 三端全原生客户端（统一版本 **`2.0.4`**），基于 Rust 共享业务内核直连 MoviePilot V3 后端，带来一致的核心功能闭环与地道原生界面体验。

### 本版本核心亮点

- **媒体服务器优先直连播放与跨端实时进度同步**：
  - 支持客户端探测并优先直连媒体服务器（LAN / WAN 媒体流直通），当不具备直连条件或探测超时时自动平滑回退至 MoviePilot 后台代理流，显著降低中转服务器带宽压力。
  - 新增媒体服务器账号绑定与三端实时播放进度同步（起播、定时心跳、暂停、拖拽与停止上报），多端无缝续播。

  - 本地与存储音频全面支持基于 HTTP Range 票据的边加载边播放与锁屏播控体验，同时优化 SMB 存储流式下载兼容性。
  - 三端音乐播放全面支持读取音频文件内嵌封面与内嵌歌词（支持 FLAC `VORBIS_COMMENT`/`PICTURE`、ID3v2.2~2.4 `APIC`/`USLT`/`SYLT`/`TXXX`、MP4/M4A `covr`/`©lyr` 及 Ogg Vorbis/Opus），兼容同步 LRC 与无时间轴纯文本歌词，并联动动态取色、迷你播控条与系统锁屏封面。
- **三端原生弹幕系统**：
  - 视频播放器内置原生弹幕渲染层，支持后端弹幕配置、剧集匹配与手动切换、开关控制、字号/透明度/速度/显示区域/时间偏移调节以及画中画自动避让，并对旧版后端提供友好升级提示。
- **Vue 联邦插件本地预热运行时与全量原生能力桥接**：
  - 推出零前端端口依赖的本地预热联邦运行时（`mp-plugin://shell/`），通过热池复用、实例隔离磁盘缓存、零令牌原生代发 API 与四层透明视觉融合大幅提升插件首开速度与视觉一致性，并保留兼容网页容器一键回退开关。
  - 全面向 Vue 联邦插件开放移动端本地原生能力（录音、流式音频播放与锁屏播控、相机拍照、相册/文件读写、剪贴板、震动、屏幕常亮、原生 Toast/确认框与标题栏动作桥接），优化移动端竖屏响应式布局。

apps.name: NusaNX
apps.subtitle: Convert Switch game containers into native iOS/iPadOS apps on device
apps.localizedDescription: Transforms legal Nintendo Switch game containers (.nsp/.xci) into standalone native iOS/iPadOS apps directly on-device — ARM64 game code runs natively while Switch NVN/OpenGL shaders are translated to Apple Metal. Requires an M1 iPad or A17 Pro iPhone with iOS/iPadOS 26 or newer.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Fixed & Improved

    - Fixed a file picker bug.
    - Fixed excessive texture re-uploads causing severe FPS drops in Grand Bazaar and Other Games.
   
    ## Experimental

    - Added on-device `.nup` support, including updates and DLC.
    - Some shaders and character textures may still appear black.
    - Game compatibility varies; LiveContainer may require the file picker fix.

    ## Requirements

    **For running converted games:**
    - **iPad:** Apple M1 chip or later, running iPadOS 26.0 or later.
    - **iPhone:** A17 Pro chip or later, running iOS 26.0 or later.
    - Metal 4 support.

    **For conversion and installation:**
    - Your own legally obtained game dumps.
    - Your own `prod.keys` for encrypted game containers.
    - Sufficient free storage for extraction and IPA generation.
    - A signing and sideloading method for unsigned IPA packages.

    ## Installation

    1. Download `NusaNX.ipa` from the release assets.
    2. Sign and sideload the converter using your preferred method.
    3. Import your `prod.keys` and a supported `.nsp` or `.xci` game dump.
    4. Build the game's IPA, then sign and sideload it separately.

    ## Known Limitations

    - This is a beta release; stability, performance, and compatibility vary by game and
    device.
    - Successful conversion does not guarantee that a game will boot or run correctly.
    - `.nup` import is not currently supported by the iPad converter.
    - The Xbox controller mapping fix is included in this build, but still requires
    physical-controller testing.
    - Both the converter and generated IPA packages are unsigned.

    ## Legal Notice

    No Nintendo firmware, decryption keys, or game assets are included. Use only game dumps
    and keys you are legally authorized to use.

    This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo.

apps.localizedDescription: A lightweight YouTube client with SponsorBlock, Return YouTube Dislike, and up to 1080p playback. No ads, no tracking, no dependencies.

versions.localizedDescription:
**New**

- Hold anywhere on the video to seek ([#116](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/116)). Press and hold on the picture, then drag sideways. The seek bar follows your finger and the video jumps where you let go, so you no longer have to hit the thin bar at the bottom. The taps you already know still work: the sides seek, the middle pauses.
- Search inside a channel ([#117](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/117)). Channel pages have a magnifier now, and whatever you type there searches that channel only. YouTube serves no filters for this kind of search, so there are none in the app either.
- Get a downloaded video out of the app ([#115](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/115)). The menu on a downloaded video has a new "Save to Files" row that hands the file to the usual iOS share sheet, so it can go to Files, Photos, AirDrop or another app. It is named after the video, and only the video leaves: subtitles, comments and the saved page stay where they were.
- Clear the whole search history at once ([#121](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/121)). The last row under Recent searches wipes the list, and it asks first.

**Fixes**

- The mini player no longer sits on top of the tab bar ([#118](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/118)). Tapping a tab behind the collapsed player switches to that tab instead of reopening the video.
- Stereo no longer gets spatialized on AirPods ([#119](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/119)). Ordinary two-channel sound was being turned into a fake surround field that moved when you turned your head. Video that really is multichannel still spatializes.
- The "..." menu stops closing on its own ([#128](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/128)). It was reacting to the device being tilted or put down, which made it look random when you held the phone in your hand.

**Also**

- If your device is older than Opaline supports, the README now points at [a downport for iOS 9](https://github.com/Joeviocoe/Opaline) by another developer, which runs on the iPad 2, iPad 3, iPad mini and iPhone 4S ([#125](https://github.com/verback2308/Opaline/issues/125)).

apps.name: Orchard
apps.subtitle: Apple Silicon macOS Ventura running inside an iPhone app
apps.localizedDescription: Boots a real arm64 macOS Ventura guest on iPhone through Apple's own chain (AVPBooter, iBoot and XNU) on QEMU's apple-vm machine, with the GPU drawn through Metal by reims-vgpu. Requires JIT, a signing tool that adds the increased memory limit, and a macOS VM you make yourself. It is slow — light scenes reach 30–40 fps at best.

versions.localizedDescription:
Orchard for iPhone 0.2: a faster emulator and a faster Metal path, plus a fix for guests that end up in Recovery.

Setup and settings: [README](https://github.com/MakrSas/orchard-ios#readme).

## Faster

On an iPhone 15 (A16), light scenes now reach 30–40 frames a second. Dragging a window runs at 10–15 frames a second (in 0.1 it dropped to around 7 once the Dock and menu bar were up).

- **CPU (QEMU TCG)**
  - The jump cache is bigger and better hashed, and keeps each process's blocks across context switches. Block-lookup misses fell from ~15% to ~3%.
  - Changing ASID flushes only the user half of the TLB.
  - The PMU is off, and fewer system-register writes end a translation block or flush the TLB.
- **Fast pointer authentication** (on by default, in Settings → Machine → Processor). The guest still sees PAC, but no signature is computed. That was 10–15% of the emulator's time. Turn it off if macOS stops booting.
- **Metal path (reims-vgpu)**
  - A guest render pass stays on the GPU as one Metal pass, instead of a GPU round trip, a full-frame readback and a re-upload for every draw.
  - Draw buffers come from a shared ring.
  - Shader keys hash faster.
  - Stores write back only the drawn area, with a NEON channel swap straight into guest pages.
- **Tip:** 960×540 at 30 Hz is the sweet spot. In the guest, Reduce transparency helps dragging windows.

## Fixed

- **Guest stuck in Recovery with no disk.** This was macOS installing an automatic update, which cannot complete on this machine. Turn automatic updates off first thing; the README has the settings and the Terminal commands.
- **Disk safety.** The disk is flushed when the app goes to the background and on Shut Down, and the log records guest flushes and I/O errors.

## Also since 0.1

- Sound (experimental, Settings → Machine → Sound).
- A shared folder: Files → Orchard → Shared, mounted in the guest at `http://10.0.2.2:8080`.
- Internet in the guest works.

## You need

- iOS 16 or later, tested on an iPhone 15 with iOS 27, and a phone with 6 GB of memory or more.
- A signing tool that adds the increased memory limit capability, and JIT (such as StikDebug).
- A macOS 13 VM made in UTM on a Mac.

Unofficial, and not affiliated with Apple or ChefKiss. No Apple software is included. Licences: see LICENSE-NOTICE.md.

apps.name: Photos Backup
apps.subtitle: On-device Google Photos backup
apps.localizedDescription: An experimental, fully on-device iPhone app for backing up selected photos, videos, and albums to Google Photos.

versions.localizedDescription:
## New

- **Keep Running in Background.** On by default, in **Settings → Background**. While a backup has work iOS won't move on its own, the app keeps itself from being suspended the way SideStore does, by playing silence mixed with whatever else is playing. No permission is needed, and the backup keeps going with the app closed or the phone locked. When the queue is done, after 12 hours, or if iOS interrupts it, it stops and the app sleeps again. If calls or music keep stopping it, switch **Method** to **Location**, which asks for location permission and uses coarse updates instead. ([#2](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/2), [#41](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/41))

- **Backup keeps going after you leave the app (iOS 26), for real this time.** 0.3.7's IPA was built with Xcode 16.4, which left this feature out, so there was no Live Activity. Releases are now built with Xcode 26.3. ([#39](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/39))

- **An edited video's original is backed up too**, so the Google Photos app counts it, including Cinematic videos, which the camera saves as edited. ([#38](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/38), thanks @saileshbro)

- **Back Up Live Photo Motion is now on by default.** ([#38](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/38))

## Fixed

- **The app forgot what it had already backed up.** ([#34](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/34), [#22](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/22), [#40](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/40), thanks @josippapez) The app forgot every photo iOS reported as changed, and iOS reports a lot more than edits: favourites, albums, and the photo analysis it redoes on the whole library after an iOS update. One report had a single background window forget 36,615 backups. A photo is now only re-checked when its edit actually changed, and photos backed up before this release keep their record.

- **Big backups are much lighter on CPU and disk.** ([#13](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/13), [#34](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/34), [#42](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/42)) Uploads were hashing one file at a time, and the queue was rewritten to disk several times a second. That's what iOS was closing the app for in the reports. Hashing now runs alongside the uploads, and the queue is saved at most once a second.

- **The screen stays on while a backup runs in the app** if Keep Running in Background is off. With it on, the phone can lock normally. ([#37](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/37))

- **The Activity tab is fast on big backups.** ([#8](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/issues/8), [#42](https://github.com/g8row/PhotosBackup/pull/42)) It drew a row for every item in the queue. It now shows what's in progress or failed, the next 20 and the last 50 finished, and says how many more there are.

## Worth knowing

- **If your progress already reset on 0.3.7**, the first launch may go over those photos once more. Most settle without uploading anything, and it shouldn't happen again.
- **Keep Running in Background uses more battery**, and swiping the app away in the app switcher still stops it. Charging overnight is still the best time for a big backup.
- The diagnostic report now has a **Keep-alive** line saying whether it was running.

## Notes

- 208 tests, 206 passing (2 opt-in live tests skipped).
- Tested on iOS 26.5 and 18.6 simulators. Not tested on a device yet. If something is off, **Settings → Support → Create Diagnostic Report** and attach it to an issue.

versions.localizedDescription:
# Playport 0.5.0: World of Warcraft, Red Dead Redemption 2, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered and touch controls
<!-- date: 2026-11-02 -->

**This is the big one. World of Warcraft is on your iPhone.** Install it straight from
Blizzard through Playport's new **Battle.net** store, sign in and step into Azeroth. **Red
Dead Redemption 2** rides out of Arthur's cabin, **The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered**
plays in Kaer Morhen, and **no controller is needed any more**: on-screen touch controls
with three layouts, a full layout editor, a touch keyboard, controller mapping and gyro
aim. Add a redesigned Library, a performance overlay and Vulkan for every game.

> **❤️ Playport is free, and it stays free. If it put a PC game in your pocket, please
> consider [supporting it on Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/playportdev).** Getting World of
> Warcraft, Red Dead Redemption 2 and The Witcher 3 running on a phone took a lot of work,
> and every donation buys time for the next release: more games and more fixes.
>
> [![Support Playport on Ko-fi](https://img.shields.io/badge/Support_Playport-on_Ko--fi-FF5E5B?style=for-the-badge&logo=kofi&logoColor=white)](https://ko-fi.com/playportdev)
>
> A donation is a gift: it buys no licence, no extra rights and no different build, and
> everyone may keep sharing Playport under its licence.

**Updated IPA (2 November 2026).** The 0.5.0 IPA was replaced with a build that adds three
fixes:

- 32-bit games that unpack their own code at start-up (The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth, The
  Witcher 2) no longer crash before their first frame.
- Playport's Steam client now gives a game Steam's ownership ticket, so The Witcher 2's DRM
  check passes.
- A tap on a launcher's window goes to what you see under your finger: The Witcher 2
  launcher's **Launch game** works.

If you installed 0.5.0 before this, download it again. `SHA256SUMS` lists the new files.

![World of Warcraft in the world with the on-screen Keyboard & mouse controls and the performance overlay](https://playport.dev/screenshots/wow-touch.webp)

## Highlights

### ⚔️ World of Warcraft, from Battle.net
**Battle.net is now a store in Playport**, next to Steam, GOG and Epic Games, and World of
Warcraft shows in everyone's Library. No Battle.net app and no sign-in in Playport: pick
the game, press Install, and Playport downloads it from Blizzard's own servers.

- **Retail, Classic, Classic Era and Classic Anniversary**, each with a region picker (US,
  Europe, Korea or Taiwan; your phone's region by default) and a language. Playport checks
  the free space before it starts and installs through Downloads, with pause, resume and
  cancel.
- **Always up to date:** every Play checks for a new build first and updates through
  Downloads, then plays. *Check for update* sits on the game's page too.
- **The game signs itself in**, as on a PC. The in-game menu's new **Type text** opens a
  field over the game for your email, password and authenticator code, with paste and
  AutoFill.
- **It plays.** In our testing World of Warcraft reaches its login screen within about
  45 seconds of Play and runs in the world at **55–60 FPS**.
- **Your game, untouched:** Playport runs Blizzard's own Windows client through its
  translator and changes none of the game's files and none of its code in memory. Before
  the first Play it tells you plainly that Blizzard does not support Playport.

![The Library's Battle.net store with World of Warcraft](https://playport.dev/screenshots/library-battlenet.webp)

### 🤠 Red Dead Redemption 2 rides
Press Play and Rockstar's own launcher starts, signs in, hands the game its ticket and gets
out of the way. Social Club runs on Rockstar's own components, so the game stays signed in
and saves as it should. One press on Story and you are in Arthur's cabin, on the frontier,
on a phone.

![Arthur Morgan in a winter coat on a snowy cabin porch, snow-covered pines beyond](https://playport.dev/screenshots/rdr2.webp)

### 🐺 The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered plays
The remastered 4.x build of The Witcher 3 used to stop the moment it started: it needs
AVX instructions the phone could not offer and asks for far more memory space than an
iPhone app gets. Playport now handles both, and Geralt is back in Kaer Morhen, on the
game's Direct3D 12 renderer. The classic 1.32 build still plays as before.

![Geralt walking through a hall of Kaer Morhen past a lit fireplace](https://playport.dev/screenshots/witcher3-remastered.webp)

### 🎮 On-screen controls: play with nothing but the phone
No controller? Playport draws its **on-screen controls** over the game. Connect a controller
and they step aside; disconnect it and they come back (*Settings › Controls*: Automatic,
Always or Never).

- **Three layouts, plus Off:** **Gamepad** (sticks, d-pad, A/B/X/Y, bumpers, triggers, View
  and Menu), **Keyboard & mouse** (a W A S D stick, drag anywhere free to look, key caps
  around your thumb) and **Point & click** (tap to click or use it as a trackpad, with a
  magnifier for small targets, plus right click, hover, scroll, keys and Esc).
- **A three-finger tap** anywhere opens Playport's in-game menu, with any layout. The first
  time the controls appear on their own, a toast says so.
- **The layout editor:** add, move, resize, duplicate and remove controls on a grid with
  snapping guides, undo, reset and switch presets, by touch or with a controller, over the
  paused game or from *Game options › Controls*. Each game keeps its own layout and its own
  opacity.
- **A suggested starting layout:** a game that never asks for a controller in its first
  20 seconds is offered Keyboard & mouse, once.
- **A touch keyboard** over the game, with F keys, arrows and sticky Shift, Ctrl and Alt,
  for consoles, names and the keys a layout lacks.
- **Any controller as a keyboard and mouse:** *Game options › Controls › Controller* maps
  every button, stick, trigger and gyro to a controller input, a key with modifiers, a
  mouse button, mouse movement or the wheel, or a Playport action. Pick **As a controller**,
  **As keyboard & mouse** or **Custom**.
- **Gyro aim:** aim by moving the phone, or a DualSense, DualShock 4 or Switch Pro
  controller, as the mouse or the right stick, per game, with sensitivity, smoothing and a
  test area to try it before you play.

![The layout editor over World of Warcraft, editing the Keyboard & mouse layout](https://playport.dev/screenshots/touch-editor.webp)

![World of Warcraft on a ship's deck with a blue dragon mount, with the on-screen Gamepad layout](https://playport.dev/screenshots/wow-gamepad.webp)

### 📚 A redesigned Library
The stores are now **a column of icons down the Library's left**: All, Steam, GOG, Epic
Games and Battle.net, every one always there (a store you are signed out of is dimmed).
The chosen store's name and game count sit above the grid, and **Installed only** narrows
any of them with one tap. With a controller, press left from the first column to reach the
stores, or step through them from anywhere with LT and RT.

![The Library with All games and the store column](https://playport.dev/screenshots/library-0.5.webp)

### 📊 A performance overlay
A small pill at the top of the game shows the **frame rate, the frame time and your phone's
thermal state**. Turn it on from the in-game menu or *Settings › Graphics*, and it stays on
for every game. It replaces Apple's Metal HUD, which cost CPU time on every frame.

## Also new
- **Vulkan is every game's graphics backend.** Direct3D 9, 10, 11 and 12 now run on Vulkan
  over Metal by default. DXMT stays one choice away in *Settings › Graphics › Direct3D* or
  on the game's page.
- **Quicker launches:** shaders are compiled faster for Metal on iOS 27, and what the
  graphics backends and the code translator have done is kept on disk, so a second launch
  skips the first one's work. *Settings › Storage › Shader cache* shows the space and
  clears it.
- **OpenGL games run**, through Mesa's Zink on Vulkan, in 64-bit and 32-bit games alike.
- **More room for big games:** each Play's memory is planned from your phone's memory and
  the game's needs, freed memory is reused, and *Settings › Graphics › Donor memory*
  (Auto by default) lets a game use more than the app alone could hold.
- **Steam for 32-bit games too:** Playport's own Steam client now serves 32-bit games the
  same sign-in, ownership check and online tickets as 64-bit ones. **Repair** fetches
  missing Steamworks Shared files.
- **Games get what they need, from Play:** an *Installing dependencies* step runs a game's
  own prerequisite installer once, fetches Steam's or GOG's redistributables, and carries
  Wine Mono for .NET games.
- **Publisher launchers:** Rockstar's launcher runs for the games that need it, and a
  game's own launcher and dialog windows show instead of an empty screen.
- **Type text** in the in-game menu sends typing, paste and AutoFill to the game's focused
  field, with a password mode.
- **Graphics choices are cleaner:** *Aspect ratio* and *Resolution* are separate, and a
  game can carry its own compatibility defaults (Super Meat Boy's 16:9, Assassin's Creed's
  Keyboard & mouse layout).
- **Screenshot** works over Vulkan games, and games that change display mode keep showing.
- **Settings scrolls** on a landscape phone; *Storage* lists Steamworks Shared, the shader
  cache and the translator's cache with their sizes.
- **Newer components:** Wine 11.20 with Valve's latest Proton Wine changes, and current
  FEX (the translator that runs x86 code on the phone), DXMT, DXVK, vkd3d-proton and Mesa.

## Games
The [compatibility list](https://playport.dev/compatibility/) carries every game we and
players have tried. Running since 0.4.0:

- **Runs:** Among Us, Assassin's Creed: Director's Cut Edition, BioShock (GOG), Monster
  Train (GOG), Duck Paradox (GOG), Spelunky (GOG), Tomb Raider: Anniversary (GOG), Super
  Meat Boy (Epic), Soccer Online: Ball 3D, #DRIVE Rally, Castle Crashers (demo), Cat Mail
  Co. (demo) and Football Manager 2022's Resource Archiver.
- **Runs, with issues listed on their pages:** Counter-Strike and Half-Life (OpenGL),
  Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition (GOG), Tomb Raider (2013), DiRT 3 Complete Edition,
  House of Golf 2 (Epic), and the three in the highlights: World of Warcraft, Red Dead
  Redemption 2 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered.

## Good to know
- **World of Warcraft needs your Battle.net account** with an active subscription; the
  game's own login checks it. Blizzard does not support Playport, and an action on your
  account is possible: Playport asks you to accept that once before the first Play.
- **World of Warcraft is big:** retail needs about 132 GB of free space, Classic about
  80 GB and Classic Era about 5 GB. Our testing covered retail. Busy cities and raids may
  run slower than the open world.
- **Red Dead Redemption 2 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered push the phone to its
  limits.** Both run close to the app's memory limit and need the increased memory limit
  from your sideloader. Both heat the phone, and their frame rate drops as it warms;
  expect long loads and hitches. Red Dead Redemption 2 installs about 120 GB, and we test
  Story mode only, never Red Dead Online. In bright light some highlights look wrong (a
  white beard brim, a red ear).
- **Vulkan is the default now.** If a game looks or behaves worse than on 0.4.0, switch it
  to **DXMT** on its page (*Game options › Graphics › Direct3D*) and tell us which game.
- **On-screen controls:** without a controller, the three-finger tap is the only way into
  the in-game menu. In some games' menus a Point & click tap moves the highlight without
  opening the item (Portal 2's). A game may show controller prompts while the layout is
  Off. Gyro aim drives the game's own stick or mouse, so a game's own aim settings still
  apply.
- **Big games keep needing memory,** and a game that wants more than the phone can hold
  still ends.
- **Tested on one phone** (iOS 27.2). If a game misbehaves, *Report a problem* on its page
  shares one zip with its logs.
- Your games, saves and logins are untouched by this update; install over 0.4.0.

## Install

Download `Playport-0.5.0.ipa` and sideload it with your own Apple ID, keeping the
increased memory limit and the JIT helper extension. If you have an earlier version,
install over it: your games, saves and logins stay. Bring your own games from Steam, GOG,
Epic Games or Files, or install World of Warcraft from Battle.net.

The complete Corresponding Source of this exact build, the notices and the rebuild
instructions are attached as `Playport-0.5.0-source.tar`, `NOTICES.tar` and
`INSTALL-REBUILD.tar`. `SHA256SUMS` covers every file.
