versions.localizedDescription:
# RewindBox 0.0.11 — Build 721

Everything since RewindBox 0.0.10 (Build 559), brought together in one update.

## 🎮 PlayStation 3 — RPCS3

- **Assassin’s Creed:** audio mixing corrections prevent audio periods from being discarded during waits.
- Reduced redundant rendering interruptions and repeated graphics work, including changes to **Vulkan/MoltenVK**.
- Improved texture caching to reuse more previously calculated results.
- **Black Ops II:** corrections to SPU synchronization, memory reservations and waits involved in stalls.
- **Black Ops II:** earlier submission of pending occlusion results, with a separate bounded budget, targets waits on the game’s main CPU threads.
- Corrected short active-wait timing on iPhones with a 1 GHz system counter and adjusted the BO2 writer-lock wait path.
- **Assassin’s Creed:** corrected an atomic SPU write that could overwrite a newer main-CPU value during game exit.
- Improved SPU program preparation and cache reuse to reduce recompilation during gameplay.
- **God of War III:** removed the unintended 30 FPS limit and reduced unnecessary texture validation.
- **God of War III v1.00:** the optional MLAA bypass now applies on a fresh boot as well.
- **Assassin’s Creed IV and Dynasty Warriors 6:** corrected game profiles to use the LLVM PPU recompiler.
- Corrected texture coherence, partial graphics commands and CPU/GPU synchronization paths.
- More reliable retention of mounted ISO images.
- Corrected JIT memory reservation when the usual address range is unavailable, including on certain iOS beta versions.
- Repositioned the **Menu** and **Performance** buttons to better respect touch controls and safe areas.
- Expanded per-game settings and diagnostic tools to identify the causes of stalls more precisely.

## 🎨 Skins and touch controls

- Added **GameCube Pocket, Wii Pocket and PS2 Pocket** skins.
- Added **Pocket — Original** variants for GameCube, Wii and PS2 while keeping the existing designs.
- Added **Switch Pocket**, available through **Skins in the Switch playlist menu**.
- Portrait and landscape layouts, with orientation locking where supported by the selected skin and engine.
- Corrected offsets between the drawn buttons and their touch areas.
- Corrected **rectangular press highlights**, pressed states and analog-stick geometry.
- GameCube/Wii analog sticks now move as a complete circle, including the C-stick.
- Bundled skin updates now refresh older installed copies while preserving your selections.
- Restored access to **Skins from the PS2 playlist**.
- Corrected the return from the MeloNX in-game menu so skin buttons and sticks regain input immediately.
- Improved game-screen framing inside Pocket skins, including rounded corners.
- Refined pressed-button visuals so controls sink into their housings rather than simply turning gray.
- Dolphin and PS2 floating session buttons no longer cover skin controls when the skin provides its own Menu button.

## 🏆 RetroAchievements

- Centralized sign-in and **Hardcore** settings.
- Corrected repeated sign-outs, credential persistence and migration of older accounts.
- Improved session ownership of notifications and progress, including external-display presentation.
- Achievement text follows the app language when the required Apple translation features are available.
- Improved game recognition, including **CHD and CSO**, with consistent identification in the library and during play.
- Clearer messages distinguish an unrecognized game from an unreadable file.

## 🧩 Cheats & Enhancements

- A unified **Cheats & Enhancements** page for each game.
- Access to compatible frame-rate, aspect-ratio, graphics and other available game patches.
- Improved activation, deactivation and restoration of original settings.
- **Corrected unintended Switch cheat activation** when the enable list was missing.
- Cheat state remains usable after the app container moves.
- RewindBox-generated cheat files now contain only the selected programs.

## 📚 Library, artwork and manuals

- Reworked 3D cases with more faithful proportions, relief, spines and backs.
- Editable back covers and nondestructive image correction.
- Artwork matching using the ROM’s actual game identifier.
- More reliable batch scraping with better preservation of existing media.
- Improved **French cover and manual** lookup with additional sources.
- Improved scan viewing and zoom.
- Lighter Switch discovery avoids reading entire game files on the main thread.

## ✨ Interface and navigation

- New **RewindBox Glacier** style with a reversible preset.
- Bundled offline system artwork.
- Corrections to margins, obscured titles, icon sizes and carousels.
- Corrections to system bubbles and the “⋯” menu.
- An **icons-only main navigation bar**, while retaining accessible names for VoiceOver.

## 🧪 Experimental renderer

- Added an **optional native Metal 4 renderer for RPCS3**. Vulkan/MoltenVK remains available and the selected renderer is preserved.

## Testing and known limits

The downloaded Build 721 IPA passed the recorded offline package, source/component identity and delivery checks. RPCS3 Core 919. Fresh Flutter, native and delivery-contract checks were executed for this delivery. The downloaded file matches the original private delivery byte for byte.

Automated tests and desktop benchmarks do not establish iPhone FPS, audio or gameplay improvements. The complete package has not been gameplay-validated on a physical iPhone. First-use shader compilation and game-specific issues may remain. Cheats and achievement support depend on the game, version and engine.

Long Hogwarts Legacy pauses and residual BO2 performance problems remain under investigation. This build retains automatic BO2/God of War III comparison windows; their removal belongs to a later build and is not included here.

Some faithful Pocket layouts have small touch targets or Dynamic Island overlap. Switch Pocket’s HOME and Capture controls are unavailable in this engine; MeloNX does not lock session orientation through the skin. The MeloNX Metal binary-archive prototype, Switch 2 experiment and RPCS3 comparison-only Cores are not included.

apps.name: Rich4Renew
apps.subtitle: 大富翁4 高清重制版，新增歌舞伎町地图与大富豪模式
apps.localizedDescription: 《大富翁4》的高清重制版：Vite + TypeScript 重写的游戏本体，Capacitor 打包成 iOS App，规则依原版反组译还原，并加入新玩法「大富豪模式」与新地图「歌舞伎町」。支持 iPhone 与 iPad，iOS 15.0 及以上。

versions.localizedDescription:
## 谢谢大家
说好的 1.3 来了。谢谢每一位在玩、在报 bug、在评论区出主意的朋友，这一版等得比较久，谢谢大家的耐心。

1.3 最大的心血是两张古代大地图：大唐长安的「开元盛世」，和北宋汴京的「清明上河」——还有八百里水泊梁山。城墙、楼阁、路人、音乐、小报、小游戏，一样一样全是重新做的。

**这个游戏属于每一位喜欢大富翁4的玩家：永远不收任何费用，也不做任何商业用途，大家尽管拿去玩、拿去分享。**

- **想玩两张新地图，请下载这个页面的 1.3.0 安装包覆盖安装**，存档会保留（保险起见，可以先在「游戏设置 → 存档备份」导出一份）。游戏内更新到的是「1.3.0 simple」版：只有几 MB，不含这两张地图，其他功能（私服、联机等）跟完整版一样，可以和完整版的玩家一起玩。iPhone 要连私服，需要装 1.3.0 安装包。
- **国内下载慢**：在国内提供下载需要备案，我个人没办法申请，建议挂梯子下载，或者等网盘版。
- **遇到 bug 或小问题**：可以在 [Issues](https://github.com/iam567/rich4-renew-app/issues) 提交，也可以在 B 站 UP 主 **TrustBox**、**阿姆西_MC** 发布的大富翁4 重制版视频下面留言，各个评论区我都会看，能修的一定会修。

祝大家玩得开心，梁山见！

## v1.3 更新内容

- **两张全新的古代大地图，都在「自制地图」里，音乐、界面、开场动画、小报和卦肆（新闻、命运）、路人全是自己的一套，钱也用「文」：**
  - **开元盛世（大唐长安）**：贡院答题考状元、斗鸡场下注、驿站快马、博戏坊押大小、发配所，路上还有几十个「小事件」格子，踩上去随机前进后退。
  - **清明上河（北宋汴京）**：城墙、虹桥、樊楼、大相国寺都立起来了。城外是水泊梁山——坐汴河漕运的船过去，打虎、射野猪、跟燕青摔跤、十字坡看碗，抽 108 张「梁山令」，凑齐一组好汉到聚义厅换奖励。
  - 清明上河的企业各有各的用处：汴河漕运把人送上梁山，东京车坊收加油费，将作监帮你加盖，官窑卖瓷器，常平仓卖保险；当上董事长还有专属好处。
- **新增「私服」：想自己架一台给朋友玩的人，可以下载「私服架设包」，一条命令装好。** 派对模式的「局域网房间」改成了「私服房间」，里面有局域网、连线私服和私服列表；输入房间码就会自动连到那台私服。私服可以有公告、活动报名、私信、介绍和横幅，掉线两分钟内回来座位还在。iPhone 要装 1.3 的安装包才能连私服。
- **新增「游戏节奏」：慢节奏、原版、快节奏三种。** 慢节奏：物价涨得慢、过路费六折、周转不灵可以清算资产；快节奏：物价涨得快，房价地价 1.2 倍。排行榜只收原版节奏。
- **所有股票都能自由买卖：** 企业的保留股份不用再走到那栋楼才能买，在股市就能直接按市价买；买不了的时候会写明原因。
- **电脑版的存档改放在游戏目录里的 save 文件夹**（Windows 在 Rich4.exe 旁边，Mac 在「大富翁4」旁边），换电脑直接复制走；原来的存档第一次打开会自动复制过去。标题画面多了「回到桌面」。
- 新增「状态条」：游戏画面右上角显示现在的状态，例如谁坐牢还剩几天、股市休市还剩几天，可以收起来。
- 结果窗口：一次影响很多人或很多块地时，列成清单慢慢滚动，相同的合并成一行，镜头不再一个个跑。
- 冬眠的人轮到时只弹一条消息，镜头不再切过去。
- 地狱难度：研究所做的道具在商店里变灰，点一下老板会说明不能卖。
- 嫁祸卡可以再嫁祸：被嫁祸的人可以用自己的免罪卡或嫁祸卡，直到有人没有为止。飞弹、核弹炸到旅馆，里面的客人也会受伤住院。
- 新闻、命运送的道具，只会是商店里买得到的。
- 大富豪模式：卡片改成全国共用一池，商店没有常备卡片了。
- 修正：有些新闻的结果写成「undefined 的 12 支股票」。
- 修正：创作乐园的地图说明太长时，按钮被挤出画面。
- 修正：很旧的安卓系统和部分电视停在绿色画面打不开（需要装 1.3 的安装包）。
- 修正：iPhone 上连点屏幕下方会退回主屏幕；现在要滑两次才会退出。
- 修正：简体显示里「著称」「毕昇」等字。
- 1.3 只能和 1.3 的玩家一起玩派对模式。存档可以直接沿用。

### v1.2.5（2026-11-17，游戏内更新）
- 修正：抢夺卡现在是「用抢夺卡换对方一张卡」。卡片栏满了也不会再要你丢掉一张；抢到对方的抢夺卡，自己手里会留下一张（以前地狱难度下两边的抢夺卡都会不见）。派对模式里有旧版本的玩家一起玩时，按旧规则进行。
- **新增：排行榜「总榜」。** 地图那一排最前面多了「总榜」，所有地图一起排名，每个成绩下面标出是在哪张地图打的。
- 星座主题、武侠主题、恐龙主题、城市主题四张地图，名字改成「星座」「武侠」「恐龙」「城市」。
- 自建地图的物件重新分类：地面、道路、格子、地标、建筑、植被、装饰，地标按洲分，建筑、植被、装饰也各有小分类；原版八张地图里的房子、商店、公园、地标也都可以拿来用了。

## 安装
- 安卓手机：下载 `rich4-1.3.0.apk`，在手机上打开安装（第一次要允许「安装未知来源的应用」）。
- 安卓电视／电视盒子：下载 `rich4-1.3.0-androidtv.apk` 安装，桌面上会出现「大富翁4 TV」；用遥控器或手柄玩。手机版的 apk 也能装在电视上（两个是同一个 App，装一个就好）。
- iPhone：`rich4-1.3.0-unsigned.ipa` 是未签名的安装包，需要自己签名后安装。
- Windows：下载 `rich4-1.3.0-windows.zip`，解压后打开 `Rich4` 文件夹，双击 `Rich4.exe`。第一次打开如果出现「Windows 已保护你的电脑」，点「更多信息 → 仍要执行」。开局域网房间时如果防火墙询问，请选「允许」。存档在 `Rich4` 文件夹里的 `save`。
- Windows 7 / 8：下载 `rich4-1.3.0-win7.zip`，用法和上面的 Windows 版一样。Windows 10、11 请用上面的 Windows 版。
- Mac：下载 `rich4-1.3.0-mac.dmg`，打开后把「大富翁4」拖进「应用程序」（Intel 和 M 芯片都能用）。第一次打开请在「应用程序」里对它按右键 →「打开」。
- 想自己架私服：下载 `rich4-server.zip`，里面有架设说明（README.md）。

装新版会保留原来的存档。

apps.name: SceneBox
apps.subtitle: Torrent streaming client
apps.localizedDescription: Torrent streaming client for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS and Mac (Catalyst), written in SwiftUI. Streams come from Stremio-compatible addons and play through a vendored libtorrent engine feeding VLC.

versions.localizedDescription:
Important: accounts now need your own Firebase project

SceneBox no longer connects to a shared Firebase project. Sign-in, profiles and sync between devices now run on a free Firebase project that you create and own. Your data stays in your own account, not mine.

- Guest mode still works without any setup. Everything is kept on the device.
- To sign in, tap Connect Firebase on the sign-in screen and import the GoogleService-Info.plist from your Firebase project (on Apple TV, type in the values). Step-by-step guide and the security rules: https://github.com/donbytyqi/scenebox#firebase-setup
- Accounts made on the old shared project don't carry over. Create a new account on your own project.
- Profile photos need Firebase Storage, which requires Google's Blaze plan (it has a free tier). Everything else works on the free Spark plan.

New

- Support SceneBox page in Settings, for anyone who wants to donate.

Fixes

- Downloading a second episode from a season pack works now. Before, every episode of a pack counted as the same download, so you had to delete the finished one before the next would start. (#9)
- Apple TV: Trakt lists open when you click them. (#10)
- Mac: signing in works on the unsigned build. macOS doesn't let unsigned apps use the Keychain, so the app keeps your sign-in session and any API keys you enter in a file inside its own sandbox container instead (readable only by your user account).

Still open

- A few people report that on iPhone the app closes shortly after a stream starts buffering. I can't reproduce it on the simulator or on Mac. If it hits you, please share the crash log: Settings > Privacy & Security > Analytics & Improvements > Analytics Data, look for a file starting with SceneBox, and attach it to the issue. Also say which iPhone and what you were playing (torrent or debrid, resolution). 1.0.2 doesn't have this problem if you need a fallback.
- Apple TV install failing in Sideloadly with "ApplicationVerificationFailed / Invalid file" on tvOS 26.6 (#8). The tvOS build is packaged exactly like 1.0.2 and passes Apple's bundle verification here, so this needs the full Sideloadly log: the "Invalid file" line names the file it choked on. Please paste that on the issue. Sideloadly also has known trouble with tvOS 26.4 and later (pairing), so try the latest Sideloadly first.

Important: this release is NOT signed. You have to allow it yourself.

Nothing here is signed with an Apple developer account and the Mac app is not notarized. macOS and iOS will refuse to open it until you explicitly allow it. This is expected, it's not broken.

Mac:

1. Open the dmg and drag SceneBox to Applications.
2. Open SceneBox. macOS will say it "could not verify" the app or that it's from an unidentified developer. Press Done (not Move to Trash).
3. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security and press "Open Anyway" next to SceneBox, then confirm.
4. From then on it opens normally.

If you'd rather skip the dialog, run this in Terminal after copying the app to Applications:

    xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/SceneBox.app

If you had an older signed version installed, delete it first.

iPhone/iPad: the ipa isn't signed, you sign it yourself with Sideloadly, AltStore, SideStore, Feather or ESign with your own Apple ID. Free Apple ID = resign every 7 days (AltStore/SideStore do it for you), paid dev account = one year.

Apple TV: Sideloadly works over Wi-Fi. On the TV go to Settings > Remotes and Devices > Remote App and Devices so it shows up, then pick it in Sideloadly.

versions.localizedDescription:
Discord: your status now goes out while something plays, not only once you pause, and it has a progress bar that follows seeks and playback speed. Titles played from Simkl show their season ("Season 2 · Episode 5"), and manga shows the same TV icon as anime. The status keeps working after the app was away for a while, and two token refreshes at once no longer sign you out of Discord without a word.

Subtitles: every cue on screen is shown at once, so a long sign no longer hides the dialogue under it. Bottom Padding goes up to 400 pt, so subtitles can sit on the picture when you watch in portrait. The units on the Subtitles settings page are translated.

Simkl: episodes of a title opened from Simkl can be downloaded and have their progress reset from their menu, like AniList episodes.

Shirox speaks Thai, in Settings › General › Change Language. The Started On and Finished On labels read as dates in every language, and the already downloaded and already queued toasts are translated.

App icons: Manga, a new home screen icon in Settings › General › App Icon.

Also: the player's subtitle settings and episode pickers take your accent color, holding the tab bar opens its menu on every tab when the bar minimizes on scroll, and a few spots that could crash on bad input from a server now handle it.

versions.localizedDescription:
## English

**Historical iOS / iPadOS 1.1.1 (build 3).** Adds CineStill 800T to the shared catalog, including red halation with 0–8 EV highlight headroom and a new illustrated cover. It reuses the Vision3 500T emulsion data and print calibration with upstream attribution.

The arm64 IPA in Assets is **unsigned**, requires iOS/iPadOS 18 or later, and needs user-managed signing and provisioning. See `INSTALL.md`, `SHA256SUMS.txt` and the included entitlement file. The 800T simulator checks and public packaging passed; the full mobile smoke check later stopped at a memory limit, and the installed Duo development build was not exercised. [Validation record](https://github.com/akinal5765-byte/Silverphase/blob/0e0d354c6d4813ec7cdbf6a004a3c3c3fde9525a/performance/VALIDATION-CINESTILL-2026-11-02.md)

---

## 简体中文

> **当前两端下载：** [macOS 1.0.1](https://github.com/akinal5765-byte/Silverphase/releases/tag/v1.0.1) · [iOS 1.1.1](https://github.com/akinal5765-byte/Silverphase/releases/tag/v1.1.1)

新增 **CineStill 800T**，已接入 iOS 与 macOS 的共享胶片目录。

- 采用上游的无防光晕背层回反射模型，提供红色光晕和 **0–8 EV 高光余量**控制。
- 新增按通用提示词生成的包装风格封面；两端卡片短名称统一为 **800T**，列表保留完整名称 **CineStill 800T**。
- 复用 Vision3 500T 的原始乳剂数据与印相校准，保留 Hanze Qiu、Andrea Volpato 的来源记录及 GPL / CC BY-SA 声明。

两端独立编号：**macOS 1.0.1（2）**、**iOS 1.1.1（3）**。

[PR #2](https://github.com/akinal5765-byte/Silverphase/pull/2) 已合并。安装包来自提交 `0e0d354c6d4813ec7cdbf6a004a3c3c3fde9525a`，其源码树与合并后的 `main` 一致。包内附构建来源与开源声明，公开包不包含个人照片、私有材料或签名凭据。

## 下载与安装

下载 **`Silverphase-1.1.1-iOS-unsigned.ipa`**，适用于 **arm64、iOS / iPadOS 18 及以上**。

这是**未签名 IPA**，需要自行完成设备签名和描述文件配置；请保留 `Silverphase-iOS-RequiredEntitlements.plist` 中的 Increased Memory Limit 能力。包内不提供证书、私钥或设备描述文件。安装方法见附件 `INSTALL.md`；校验值见 `SHA256SUMS.txt`，构建与来源信息见 `ios-build.json`。

## 验证范围

800T 的模拟器专项检查通过，公共 Release 构建与打包通过。完整移动端冒烟检查在后续读取原图细节时因内存不足中止，因此仍属部分覆盖。

签名开发版本已单独覆盖安装到 Duo，保留照片库和编辑记录；安装后未启动应用或操作验证。此版本不新增真机触控、相册权限、内存能力或全分辨率导出的验收结论。

[详细验证记录](https://github.com/akinal5765-byte/Silverphase/blob/0e0d354c6d4813ec7cdbf6a004a3c3c3fde9525a/performance/VALIDATION-CINESTILL-2026-11-02.md)。

versions.localizedDescription:
# Simple Live v1.13.3 更新速览

发布日期：2026-10-25

本版主题：发热优化、Windows 退出修复、桌面端快捷键中文输入法适配、B站弹幕缺失修复与虎牙 4K 断流调查结论。2026-11-01 追加全屏四角时钟（#160），2026-11-02 追加音量增强与音量手势修复（#161），2026-11-03 修复抖音部分房间登录墙导致进不去、关注页刷不出，2026-11-08 追加 iOS 系统画中画、取消关注不再触发全量刷新（#163）与 WebDAV 恢复 500 根因修复（#164）。

经过19次构建，终于解决了，连media_kit都没解决的iOS PIP问题，在一个PR中，获得了思路，经过一些修复，与我们项目实现了兼容。

在此，感谢各位提供日志的用户：@laobai95 等等多位用户（请在群内提供git用户名）。
## 省电模式（新增，默认关闭）

- 针对安卓端观看时发热严重的反馈，新增一键「省电模式」（设置 → 直播间设置 → 播放器，置于首位）：视频缩放降档（均衡 → bilinear、画质 → spline36）、弹幕限 60 帧、关闭弹幕描边、放宽安卓播放检测频率、多开上限 4 个且压至最低清晰度。
- 默认关闭，关闭时所有行为与 v1.13.2 完全一致；打开后进入下一个直播间生效。全端开关一致可见（iOS 上为弹幕部分生效）。

## 弹幕渲染降耗

- 弹幕描边开关（默认开）：关闭后每条弹幕少一次整段文本绘制，弹幕越密越省。
- 帧率上限（默认跟随屏幕）：高刷屏可限 60 帧，视觉无差异、GPU 负担约减半。
- 修复「描边宽度」设置从未生效的问题（渲染侧此前硬编码为 2）。
- 弹幕层透明度改为逐条并入颜色 alpha，去掉整层离屏合成（视觉不变）。

## 性能与修复

- 高热房间 CPU：屏蔽词正则从「每条消息每个词重新编译」改为编译一次缓存，消息量越大收益越明显。
- Windows 退出修复：关闭应用时偶发的「快速异常检测失败」fast-fail 弹窗与进程挂死；本地 fork media_kit_video Windows 部分，纹理与 mpv render context 释放改为同步等待，退出时等待 mpv 关停。
- 关闭窗口弹「Unknown Hard Error」：装有搜狗输入法等第三方输入法的电脑，每次关闭都会弹出系统错误（出错模块 `SogouPY.ime`）；现退出时跳过第三方模块的卸载回调，不再弹窗。

## 桌面端快捷键（Windows / macOS / Linux）

- 中文输入法下 F、R、空格等单键快捷键可直接使用，无需先切英文；输入框内照常打中文。
- 带 Ctrl / Alt / Win（macOS 为 Cmd / Ctrl / Option）的组合键不再被拦截，修复 macOS 直播间内 Cmd+Q 无法退出等问题；macOS / Linux 补上空格键播放/暂停；长按只触发一次。

## B站弹幕缺失修复（#150）

- B站对弹幕接口的登录态风控（账号被标记后带 cookie 请求被拒）导致弹幕缺失、换号才能恢复；现登录态请求失败时自动回退未登录获取 token，以游客身份连接弹幕。
- 回退不粘连：每次进房先走登录态，风控解除后自动恢复；清晰度与账号其他功能不受影响（取流仍走登录态）。

## 全屏四角时钟（新增，#160，2026-11-01 追加）

- 全屏直播画面四角（左上/右上/左下/右下）常驻显示当前时间（HH:mm），不随控制栏隐藏；仅全屏显示，默认关闭、右上角，入口在 直播间设置 → 四角时钟。
- 时钟层不拦截触摸，滑动手势不受影响；组件自管定时器、关闭时零开销。TV 端同版合入同款功能。

## 音量增强与音量手势修复（#161，2026-11-02 追加）

- 新增「音量增强」开关（默认关，直播间设置 → 播放器 → 音量）：开启后音量上限 0–300%，超过 100% 为播放器软件增益（最高 ×3.0），不动系统音量；关闭时全部音量入口回到 0–100，与旧版一致。
- 音量弹窗（底栏音量图标，移动端本版起也开放）：滑条 + 预设 0/50/100/200/300（关=0/50/100），增益区显示倍率。
- 修复安卓快速上下滑调音量「实际没有反应」：终值落地不再被丢弃，快速滑动必生效。
- 纯增益在音源响度大时可能破音，调回 200% 以内即可。TV 端同版合入音量控制。

## 虎牙 4K 断流调查结论（#156，2026-10-31）

- 虎牙已将 4K / 4K HDR 设为 VIP 专属画质（登录网页端画质列表实测标注）。非 VIP 账号拉 4K 会被 CDN 随机拒绝（`Failed to open`）或限速至不可用带宽，表现为断流卡顿；与客户端参数、登录态、IP 均无关，客户端无解。
- 2K 及以下不受影响，追求流畅建议选 2K；调查中试行的参数修改已验证无效并撤回。
- TV 端结论相同；TV 版本另有轮播列表、标签批量管理与全屏四角时钟。

## 抖音登录墙房间进不去修复（2026-11-03 追加）

- 部分抖音房间（如「赛雷三分钟」）App 内报 room 为空进不去、关注页刷不出，但直链导入外部播放器能播。根因是匿名访问被 web 端按房间维度下发扫码登录墙（`enter_mode=1`、不下发 room），换 ttwid / 移动端 UA 均无效。
- 新增移动端 reflow 匿名取房：凭登录墙响应里仍可匿名拿到的主播 `sec_user_id`，请求 reflow 接口（无需 Cookie 与签名）取回真实房间与流地址，在 API 与 HTML 两条路径都做兜底；关注页状态判断同步修复。
- 实网验证 4 档画质真实可播、`getLiveStatus` 正常。TV 端共享核心库同步生效。

## iOS 系统画中画（新增，2026-11-08 追加）

- iOS 端新增系统级小窗（画中画，要求 iOS 15+）：直播画面悬浮于桌面与其他应用之上，后台持续观看；采用 AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer 路线，mpv 渲染帧零拷贝桥接进系统小窗。
- 「后台保持画面」开关（设置 → 播放设置 → iOS 小窗，默认开）：开启后进小窗先停播重建管线至软解码+软渲染（纯 CPU，不依赖后台 GPU 权限），切后台画面持续显示，实测连续 76 秒 30fps 零丢帧；关闭为即显省电路线，秒开，切后台画面停住、声音正常。
- 返回 App 自动关闭小窗并恢复应用内播放；小窗内可暂停/恢复播放，与 App 内状态同步。
- 已知说明：重建路线进小窗有 1~2 秒重连空窗；后台持续画面耗电略增，部分设备后台渲染表现不一致，可按实测用开关选择；其他平台（Android 系统小窗、TV）不受本项影响。

## 取消关注不再触发全量刷新（#163，2026-11-08 追加）

- 清理关注列表时，每次取消关注都会触发**全部**关注的开播状态刷新（上百关注等于上百次请求），容易触发平台风控。
- 现取消关注仅本地移除（标签归属同步清理），不再发起任何网络请求；开播状态按原有的定时刷新 / 手动刷新节奏更新。

## WebDAV 恢复 500 根因修复（#164，2026-11-08 追加）

- 「能上传、不能恢复」的根因确认：Alist 等网关把恢复（GET）请求代理转发到阿里云盘 OSS 签名直链时，应用携带的多余 `Content-Type: text/xml` 头被透传参与签名计算，与直链签名不一致（`SignatureDoesNotMatch`），403 被转成 500 返回。
- 修复：GET 请求不再携带该头（PROPFIND 所需的 XML Content-Type 由组件按规范自行设置，不受影响）。
- 同步失败时的报错增强：附带请求方法、URL、状态码与服务器响应体摘要（300 字符），便于定位服务端问题。

## 设置页重排

- 我的-设置入口：直播设置、弹幕设置、多开设置提前聚拢（外观 → 主页 → 直播 → 弹幕 → 多开 → 播放页 → 关注 → 定时 → 其他）。
- 直播设置：省电模式置顶；移动端后台播放相关项并入「直播间」段；实时字幕（实验）移至末尾。
- 弹幕设置拆为屏蔽 / 显示 / 重点动态 / 过滤与延迟四段，屏蔽保持第一。

apps.name: Spotube
apps.subtitle: Cross-platform open-source music streaming app
apps.localizedDescription: A cross-platform, extensible open-source music streaming platform. Bring your own music metadata, playlists and audio sources through community plugins, with time-synced lyrics, downloadable tracks and no telemetry or user data collection.

versions.localizedDescription:
## Spotube V6 is here 🎉🚀

### 🔥Highlights

- Migration from Flutter to Compose Multiplatform, [learn why we did it](https://spotube.cc/blog/compose-multiplatform-migration/)
- UI redesign, introducing [Millennium](https://github.com/team-spotube/millennium/) UI. 2000s look and feel with 2026's modernity
- Jam sessions, play music with friends and family in sync. Runs on a new dedicated room server, with host-only controls and device bans to keep rooms safe
- Full Android Auto integration. Browse, Library, Search all are there now, not just queue
- iOS now plays audio through VLC, so every streaming format works, and keeps playing in the background
- Migration from hetu_script to Kotlin for plugin development. Powered by [Zipline by Cashapp](https://github.com/cashapp/zipline/)
- More extensibility, plugin support for Lyrics provider and Scrobbling providers
- Redesigned plugin manager. Plugin login pages can only reach cookies and scripts of the domains they declare
- Native Android APK, with reduced apk size, performance improvements and more native android integrations.
- Relicensed from BSD-4-Clause to AGPL-3.0-or-later for a more Open Source friendly licensing. And for preventing distribution of closed source and maliciously modified Spotube.

### 💫 Features

- Migration to Compose Multiplatform
- Add ChipTab component and refactor SearchScreen to use it

apps.name: Stats
apps.subtitle: Your Mac's activity, at a glance
apps.localizedDescription: View your Mac's system activity on iPhone over a local encrypted connection. A native, local-first system monitor with a lightweight Mac companion and a mobile dashboard.

versions.localizedDescription:
Stats for iPhone 0.3.18 adds interactive one-minute CPU and memory charts to the dashboard.

## What's changed

- Drag across either mini chart to see the sample's time and percentage. Light haptics follow the in-app setting.
- The CPU chart adjusts its percentage scale to make small changes easier to see. The memory chart shows usage, with memory pressure shown separately.
- The Mac card keeps the last update time and opens About This Mac when tapped. The dashboard refreshes automatically.

## Download

**Stats for iPhone 0.3.18 (build 21)** requires iOS 17 or later. The arm64 IPA is unsigned for AltStore, SideStore, and LiveContainer.

**SHA-256** 6d9931bd5cb7240a4d2a4ff995909e8e6f950fa38e3c3ceae45b483c3eff0b96

[Full changelog](https://github.com/ishtiaq156/stats/compare/v0.3.26...v0.3.27)

apps.name: TDrive
apps.subtitle: Turn your private Telegram storage into a cloud drive
apps.localizedDescription: TDrive turns your private Telegram storage into a drive you can browse, search, preview, share and mount, with an AI assistant, automatic photo backup and client-side encryption. Requires Telegram API credentials from my.telegram.org.

versions.localizedDescription:
# TDrive v3.1.9

This release changes how Android folder import handles a file that already
exists on the drive under the same name. Instead of skipping or renaming it
silently, TDrive asks what to do. It also creates the folder you picked even
when that folder is empty. Bản phát hành này thay đổi cách nhập thư mục trên
Android khi một tệp đã có trên drive với cùng tên. Thay vì bỏ qua hoặc đổi tên
âm thầm, TDrive sẽ hỏi bạn muốn làm gì. Thư mục bạn chọn cũng được tạo ngay cả
khi thư mục đó trống.

## Highlights

- Same name, different size: before anything is sent, TDrive asks whether to
  Replace the file on the drive, Keep both, or Skip. Skip is the default, and
  canceling the question sends nothing. With several clashes, one choice can be
  applied to all of them.
- Replace moves the old file to Trash, where you can restore it. The new copy
  is confirmed on the drive before the old one is moved, and then it takes the
  original name.
- Keep both saves the new file as the first free name, such as `photo_1.jpg`.
  The name also avoids folders that the same import is about to create.
- An empty folder you pick is created on the drive, even when nothing goes into it.
- The Transfers entry notes how many files were replaced, kept or skipped.

## Known limits

- Replace uses Trash, so the old file can be restored, but it is not a
  Telegram revision.
- A file whose size is unknown, or whose drive check fails, is uploaded as a
  copy without asking.
- Retrying a failed import does not carry your clash answers, so the question
  can appear again.
- A file name that contains a backslash makes its whole upload batch fail.
- The Transfers row title can cut off the replaced and kept counts. The full
  text is in the history and notification.
- The Android build was tested on an x86_64 emulator with automated tests. The
  ARM64 release APK was not run on a phone.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-windows-amd64-setup.exe` | Installer. A portable `TDrive-v3.1.9-windows-amd64.zip` is also attached. |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-macos-arm64.zip` | Unzip and drag TDrive to Applications. |
| Linux (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it, then run it. Needs glibc 2.35 or newer. |
| Android 7.0 or newer (ARM64) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-android-arm64.apk` | Allow installs from your browser or file manager when Android asks. |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 16 or newer) | `TDrive-v3.1.9-ios-unsigned.ipa` | Not signed. Install with TrollStore, Sideloadly or AltStore. |

## Integrity

- `checksums.txt` lists SHA-256 digests for the downloadable packages.
- `checksums.txt.sig` authenticates that manifest for the desktop updater using the embedded Ed25519 trust keys.
- Android release certificate SHA-256: `A8:F4:4A:72:E0:56:E1:79:DE:19:4C:F3:E3:10:84:9D:5C:B6:BA:5A:58:EC:5F:A6:AD:BA:DD:29:FB:DC:22:92`.

## Credits

Original TDrive by [Jeetraj](https://github.com/jeetrex17/TDrive), MIT License. This fork is maintained by [Nguyễn Dương Gia Thuận](https://github.com/ndgthuan/tdrive).

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/ndgthuan/tdrive/compare/v3.1.8...v3.1.9

apps.name: Tsumiru
apps.subtitle: Native manga & manhwa reader for Suwayomi-Server
apps.localizedDescription: Tsumiru is a native client for reading manga & manhwa from a Suwayomi-Server instance, built for long webtoon binges. Offline downloads with an on-device catalog, a rebuilt continuous-scroll webtoon reader, incognito mode, and 13 built-in themes.

versions.localizedDescription:
A manga and webtoon reader for your [Suwayomi](https://suwayomi.org/) server.

### ✨ New Features

- Added **Per-category settings for sort and filters** to the Library, including changes made offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Added notifications when a new Tsumiru or server version is out, with **Remind later** and **Ignore** (@aaronbamblett)
- Added **Offset double spreads** to the paged reader for spreads that start on an odd page (@PainTownblue)

### ⚙️ Changes

- Made long strip taps and keys scroll by **Scroll distance** instead of a whole page (@aaronbamblett)
- Changed **Keep screen on** to off by default (@aaronbamblett)
- Added Up and Down page turns in horizontal paged mode and N and P to change chapter (@aaronbamblett)

### 🚀 Improvements

- Hid empty category tabs while searching or filtering the library, with **Show empty categories during search/filtering** to keep them (@aaronbamblett)
- Moved **Create registration code** to **Manage users** and added an **Edit** button to user rows (@aaronbamblett)

### 🧩 Fixes

- Fixed the offline library not opening when Tsumiru starts without a connection (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed **Something went wrong** showing on every page while reading offline (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed library covers going blank in Safari after scrolling them off screen and back (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed the paged reader restoring an old zoom when you return to a page (@aaronbamblett)
- Fixed saved searches from older WebUI versions not loading (@aaronbamblett)

*Thanks to our Weblate translators: Damien O'Neil for French, Kisnov for Catalan, Andrei Stepanov for Russian and PainTownblue for Chinese.*

## Install

You'll need a running Suwayomi server. See [Getting started](https://tsumiru.app/docs/guides/getting-started).

### Mobile

**Android:** download the universal APK below and open it to install. Smaller APKs for specific chip types are also attached.

**iOS:** the `…-ios.ipa` below is unsigned and has to be sideloaded. Add `https://tsumiru.app/apps.json` as a source in [SideStore](https://sidestore.io/) or [AltStore](https://altstore.io/) to install it and get later releases as updates.

<details>
<summary>Which sideloading tool should I use?</summary>

- **[SideStore](https://sidestore.io/)** signs and refreshes the app on the device itself, with no computer needed after setup. Best for most people.
- **[AltStore](https://altstore.io/)** expires every 7 days and only refreshes while a computer running AltServer is switched on and on the same Wi-Fi as your phone.
- **[TrollStore](https://ios.cfw.guide/installing-trollstore/)** installs permanently with no expiry, but only works on older iPhones and iOS versions with the required vulnerability.

With SideStore or AltStore the app is re-signed periodically, which those tools automate. There is no App Store build.
</details>

### Desktop

**Windows:** download `…-windows-x64.zip`, extract it anywhere, and run `tsumiru.exe`.

**macOS:** download `…-macos-universal.zip`, extract it, and move the app to Applications. If macOS blocks the first launch, approve it under System Settings → Privacy & Security.

**Linux:** the Flatpak is recommended and auto-updates.

```sh
flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists tsumiru https://flatpak.tsumiru.app/index.flatpakrepo
flatpak install tsumiru app.tsumiru.Tsumiru
```

Existing Flatpak installs keep receiving updates under `io.github.aaronbamblett.tsumiru`; no data, settings or logins move. AppImage/deb also keep that ID.

For a portable option, download `…-linux-x86_64.AppImage`, mark it executable with `chmod +x`, and run it.

### Web

Download `…-web.zip` and serve its contents with any static web server.

[Full documentation](https://tsumiru.app/)

apps.localizedDescription: TwinDesk turns your iPhone or iPad and your Mac, Windows PC or Linux computer into one desk: the computer's screen mirrored or used as a second display, files, clipboard, notifications, sound, camera and remote control, over Wi-Fi, USB or Bluetooth. It needs the TwinDesk desktop app on the computer.

versions.localizedDescription:
## TwinDesk 3.2.1: TwinDesk pop-ups, a richer Messages, and Photos albums

3.2.1 adds what's under **New in 3.2.1** below; everything after it is what 3.2 brought.

https://twin-desk.vercel.app

![TwinDesk 3.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/main/.github/assets/v32-banner.jpg)

The first release since 3.0. Your phone becomes a **Deck** of buttons for the computer, with a window space that arranges your windows. **TwinDesk Drive** keeps one folder the same on all your computers, with no cloud. **Multi-device is out of beta**, with every device's monitors on **one map**. There's also **search everywhere**, an **air mouse with a laser pointer**, **encrypted history**, **updates that install in place**, and a **tour** for someone new, in Multi-device too.

### ⬇️ Download

|---|---|
| **Windows** (Intel / AMD) | [`TwinDesk-Setup-3.2.1.exe`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.2.1/TwinDesk-Setup-3.2.1.exe) |

| **Mac** (Homebrew) | `brew install --cask inukaasith/twindesk/twindesk` |
| **Linux** (any distro) | [`TwinDesk-3.2.1-x86_64.AppImage`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.2.1/TwinDesk-3.2.1-x86_64.AppImage) |
| **Linux** (Debian / Ubuntu) | [`TwinDesk-3.2.1-amd64.deb`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.2.1/TwinDesk-3.2.1-amd64.deb), or our [APT repository](https://inukaasith.github.io/twindesk-apt) |
| **Linux** (Arch) | [`twindesk-bin-3.2.1-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.2.1/twindesk-bin-3.2.1-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst) |

| **Android** (full: notification access, SMS, Accessibility) | [`TwinDesk-3.2.1-full.apk`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.2.1/TwinDesk-3.2.1-full.apk) |

| **Any browser** | Turn on **TwinDesk Web** on a computer, then type `twindesk.local` |

#### Full KVM edition

The mouse and keyboard also reach UAC prompts, the lock screen, Ctrl+Alt+Del and, with System-wide, the login screen, through a system service. It installs over the normal TwinDesk (the same app with the service added), so a computer has one or the other.

| Device | File |
|---|---|
| **Windows** (Intel / AMD) | [`TwinDesk-FullKVM-Setup-3.2.1.exe`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.2.1/TwinDesk-FullKVM-Setup-3.2.1.exe) |
| **Windows** (ARM) | [`TwinDesk-FullKVM-Setup-3.2.1-arm64.exe`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.2.1/TwinDesk-FullKVM-Setup-3.2.1-arm64.exe) |
| **Linux** (any distro) | [`TwinDesk-FullKVM-3.2.1-x86_64.AppImage`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.2.1/TwinDesk-FullKVM-3.2.1-x86_64.AppImage) |
| **Linux** (Debian / Ubuntu) | [`TwinDesk-FullKVM-3.2.1-amd64.deb`](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/download/v3.2.1/TwinDesk-FullKVM-3.2.1-amd64.deb) |

**TwinDesk Portable** runs without installing: run normally it does everything that needs no administrator, run as administrator it also does the firewall, folder sharing and Wake on LAN.

Already have TwinDesk? The in-app updater picks the right file for your computer, and from 3.2 on, **Install now** updates in place, and each edition updates to its own (Full KVM to Full KVM, Portable to Portable). Update every device you pair: 3.2 still talks to 3.0, but the new features switch on only when both sides have 3.2.

> **Windows:** the installers aren't code-signed yet (signing is on its way). If SmartScreen stops it, choose **More info › Run anyway**.
> **iPhone and iPad:** the IPA is unsigned. Install it with SideStore, AltStore or any signing tool, or let the computer sign it with your own Apple ID (General › TwinDesk iPhone, opt in).

---

### 🆕 New in 3.2.1

Ideas from [@rahulpatel902](https://github.com/rahulpatel902)'s list of suggestions (#231), in TwinDesk's own look.

- **TwinDesk pop-ups** (Notifications › Showing here › Pop-ups): pick TwinDesk's own small window for your phone's notifications. Type a **Reply** right in it, use the app's own buttons (Mark as read, Mute…), see the notification's **picture**, **Copy** a one-time code, and watch a download or a timer fill its **progress bar** in place. The system's notifications stay the default, the lightest choice: with them the phone sends no pictures or progress.
- **Buttons on Linux's own notifications:** the phone app's buttons and a code's Copy, as on a Mac.
- **Each app its own way:** Show, No pop-ups (only in Recent) or Hide for each phone app.
- **Pause pop-ups on a schedule**, overnight too. Notifications still go in Recent and Messages.
- **Copy codes by themselves:** a one-time code goes on the clipboard when it arrives, never to your other devices or the clipboard history, and comes off it after 2 minutes.
- **Messages:** contact and chat pictures with the app's badge, a search box, **Delete** for a chat or a thread, and **Apps…** to choose which chat apps show. "Sending video…" and other progress notifications no longer turn into chats.
- **Photos:** your phone's **albums** in a sidebar, with covers and counts. **Open**, and on Windows **Open with…**, from the viewer.
- **The media card** stays compact: its chevron slides open back and forward 10 s, the phone's volume and where the sound plays, tinted by the artwork if you like (General).
- **Calls pause the music** (Calls › Sound): a call pauses what plays on the computer, and it plays again when the call ends.
- **Camera:** Mirror, quality from 720p to 4K, the light, zoom and a snapshot for the phone's camera.
- **Keep on top:** a pin in the toolbar of the phone's screen and a computer's shared screen keeps that window over the others.
- **Skip adbd** (Mirroring, off unless you switch it on): over Wi-Fi the phone's screen, sound and input go straight to the computer, encrypted, instead of through wireless debugging's adbd. Its biggest gain is while adb is busy: with a big file going to the phone, a tap showed up in about 90 ms instead of 210 ms. If the phone can't be reached directly, it goes through wireless debugging as before.
- **Low latency** (Mirroring, off): asks the phone's video encoder to send each frame as soon as it's ready. Some phones ignore it.
- **Fixed:** in Multi-device on a Mac, the Camera page's picture showed a broken image.

Android needs 3.2.1 too for pictures, progress bars, contact pictures and albums; with an older phone app the rest works as before.

---

### 🎛️ The Deck

A Stream Deck style grid of buttons on the phone (Android, iPhone and Web) for the computer: spaces and pages, tiles of any size, live sliders for sound and brightness, Bluetooth devices, the sound output and microphone, and files and saved scripts opened like a double-click (never through a shell). Full screen, it shows widgets: a clock, the computer's media player, CPU, RAM and temperature.

- **The window space**: the computer's windows on the phone. Tap an app, pick a layout and they're arranged. Save a few apps as a set on the shelf and arrange them again with one tap. Snap, minimize, maximize and close from the phone.

### 🗂️ TwinDesk Drive

One folder kept the same on your computers, with no cloud. Each keeps its own copy and works offline, and they swap what changed when they connect. A file changed on two at once keeps both, and deleted files go to the Trash or Recycle Bin. Off until you turn it on in File Sharing. Mac, Windows and Linux, one-to-one and Multi-device.

### 🖥️ Multi-device, out of beta

- **The monitor map** (#225): every device's monitors in one picture, arranged by dragging. The pointer crosses only where monitors touch, keeps its place along the edge, and goes through an offline device to the next one.
- **Everything one-to-one has**: fast files (fx and fx2), Camera, Remote, Deck, ReZume with any one device, TwinDesk iPhone, Modules, every device's notifications with Reply and one-time codes, clipboard pictures, Now Playing both ways, and pairing a phone with a QR code.
- **Mouse and keyboard over Bluetooth** between Macs and Windows PCs.
- **The tour and What's new** now open in Multi-device too.

### ✨ Everywhere

- **Air mouse and Presentation** in Remote: point the phone to move the pointer, run your slides with a laser pointer. A three-finger tap is a middle click.
- **Hold a key to cross** (#230): pick a key on the Mouse page and the pointer leaves the computer at its edge only while you hold it. In Multi-device it's for that computer's own mouse or trackpad.
- **Emergency return** (#178): a shortcut (Control+Alt+Command+Esc, Win or Super on a PC, or your own) that brings the mouse and keyboard home and turns sharing off, whatever the other side is doing. One-to-one and Multi-device.
- **Search everywhere** (⌘K, Ctrl+K on Windows and Linux): settings, shortcuts and features found by what they do.
- **Arrange** the sidebar and the phone's bottom bar, and switch off pages you don't use in **General › Modules** (they aren't loaded).
- **Clipboard and notification history kept across restarts**, encrypted, for a day up to a year. Off until you turn it on.
- **Updates install in place** on Mac, Windows, Android, and iPhone (re-signed by the computer).
- **TwinDesk iPhone** (opt in): the computer signs TwinDesk for iPhone with your own free Apple ID and keeps it refreshed.
- **A tour for someone new**, and **What's new** after an update, now with the changes and fixes too. Both in General › Tutorial.
- **Linux touchpad** (#222): tap to click, two-finger scrolling and pinch on the other device, read from your desktop's own settings.
- **Pick which Mac display an Android phone mirrors** (#221), and **a custom size for Extend** on Windows (#226).
- **Phone-to-phone sound** between two Android phones (#205), and **Photos** has Copy and Share.

![What's new in 3.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/main/.github/assets/v32-whats-new.jpg)

### 📦 Installing

- **APT repository** for Debian, Ubuntu, Mint and Pop!_OS, updated by `apt upgrade`.
- **F-Droid** build (the full app without Google's code scanner and without the updater).

### 🩹 Fixes

- **Coming back to a PC with two monitors**: the pointer comes back on the edge that touches the device it left, also after a fast move.
- **Clipboard**: copying the same text again after the other side copied something sends it again (#223, #227).
- **Pinch on Android** from a Mac trackpad or a Linux touchpad (#228).
- **Phone keyboard layouts in Multi-device**: Type as a hardware keyboard on Windows and Linux, so AZERTY and other layouts reach Android as they are (#188).
- **Overview cards** side by side end level (#224). **Arrange** has Search's dim and solid panel instead of a blur.
- Android reconnects after a long Wi-Fi interruption (#192, #217), and its settings refresh at once (#190, #191, #214).
- Mac: the screen capture names its display (#198, #199), General asks for a missing screen permission (#200, #201), the viewer fits the Android window (#215), and Universal Clipboard no longer delays pasting (#211).
- Windows: right Shift from some keyboards is no longer lost (#212), clicking TwinDesk's own window buttons from the other computer no longer freezes the session (#203, #208, #209), and Multi-device starts when Windows blocks the helper (#216).
- Multi-device: sound stays on its device when the selection moves (#194, #196), and per-pair switches stay in step (#193, #195).
- Linux: Open at login works under systemd's autostart generator (#189, #202). Nix starts with its window and tray again (#213).

### 🙏 Thanks

Suggestions from [@rahulpatel902](https://github.com/rahulpatel902) (#231). Code from [@alexfoxtm](https://github.com/alexfoxtm) (#190, #199, #201, #214, #215, #217, #221, #227, #228), [@youyouhdhd](https://github.com/youyouhdhd) (#226), [@pengusto](https://github.com/pengusto) (#178, #230), [@hughesyadaddy](https://github.com/hughesyadaddy) (#195, #196), [@ShivanshuKantPrasad](https://github.com/ShivanshuKantPrasad) (#205, #213), [@Yashkush06](https://github.com/Yashkush06) (#197) and [@YashvanthSankar](https://github.com/YashvanthSankar) (#202). Reported by [@ElMahaster](https://github.com/ElMahaster) (#188).

The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

---

Earlier release: [3.0.0 notes](https://github.com/InukaAsith/TwinDesk/releases/tag/v3.0.0) (iPhone and iPad app, TwinDesk Web, phone to phone).

apps.name: UTM
apps.subtitle: Virtual machines for iOS
apps.localizedDescription:
UTM is a full featured virtual machine host for iOS. In short, it allows you to run Windows, Android, and more on your iPhone and iPad.

This version requires using AltJIT. Install UTM SE for slower emulation without JIT.

More information at https://getutm.app/

Features:

• Emulate any Processor
30+ processors supported by qemu including x86_64, ARM64, and RISC-V
• Run any Operating System
Windows, Linux, and more natively and securely on iOS within an App
• Fast Emulation
Para-virtualization with SPICE and JIT compilation with TCG
• High Compatibility
iOS 14+ supported. Works on iPhone and iPad. No jailbreak needed
• Free and Open Source
UTM and its dependencies are all free and open source
• Easy to Use
Configure and customize your VM in a native UI

versions.localizedDescription:
## Highlights
* (macOS) **DirectX graphics support for Windows**: Modern accelerated graphics for Windows 11 is now available on UTM for the first time. The driver is still experimental and games compatibility is currently limited.
* **Vulkan 1.3 graphics support for Linux**: Vulkan 1.3 is now supported on Linux guests with VirtIO Venus drivers in Mesa. Additionally, OpenGL 4.1 is supported with the new Apple Core OpenGL backend (macOS only).
* **Snapshots**: Save your VM at any point and go back to it later from the new Snapshots tab. Works with QEMU VMs on macOS and iOS 26, and with Apple Virtualization VMs on macOS 27.
* (macOS) **Apple Virtualization on macOS 27**: Pass USB devices through to your VM, turn on Secure Boot for Linux, run a VM without saving changes, and let VMs talk to each other with new networking modes.
* (macOS) **Smoother displays**: VMs now follow your display's refresh rate, so motion is fluid at up to 120 Hz on ProMotion displays.
* **More reliable USB**: Fast external SSDs can now be shared with a VM, and disconnecting a drive no longer freezes UTM. On macOS, drives are safely unmounted before they are handed to a VM.
* (iOS) **Better touch controls**: Gestures respond immediately, with new middle-click and right-drag actions and a new drag-to-scroll touch mode.
* (iOS) **iPhone Duo**: Fold your iPhone Duo like a laptop, and the bottom half becomes a keyboard or touchpad for your VM.

## Notes
* Suspended VMs may not resume correctly after updating. We recommend shutting down all VMs before you update UTM.
* The minimum supported versions are now macOS 12 and iOS 15.
* (macOS) Check out [UTM Games Database](https://db.getutm.app/) to see and report game compatibility for the experimental 3D driver. Re-install the Windows guest tools to get the latest driver.
* We now have a [development blog](https://blog.getutm.app)! Follow us for in-depth technical deep dives such as how we brought DirectX to QEMU.
* (macOS) To use the new graphics driver for Windows 11, we recommend a fresh install because the driver is still experimental and its use could lead to instability in the system. During the install of the guest tools, you will be prompted to select the experimental graphics driver. If you wish to install the new driver on a system that already is running the older display only driver, you need to run the uninstall script provided on the guest tools install ISO first.
* (macOS) Apple CoreGL backend does not support Vulkan or DirectX.
* Linux desktop rendering in Vulkan does not work due to lack of support for indirect draws for geometry shaders. Please configure your guest to use the older VirGL Gallium driver.
* SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller. A VM with a SCSI drive that was suspended, or has a snapshot with saved state, from an earlier version cannot resume it: delete the saved state and start the VM again.

## Changes (v5.0.9)
* (macOS 14) Display: Reverted the fix for VM windows being limited to 60 fps on ProMotion displays, because it could crash a VM at startup (#8204) and blurred Retina mode (#8191). VM windows still run at 120 Hz on a ProMotion display, unless a slower external display is the main display (added 2026-11-18)
* Fixed Windows games hanging at startup while compiling shaders, in-game videos stalling after the first frame, and a failed 3D command resetting the guest's display (#7984)
* Fixed X11 apps under Xwayland not displaying with Vulkan on Linux
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends
* Security: Fixed memory corruption issues that could allow a malicious guest to gain sandboxed code execution in the isolated rendering process (thanks Xusheng Li at Vector 35 Inc)
* Home: VM notes now render Markdown (#3547) (thanks @pingu-the-penguin)
* Home: Fixed the confirmation for Clone, Stop or Move not appearing the second time it was requested for the same VM (thanks @ianplusplus)
* Home: Fixed the screenshot in the VM details being covered by a flat color on iOS 26, macOS 26 and visionOS 26
* Home: The size shown in the VM details now updates after the settings are closed (#7923)
* Home: A VM on an external drive that is listed as unavailable now stays available after its .utm is opened again (#7762)
* Home: Fixed one unreadable saved entry making every VM lose its saved location, window state and external drives
* Config: SCSI drives on ARM64 virtual machines now use a VirtIO SCSI controller, so guests without an LSI driver such as Rocky Linux and RHEL can see them (#7712)
* Config: Fixed PowerPC VMs created with the default settings failing to start because of too many CPU cores
* Config: Fixed the default devices of the Heathrow PowerMac (g3beige) machine keeping the VM from starting (#7803)
* Config: Fixed the default configuration of the Sam460ex machine failing to start (#7603)
* Config: Fixed new PowerPC VMs such as pseries defaulting to a network card that the machine rejects (#7592)
* Config: Fixed saving a VM failing after adding a TPM on RISC-V and LoongArch
* Config: Fixed a crash opening the terminal window of a VM whose configuration has no terminal settings
* Config: Fixed the host port of port forwards being replaced by the guest port when migrating a UTM 3 configuration
* QEMU: Guests with a VirtIO GPU now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 75 Hz (#7820) (thanks @dragoshont)
* QEMU: Fixed saving a VM state that takes longer than 10 seconds being reported as "Timed out waiting for RPC" (#8052)
* QEMU: Fixed networking and the guest agent stalling once QEMU holds about a thousand open files, such as with a busy shared directory or 3D acceleration (#7624)
* QEMU: Fixed the display modes missing from the Monitors control panel of Mac OS guests on the mac99 machine (thanks @giovariot)
* QEMU: Fixed sound in Mac OS 9 and a hang at startup in its sound driver (#8033)
* QEMU: Fixed Mac OS 9 restarting to a black screen (#7999)
* QEMU: Fixed sound crackling and dropping out while the host is busy
* QEMU: Fixed Windows showing "Display output is not active." for several seconds on every boot with GPU acceleration
* QEMU: Fixed wrong colors in Windows programs that run in exclusive fullscreen with a 10-bit display format
* QEMU: Fixed a newly created VM not writing its debug log until UTM was restarted
* SPICE: Fixed sound staying silent until UTM was restarted after the guest stopped playing audio (#8148)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed a VM restored from a saved state showing a black screen until the guest draws again (#8050)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed a crash when a VM's screenshot was redrawn after the guest changed resolution or the VM stopped (#7745)
* Guest Agent: Fixed a guest being able to crash UTM through the guest agent port (#7684)
* USB: Fixed sharing 10 Gbps (USB 3.2 Gen 2) devices such as external SSDs and NVMe enclosures (#7530) (thanks @giovariot)
* USB: Fixed UTM freezing when a USB 3 drive is disconnected from a running VM (#5851)
* USB: Fixed USB audio devices playing slowly and stuttering (#8028) (thanks @gitwillsky)
* Downloader: Fixed the guest tools never updating after the first download when UTM runs in a language other than English (#7978)
* Downloader: VMs downloaded from a link now show the same warning about custom QEMU arguments as imported VMs (#7733)
* Downloader: Fixed some ZIP files importing as an empty VM
* Shortcuts: Fixed "Pause Virtual Machine" with Save State not saving the state
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 15) Fixed a crash on launch
* (iOS) Fixed the state saved by "Auto save on background" being lost when iOS ends UTM (#8051)
* (iOS) Home: Fixed a crash when selecting a VM whose configuration failed to load
* (iOS) Home: Fixed the settings closing right away when editing a VM while the list is in edit mode (#7939)
* (iOS SE) QEMU: Fixed wrong results from vector comparisons in guests (#7722)
* (macOS) Fixed a VM never starting, and blocking every later start, when it is started while UTM is hidden (#4091, #7988)
* (macOS) Fixed D3DMetal being selected on Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 27 without Rosetta (#8002) (thanks @pingu-the-penguin)
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Intel Macs by no longer selecting D3DMetal there (#8040) (thanks @nightness)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for corrupted geometry and GPU hangs in games
* (macOS 12) Fixed the Virtual Machine menu having no title in the menu bar (#8117)
* (macOS 14) ~~Display: Fixed VM windows being limited to 60 fps on ProMotion displays when connected to an external display (thanks @dragoshont)~~
* (macOS) Display: Holding a key now repeats it in guests that use a PS/2 keyboard, such as DOS and Windows 98 (#7766)
* (macOS) Display: Fixed clicks from automation, accessibility tools and touch displays landing at the previous pointer position
* (macOS) Toolbar: The USB, drives, shared folder, windows and keyboard shortcut menus now open under their button instead of at the pointer
* (macOS 12) Wizard: Fixed the summary page renaming the library window to "Summary"
* (macOS) Wizard: Going back to the hardware page no longer discards the machine, memory, cores and storage that were chosen
* (macOS 26) Settings: Fixed the Input pane being cut off at both edges of the settings window (#7990, #8022)
* (macOS) Settings: Fixed the Display and Input panes of a VM being cut off in languages with long labels (#7782)
* (macOS) Settings: Fixed number fields with steppers not lining up with the rest of the form (#7702)
* (macOS) Settings: Fixed a click not selecting a port forward (#7600)
* (macOS) Settings: Fixed a crash in the keyboard shortcut editor after deleting a shortcut (thanks @namoen0301)
* (macOS) QEMU: Better performance and steadier sound for x86_64 guests on Intel Macs, with new "Interrupt remapping" and "Lock guest memory" options under QEMU → Tweaks that are on by default (#8046) (thanks @nightness)
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed GPU-accelerated VMs crashing at startup on Intel Macs (#8036)
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed multi-core VMs hanging after the guest reboots (#8009)
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows VMs crashing on reboot or shutdown with the 3D graphics driver (#7981)
* (macOS) SPICE: Fixed a crash while sharing the clipboard with the guest (#8106)
* (macOS) USB: A drive's volumes are now unmounted before it is connected to a VM, which avoids the "Disk Not Ejected Properly" warning (#5650) (thanks @giovariot)
* (macOS) USB: A device set to "Auto connect on start" is now connected again when it is plugged back in while the VM runs (thanks @giovariot)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed Linux guests having no sound output (#8105)
* (macOS) AVF: Clones now get new MAC addresses when "Regenerate MAC addresses on clone" is on (#7895)
* (macOS) AVF: Say that the disk is full when a macOS install fails because the Mac ran out of space (#7958)
* (macOS) AVF: Side mouse buttons are no longer sent to Linux guests as a middle click (#7739)
* (macOS) AVF: Fixed a crash when taking a screenshot of a VM window with no size (#7650)
* (macOS) Scripting: New `capture screen` and `install guest tools` commands, a `file` property for the location of a VM, and `start … environment` to pass environment variables to QEMU, also as `utmctl start --env` (#5341, #6933)
* (macOS) Scripting: More QEMU options and the sound devices can be set in the configuration, and `guest size` now grows an existing drive
* (macOS) Scripting: The input commands and `capture screen` now work with Apple VMs, and a macOS VM can be created and installed without supplying an IPSW
* (macOS) Scripting: `get configuration` now returns the `source` of each drive (#7743)
* (macOS) Scripting: Suspending with save state now leaves the VM running when its state can't be saved, instead of leaving it paused (#7934)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed scripting and utmctl finding no VMs when UTM is launched hidden without its main window (#7949)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed a removable drive set from a script on an Apple VM failing on the first start (#8129)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed `protocol:TCP` being rejected in a port forward
* (macOS) Scripting: A failed `update configuration` or `duplicate` no longer leaves its unsaved changes behind
* (macOS) utmctl: Commands now exit with a failure status when they fail (#7933)
* (macOS) utmctl: `exec` now waits for the guest process to finish and returns its exit status (#7932)
* (macOS) utmctl: Removed the `attach` command and `start --attach`, which never worked (#7987)

## Changes (v5.0.8)
* Fixed several changes listed for v5.0.7 being left out of that build by mistake.
* (macOS) Fixed Windows 3D acceleration on Apple Silicon Macs without Rosetta by falling back to DXMT
* (macOS) QEMU: Fixed Windows installs from the USB CD drive stalling repeatedly, which made them much slower in v5.0.7 (#7970)

## Changes (v5.0.7)
* Updated the virglrenderer, MoltenVK and DXMT graphics backends with fixes for Windows 3D acceleration
* ~~QEMU: Windows guests now use the host display's refresh rate instead of always 60 Hz, which also fixes 3D acceleration failing on displays faster than 125 Hz (#7820)~~ This was dropped and will be included in the next update.
* QEMU: Fixed VirtIO GPU stalls that hung Windows at shutdown, stalled 3D benchmarks on Linux, and could leave the Windows 3D driver without a display
* Snapshots: Fixed saving and restoring the state of VMs with compressed disks (#7916)
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS 27.1) Support for iPhone Duo: the VM toolbar sits in the outer display's camera strip, and a new laptop mode turns the bottom half of the folded screen into a keyboard or touchpad
* (macOS) Fixed headless VMs keeping the Mac from sleeping after they were paused or stopped
* (macOS) Closing a VM window or quitting UTM while a VM runs now confirms with "Close" or "Quit" instead of "OK"
* (macOS) Fixed shaders using instancing or integer vertex attributes drawing incorrectly with the Apple Core OpenGL backend (#7944)
* (macOS) Updated the D3DMetal graphics backend with fixes for DirectX 12
* (macOS) Display: The option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen is now available on macOS 12 and later (#6183)
* (macOS) Wizard: Fixed the Name field's focus ring being clipped on the summary page (thanks @dnicolson)
* (macOS 15) QEMU: Better performance on Apple Silicon with the Hypervisor.framework built-in interrupt controller
* (macOS) Scripting: Force stopping a paused VM is now allowed
* (macOS 27) AVF: Explain when a USB device such as a webcam or phone can't be passed through, instead of showing "VZErrorDomain error -6" (#7914)
* (macOS) Guest Agent: Fixed an issue where clipboard sharing fails upon suspend-resume in macOS guests (you need to re-install the latest guest tools) (#7717)

## Changes (v5.0.6)
* Raised the minimum supported versions to macOS 12 and iOS 15 (#7758)
* Updated the DXMT and MoltenVK graphics backends
* Updated the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver, which now requires macOS 26 or iOS 26
* Home: The welcome screen now offers to open an existing VM instead of linking to the gallery
* Snapshots: New Snapshots tab to save, overwrite, restore, rename and delete snapshots of QEMU and Apple VMs. Requires iOS 26 on iOS and macOS 27 for Apple VMs (#5484)
* Settings: Custom QEMU arguments moved to their own page, and the full command line is shown as read-only text that can be copied (#489, #7604)
* SPICE: Fixed microphone audio quality (#7751)
* SPICE: Fixed display and input freezing when audio playback hangs under memory pressure (thanks @evan314159)
* CocoaSpice: Fixed typing into the built-in serial terminal (#7814)
* Terminal: Updated SwiftTerm with a new Metal renderer, and only web links printed by the guest can be opened
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* (iOS) Fixed the VM toolbar and external display on iOS 26 and iOS 27
* (iOS 26) Reclaim Space, Compress, Resize and converting imported drives to qcow2 are now available on iOS (#4774)
* (iOS 27) Confirm before closing the window of a running VM on iPad
* (iOS) Display: Long press and pan gestures respond immediately, touches at the screen edges reach the guest, new middle click and right/middle drag actions, and a new "Touch mode (drag to scroll)" (#4738)
* (iOS) Display: Redesigned the keyboard accessory bar to match the iOS 26 keyboard
* (iOS) Input: Game controller Options and Home buttons can now be mapped
* (iOS) Settings: Fixed selecting the KosmicKrisp Vulkan driver
* (macOS) VoiceOver now announces file browse fields by their name (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Terminal: Added a find bar (Cmd-F)
* (macOS 27) Display: New option to use the area beside the camera housing in full screen (#6183)
* (macOS 27) Display: Hot Corners are turned off while a VM is in full screen
* (macOS) Settings: Improved the notes field
* (macOS 26) Settings: The "New…" device menu now matches the sidebar
* (macOS) AVF: Sound input and output can be enabled separately, so "Output Only" no longer switches Bluetooth headphones to headset mode (#7875)
* (macOS 26) AVF: New "Shared Network (VM to VM)" and "Host Only" networking modes (#6975, #7480) (thanks @lovon-spec)
* (macOS 27) AVF: USB passthrough, also available from scripting and utmctl (#3778, #7777)
* (macOS 27) AVF: Run without saving changes (#4201, #7326)
* (macOS 27) AVF: Secure Boot option for UEFI guests (#7874)
* (macOS) Scripting: Snapshots are now scriptable objects, and utmctl gains `snapshot` and `discard-state` commands
* (macOS) Scripting: Create and install macOS VMs on the Apple backend (#6092) (thanks @meisenbarth)
* (macOS 27) Scripting: Set up the user account, automatic login and Remote Login of a new macOS VM on first boot (#7757)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed shared directories set with `update registry` failing to open on Apple VMs (thanks @atkinsam)
* (macOS) Scripting: Fixed a crash when starting a VM after removing its displays with `update configuration` (#7882)

## Changes (v5.0.5)
* ~~Reverted minimum version requirement imposed by v5.0.4: once again we support versions down to macOS 11.3 and iOS 14.0. However, DirectX support is still limited to macOS 13.0 and iOS 16.0.~~
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Config: For ARM64 configs, GICv3 is now selected by default. Previously this was only the case for > 8 vCPUs. This improves performance for higher vCPU counts < 8.
* Downloader: Path traversal and symlink checks added when unpacking downloaded ZIP files
* Wizard: scaling is now default to "nearest" when a "classic" computer emulation is created in the wizard and "linear" otherwise. Previously it was "nearest" for all configurations which led to poor scaling filter for anything with higher resolutions.
* (iOS) Support DirectX 11 with DXMT. Note that due to older iOS version (which supports TrollStore + Hypervisor), compatibility of DirectX titles is worse than macOS.
* (iOS) QEMU: Fixed MMIO BAR bug which prevented large hostmem window from working
* (iOS) Config: Improved RAM limit detection
* (macOS) DirectX 12 is now supported with D3DMetal backend (when available). You must (re)install the latest UTM guest tools experimental 3D graphics driver.
* (macOS) Support holding down Caps Lock key when input capture is enabled (#7840) (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Settings: new options to gracefully power down all running VMs on exit (#7829) (thanks @vectorseven)
* (macOS) Settings: support Cmd<->Opt swapping (#7837) (thanks @lprazdnik)
* (macOS) Scripting: add snapshots commands to scripting interface (#7832) (thanks @naveenrajm7)
* (macOS) AVF: Better error message when macOS guest version is too high (#7806) (thanks @sigitkusuma)

## Changes (v5.0.4)
* (macOS) Added support for Neptune backend in virglrenderer for DirectX support
* Localization: Updated German (thanks @Benjamin123-tech)
* Scripting: new reload config and VLAN commands (#7710, #7711) (thanks @GregOriol)
* SPICE: Fixed various bugs in renderer that leads to performance and tearing issues
* SPICE: Fixed a memory leak that could result in large amount of memory use by UTM
* Updated USB icon (#7718) (thanks @tan9)
* Fixed crash in UTMRegistry and memory leak in AVF installer (#7701) (thanks @Casey)

## Changes (v5.0.3)
* Fixed regression in GRUB rendering time due to new graphics backend
* Fixed Vulkan issues on latest Wayland
* Localization: Updated Chinese (Hong Kong, Simplified) (thanks @changanmoon)
* Home: Confirm delete when using swipe left (#3086)
* Home: Prevent duplicate VMs from appearing (#7533) (thanks @DevSecTim)
* AVF: Fixed CPU spike and mic loss due to two audio devices (thanks @matapo)
* Scripting: Added ability to get IP address from AVF machines (#7643) (thanks @hellcastter)
* Scripting: Fixed "update registry" for AVM backend (#7664) (thanks @EkkoG)
* Scripting: Improve USB device matching logic (thanks @TronickDev)

## Changes (v5.0.2)
* Environment variables are now logged when debug log is enabled
* Fixed a regression in GL acceleration where desktop might not render correctly (#7626)
* Added geometry shaders support to MoltenVK to enable DXVK (thanks @Anducalliew433) (#7575)
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where EAGL backend boots into a black screen (#7587)
* (iOS) Fixed a crash on iOS 15 due to incompatible symbols (#7593)
* (iOS) Fixed verbose logging for graphics backend
* (iOS) Fixed a crash when GL is enabled due to missing support for glDrawElementsInstancedBaseVertex (#7596)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue when after resizing a window if the guest outputs a different resolution size, the wrong texture resolution is used leading to misaligned cursor and warped graphics (#5781)
* (macOS) Fixed an issue where the window resizes to 0x0 when native scaling is enabled

## Changes (v5.0.1)
* CocoaSpice: Reworked Metal renderer to be faster and have lower latency
* Fixed an issue where a BIOS file with a comma in the filename will fail to load
* Default FPS will now be the maximum refresh rate of the display on macOS and iPadOS (iPhone with ProMotion will still have 60Hz as the default rate but can be overridden to 120Hz through settings)
* (macOS) Fixed issue causing `HV_UNSUPPORTED` on startup with Vulkan enabled (#7579)
* (iOS) Fixed resolution issue on external displays (#6040)
* (iOS) Pinch to zoom will turn off automatically updating zoom from the guest (until reset with the resize button)
* (iOS) Fixed external display menu not updating
* (iOS) Fixed incorrect scale on external displays and connecting an external display will now automatically scale to fit
* (iOS) Fixed an issue where powering off the VM will show the home screen but not terminate UTM in the background

## Changes (v5.0.0)
* Add Venus support for Vulkan (#4551)
* Add Apple Core OpenGL support for OpenGL 4.1 (#4285) (thanks @startergo)

## Issues
Please check the full list on [Github](https://github.com/utmapp/UTM/issues) and help report any bug you find that is not listed.

## Installation

* [iOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/ios/)
* [macOS](https://docs.getutm.app/installation/macos/)

| File | Description | Installation | JIT | Hypervisor | USB |
|------|------------|--------------|-----|-----------|-----|
| UTM.deb | Jailbroken iOS version | Open in Cydia, dpkg, or Sileo | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM.dmg | macOS version | Mounting and copying UTM.app to /Applications | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| UTM.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, etc (see guide) | Yes(2) | No | No |
| UTM-HV.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (TrollStore) | TrollStore | Yes | Yes(1) | Yes |
| UTM-SE.ipa | Non-jailbroken iOS version (sideloading) | AltStore, enterprise signing, etc | No | No | No |
| UTM-Remote.ipa | Remote client | Any | No | No | No |

1. Hypervisor on iOS requires an M1 iPad or newer.
2. Enabling JIT may require a separate JIT enabler such as [Jitterbug][2] or Jitstreamer.

### Verification (macOS)

The macOS release (`UTM.dmg`) is notarized by Apple. To verify the download, run `xcrun stapler validate UTM.dmg`. To verify the install, run `spctl -a -vv /Applications/UTM.app` and check that it is notarized and signed by `Turing Software, LLC (WDNLXAD4W8)`. This needs a network connection, so it cannot run from a sandbox that blocks outgoing connections.

[1]: https://getutm.app/install/
[2]: https://github.com/osy/Jitterbug

versions.localizedDescription:
### 正式发布与鸿蒙下载

- 发布 `1.18.5+254`，鸿蒙与 Android 手机／TV、Windows、macOS、iOS、Linux 从同一正式标签重新构建，统一在 GitHub Releases 提供安装包；鸿蒙取消 Beta 分类，用户可从公开发布页直接取得 HAP，应用内稳定更新检查可识别同版本的 HAP 和 manifest。
- 鸿蒙采用 `distribution: bundled`、`channel: harmonyos` 与可选真机报告，HAP、来源 manifest 和 SHA-256 随 Release 长期提供，四种语言 README 与安装指南同步统一下载入口。保持现有包名、桌面名称及递增构建号，覆盖升级仍需沿用用户原签名密钥。
- 构建、源码、版本、原生库及原始包摘要核验仍为发布前置条件；HAP 继续如实记录 `signed: false`、`runtime_verified: false` 和已知平台能力限制。缺少真机报告不阻止发布，主动提供的无效或失败报告仍会被拒绝；历史标签读取原提交的分发、渠道和验收策略。

### 新增语言

- 新增德语和日语各 1067 条界面翻译，覆盖设置、阅读器、收藏、导入导出、备份恢复和错误提示；语言设置、系统语言匹配、Flutter 组件及 JS `APP.locale` 同步支持 `de_DE`、`ja_JP`，德语不同地区与日语无地区设置均能识别，保留已有语言选择和系统默认策略。
- 补充 Apple 平台支持语言声明，日语桌面显示优先使用日文字体；语言菜单的「系统」随界面语言翻译，德日继续保留英文未知文案回退和第三方标签原文，新增实际资源、语言切换以及真实字体下的手机／横屏／桌面与两倍字号设置、菜单、覆盖确认回归。
- 设置选择器限制长选项的占宽，为标题保留空间；确认窗口的长标题支持换行，操作按钮在空间不足时改为纵向排列，避免德语、日语及大字号下布局失败、省略关键标题或挤出确认操作。
- GitHub 全平台正式构建和手动构建在实际安装包中核对翻译词典与来源提交一致，避免漏打包或携带旧版译文；继续使用指定 commit 的工作流产物验证新增语言。

### 语言与翻译修复

- 补齐下载备份覆盖本地修改确认提示的繁体翻译，以及漫画源更新取消提示的简繁翻译；润色阅读器横／竖屏图片数量的英文文案并统一中文括号。
- 将语言选项、持久化标识、Flutter 支持列表和翻译标识集中维护，保留现有简／繁／英文选择及系统语言匹配行为；JS 的 `APP.locale` 在英文下返回约定的 `en_US`，修复原先的 `en_null`，补齐 Flutter 组件本地化代理。
- 启动时载入简繁内置标签词库，查找按当前语言选择，显式切换和系统语言变化立即生效；避免继续使用启动时的旧词库，并保留英文原标签及未知标签回退。
- 文案参数按完整名称替换所有出现位置，避免短参数名替换其他名称的前缀或将参数值再次当作文案参数处理；未知参数继续保留原文。

### 应用启动诊断

- Windows 启动记录细化到 COM、工程与参数准备、实例检查、窗口类、显示器／DPI、窗口、引擎和插件阶段，补充应用版本、系统架构与 CPU 指令能力；主线程异常通过预先准备的句柄记录原始异常代码、模块文件名和相对偏移，捕获边界与 C++ 对象生命周期隔离，保留原异常传播及 Windows 错误报告，并验证日志轮转、不可写时的行为及真实安装包启动记录。用于继续定位 #190 的原设备启动失败，尚未确认原始兼容故障已修复。

### 阅读器修复

- 连续／瀑布流阅读在图片旁的空白区域右键保存或复制时，按当前可见图片行确定原图，复用活动滚动视口的几何与来源校验，保留缩放、平移、重复图片及跨章节的实际页码和章节归属；章节分隔和阅读区域外不选择图片，避免返回「没有图片」或选中隐藏预加载页面（#193）。

### 开发维护

- 阅读器保存失败后恢复悬浮章节导航的回归复用受控帧与真实 I/O 推进，等待退出处理完成后再验证恢复结果，修复鸿蒙 SDK 宿主测试中直接等待退出 Future 可能停滞的问题；保留保存期间禁止导航及失败后可重试的实际行为验证。
- 鸿蒙真机验收报告改为显式 `optional` 策略，随版正式版和候选版均可在缺报告时发布或恢复草稿；已附报告仍核对维护者权限、准确 HAP、源码、版本、摘要和测试结果。继续强制包体与原生库核验，保留未签名和未完成真机验收标记，历史 `required`／`stable_required` 标签仍按原策略恢复。
- 新增德语和日语完整 README，四份项目说明互相提供语言入口，默认 README 继续使用中文；同步更新翻译贡献、术语与验收说明，赞助名单生成、校验和自动同步覆盖全部四份 README。
- 使用现有独立 Dart 语法分析工具核对翻译，覆盖跨行、相邻拼接、转义、条件及列表中的静态文案，校验词典键集合、重复 JSON 键、空值／类型、占位符名称与次数及静态调用参数；替换原来的正则扫描，保留动态文案的校验边界，补充真实资源加载、语言切换、英文回退、所有漫画源失败枚举提示和 JS 语言标识回归，以及中英文翻译维护说明。
- 将正式安装包核验整理为公共工具，按配置推导手机／TV、Windows、macOS、iOS、Linux x64／ARM64 的完整附件清单；实际解包核对版本、架构、源码资源与原生库声明，用 libarchive 读取现有 DEB 的 zstd 压缩内容，明确验证安装目录、ARM64 字体补丁及 Flutter 字体路径编码，采用兼容 Python 3.10 的流式 SHA-256 生成绑定提交、构建运行号与安装包摘要的回执。
- 发布安装包与平台核验回执的 Actions 保留期统一为 30 天；鸿蒙随版 HAP 的构建产物同步保留 30 天，公开 Release 附件长期保留。
- 完整构建将固定版本 cargo-audit 的最新 RustSec 扫描和实际包核验汇总作为必需门禁，从审计程序自身读取版本并准备完整锁定依赖索引，查询失败保留诊断并阻止发布，安全回执有效期为 24 小时；手动构建共用核验入口，新增不公开的真实草稿上传、下载回读及中断后原包恢复演练，演练后清理仅属于本次运行的草稿。
- 正式发布与恢复支持补传缺失原包及复核已经公开的版本，保留已有附件并阻止摘要冲突；恢复按原提交中的门禁政策检查旧构建，并重新扫描原锁文件。来源、安全与平台核验清单作为发布附件长期保留，各阶段和渠道同步状态分别报告。
- 更新检查的超时回归改用受控时钟，在假 HTTP 请求进入后推进截止时间，继续验证取消与原生收尾的顺序，消除繁忙 CI 运行器上依赖真实 30 毫秒启动窗口的竞态。
- 完善中英文翻译贡献入口，提供新语种需求、校对和维护的提报要求，以及现有简繁术语参考与同提交的词典、组件、手机／桌面和大字号验收清单；首批语种按实际需求和校对能力确定。

### 安全与依赖

- 将 Rhttp 的 `cookie` 锁定版本从 0.18.1 更新至 0.18.3，消除最新完整锁文件扫描发现的 RUSTSEC-2026-0594；该公告涉及 Unix `fork()` 后生成私有加密 Cookie 的 nonce 重复，当前依赖未启用此功能。仅更新该 crate 的版本与校验值，继续核验现有原生平台兼容性。

apps.name: VRCM
apps.subtitle: Bring your VRChat social life to your phone
apps.localizedDescription: VRCM is a cross-platform VRChat companion focused on social connection and convenience. Explore your social circles, remember time spent together, and move smoothly from shared links to worlds, interactions, and real-world meetups.

versions.localizedDescription:
## 新增

- Android 和 iOS 支持通过相机或相册扫描 VRChat 链接，图片包含多个二维码时可选择识别结果。
- 支持扫码审批 VRChat 设备登录，展示请求时间和来源地区；Android 新增扫一扫桌面快捷方式。
- 新增独立“我的二维码”页面，支持个人主页码、样式切换和分享卡片。
- 统计数据支持 SQLite 导入导出，可导入 VRCM 或 VRCX 数据库，预览导入内容并去重合并。
- 设置按账号安全、外观、通知、隐私与数据等分类，集中管理已保存账号的切换和登出。
- 好友动态新增名字和模型变更记录，并提供独立的模型筛选分类。

## 优化

- 群组房间支持邀请自己，世界详情加载来源房间，展开的房间卡片可打开房主主页。
- 资料编辑适配 VRChat 新接口，保存简介、社交链接和语言后同步刷新状态。

## 修复

- 后台登录会话失效时自动恢复，避免好友与动态更新长期中断。
- 修复玩家批量清理在列表刚加载完时点击无响应，以及登录续期后剩余请求中断的问题；避免迟到的续期通知覆盖已成功的语音开关状态。
- 修复 Android 大型统计快照读取、系统文件选择器导入和导出文件句柄释放问题。
- 应用内更新遇到包名或签名不匹配的 APK 时停止更新，避免继续换源重试。
- 修复 Windows 渐进背景模糊导致的卡死、群组代表状态跨资料页不同步，以及模型列表的平台支持标记错误。

****************

## New Features

- Scan VRChat links with the camera or from photos on Android and iOS, and choose a result when an image contains multiple QR codes.
- Approve VRChat device sign-ins by scanning a code, with the request time and source region shown; Android also adds a launcher shortcut to the scanner.
- Added a separate My QR Code page with a profile code, appearance options, and a shareable card.
- Import and export statistics as SQLite files, with support for VRCM and VRCX databases, an import preview, and duplicate merging.
- Settings are organized into account security, appearance, notifications, privacy and data, and other categories, with saved-account switching and sign-out in one place.
- Friend activity now includes display-name and avatar changes, with a dedicated avatar filter.

## Optimizations

- Invite yourself to group instances, load the source instance in world details, and open the owner's profile from an expanded instance card.
- Profile editing follows VRChat's updated API and refreshes the saved bio, social links, and languages consistently.

## Bug Fixes

- Automatically restore expired background sessions to resume friend and activity updates.
- Fixed bulk player cleanup ignoring clicks just after loading or interrupting remaining requests after session renewal; delayed renewal notifications no longer overwrite successful mute or unmute actions.
- Fixed large statistics snapshots, imports through Android document providers, and file-handle cleanup after exports.
- In-app updates stop when an APK has a mismatched package name or signature instead of retrying other mirrors.
- Fixed Windows freezes caused by progressive backdrop blur, group representation falling out of sync across profiles, and incorrect platform-support indicators in avatar lists.

详情 / Details: <https://github.com/vrcm-team/VRCM/tree/main/docs/releases/1.1.6.md>

apps.name: WQ Files
apps.subtitle: File manager for iOS 26 and 27 (worse_query)
apps.localizedDescription: File browser, app data manager and cache cleaner for iOS 26 and 27, built on the worse_query sandbox technique. Browse other apps' containers, edit plists, hex and SQLite databases, and back up, restore or clear app data without a jailbreak or kernel exploit.

versions.localizedDescription:
> **Requires:** iOS 26.0 – 26.7.2, or iOS 27.0 up to 27.3 beta 1. **Not supported:** iOS 27.3 beta 2 and later, where Apple patched worse_query. Tested on iOS 27.0.1, 27.2.1, 27.3 beta 1 (confirmed by a user) and 26.7.1; see [Tested devices](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#tested-devices).
> **Needs:** a sideloading tool that keeps the App Group entitlement; see [Signing](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles#signing-the-app-group) in the README.

# Worse Query Files 0.9.20

Apps Manager backups, and safer handling of databases that are in use.

## New

- **Import Apps Manager backups** ([#19](https://github.com/kolbicz/WQFiles/issues/19)): **Apps** → tap the app → **Import as Backup…** now accepts `.adbk` files from Apps Manager. The app's data is saved as a normal WQ Files backup, ready to restore.
  - Only the app's own data folder is imported. App Group data in the file isn't, because WQ Files backups don't include App Groups. The keychain items Apps Manager saves are encrypted, so they can't be imported either. When you import, WQ Files lists what it left out.
  - If the file says it belongs to a different app than the one you tapped, WQ Files asks first, as with any other import.
  - Opening an `.adbk` from the Files app or the share sheet doesn't start an import; start it from Apps.

## Fixed

- **Files another app is using:** deleting or replacing them, for example an app's database in its App Group while the app runs, failed with "Resource temporarily unavailable (errno 35)". WQ Files now says another app is using the file and that quitting that app and trying again should work. Its extensions or widgets can keep the file open even after you quit it.
- **Databases in use stay intact:** an app's database comes with `-wal` and `-shm` files next to it, and while the app runs, iOS doesn't lock the `-wal` file. WQ Files could delete or replace it while refusing the database file, which lost the app's newest data. Now a database and its `-wal`, `-shm` and `-journal` files are only changed together: if one of them is in use, none of them is touched. This applies to deleting (also whole folders), replacing on import and editing.
- **Deleting or importing several files at once:** each database is handled before its `-wal` and `-shm` files, which are skipped if the database itself couldn't be deleted or replaced. "N of M files were imported" is translated now.

## Credit

New design: GpGp700. Sandbox technique: [worse_query](https://github.com/forcequitOS/worse_query) by Taj C (forcequit). Container enumeration: [KAMUI](https://github.com/murk-sus/kamui-escape) by murk-sus. Resumable scans: hhh2210. Custom inspectors idea: deltaII. Translations: iosrxwy and FrogTool (Simplified Chinese), kinboy56 (Japanese), hfip (Arabic), hooray804 (Korean), Reinascape (Russian), romlayvn-93 (Vietnamese), buraakkcayir (Turkish review). Thanks to braless for the Apps Manager sample, and to everyone who sent screenshots and Logs. GPL-3.0-or-later.

SHA-256 of WQFiles.ipa: `9ddfa3c1ff01de4d76f601d3b6b76390436136d529f029b9bfaa48c501cfe197`
